content.text:
This Part is concerned with the fire, structural, heating, ventilating
and air-conditioning performance of [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings, as well as processes and operations carried out therein that involve
a risk of explosion, high flammability or related conditions that
create a hazard to life safety. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote2:short].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect1.subsect2.art1.sent2:short], this Part applies to all [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art5:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art6.sent1:long].

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7:long] do not apply to Group G, Division
4 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies.
Words that appear in italics are defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect4.subsect1.art2:long].

subsections.title: Classification of Farm Buildings by Major Occupancy

content.text:
Every [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building or part of
a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building shall be classified
according to its [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy as
belonging to one of the Divisions of Group G described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect1.subsect4.art1.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote3:short].)
(See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote11:long])

content.title: Classification of Agricultural Major Occupancies

body_rows.content: [REF:term:grc-ccp]Agricultural occupancies not elsewhere classified in Group G

content.text:
Every [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building or part of
a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building shall be classified
in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect1.subsect4:long]

Portions of [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings that
do not contain Group G, Division 1, 2, 3 or 4 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies shall be classified according to their [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy as belonging to one of the
Groups or Divisions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art1.table1:long] and those
portions shall conform to the requirements in Part 3. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote4:short].)

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings classified as a Group G,
Division 1 or 4 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall
not contain a Group A, B or C [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings classified as a Group G,
Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall
not contain a Group A, Division 1 or 3, or Group B [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

In a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building in which the
aggregate area of all [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies in a particular Group or Division is not more than 10% of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area of the [REF:term:tr]storey in which they are located, these [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies need not be considered as [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies for the purposes of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect2:long], provided they
are not classified as Group F, Division 1 or Group G, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art4.sent2:short], [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies shall be separated
from adjoining [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies by [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations having [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance ratings conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art4.table1:long]

If one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy is located
above another [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of the floor assembly
between the [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies shall
be determined on the basis of the requirements of this Section for
the lower [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy.

[REF:term:ccpnc]Occupancies other than [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies shall be separated from
adjoining [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies belonging to a different
Group or Division by [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations having [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance ratings that
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art4.table1:long], but need not be more than 1 h (metric).

content.title:
Major Occupancy Fire Separations
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art9:long] contains requirements for other [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations that are in addition to the
requirements for the separation of [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies.

content.text:
Any wall, [REF:term:prttn]partition or floor assembly
required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation shall

clauses.text: except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art5.sent2:short], be constructed as a continuous element, and

as required in this Section, have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating as specified (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote27:long]).

content.text:
Openings in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation shall
be protected with [REF:term:clr]closures, shafts or other
means in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19:short]

articles.title: Penetrations in Fire Separations and Fire-Rated Assemblies

content.text:
Penetrations of a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4:short]

A [REF:term:frwll]firewall that separates a [REF:term:bldng]building or [REF:term:bldng]buildings with [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas containing a Group G,
Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall be
constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 4 h (metric).

A [REF:term:frwll]firewall that separates a [REF:term:bldng]building or [REF:term:bldng]buildings with [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas containing a Group G [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy and a [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy prohibited by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art2:long] shall
be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 4 h (metric).

[REF:term:frwll]Firewalls shall conform to the requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art7:short],[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent3:long].

Concealed spaces in interior wall, ceiling and crawl spaces
shall be separated from concealed spaces in exterior walls and [REF:term:ttc-r-rf]attic or roof spaces by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote6:short].)

Concealed spaces in walls and [REF:term:prttn]partitions shall be separated by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks into
compartments not more than 3 m (metric) in height and 20
m (metric) in length.

Horizontal concealed spaces within a floor assembly or roof
assembly of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction, in which sprinklers are not installed, shall be separated by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks into compartments not more than 900 m2
                            (metric) in area.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art8.sent5:short], [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks shall be constructed of
materials that will remain in place and prevent the passage of flames
for not less than 15 min (metric) when subjected to the standard
fire exposure in [REF:standard:ulcs101]

[REF:term:fr-blk]Fire blocks need not be tested in
conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art8.sent4:short] if they
are constructed of not less than

clauses.text: 0.38 mm (metric) sheet steel,
12.7 mm (metric) gypsum board,

12.5 mm (metric) plywood, OSB or waferboard, with joints
backed with similar material,
two layers (metric) of lumber, each not less than 19 mm (metric) thick, with joints staggered, or
38 mm (metric) lumber.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art9.sent2:short] and required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art9.sent3:short], fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliances shall be installed in [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms separated from the remainder of
the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building by

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min (metric) in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is
not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, or

a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation not required
to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating in
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

content.text:
A fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliance that serves
only one room is not required to be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building.

Incinerators shall be installed in [REF:term:rvc-rm]service
rooms that

clauses.text: do not contain other fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliances, and

are separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than

subclauses.text:
2 h (metric), where the [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room is adjacent to a Group G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is
not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,

1 h (metric), where the [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room is adjacent to a Group G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,

1 h (metric), where the [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room is adjacent to a Group G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,
or

30 min (metric), where the [REF:term:rvc-rm]service
room is adjacent to a Group G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

content.text:
A room containing a device that produces open flames, heat or
sparks and used for crop drying shall be separated from the remainder
of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building by

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min (metric) in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is
not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, or

a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation not required
to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating in
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

content.text:
A room intended to be used for repairing farm machinery shall
be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm
building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having
a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than

clauses.text:
1 h (metric), in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,
or
30 min (metric), in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

content.text:
Storage areas for [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art2.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art2.sent2:short].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art10.sent2:short], the rating of a material, assembly of materials, or structural
member that is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating shall be determined on the basis of the results of tests
conducted in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs101]

A material, assembly of materials, or structural member is permitted
to be assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating on the basis of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long].

[REF:term:flm-prd-]Flame-spread ratings shall be
determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect12.art1:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art12.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art12.sent3:short], the [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of interior wall and ceiling finishes, including glazing and skylights,
shall be not more than 150.

The [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of interior
wall and ceiling finishes in [REF:term:xt]exits shall conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art2.sent1:long].

Subject to the requirement of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art13:long], the [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating on any exposed surface
of foamed plastic insulation, and on any surface that would be exposed
by cutting through the insulation in any direction, shall be not more
than 500.
Foamed plastics installed in [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall be protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art2.sent1:long].
Fabrics and films used in connection with tents and [REF:term:r-pprtd-]air-supported structures shall conform to [REF:standard:ulcs109]

The installation of electrical wiring and electrical equipment
shall conform to the requirements of

clauses.text: provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws, or

[REF:standard:csac22.1] in
the absence of the regulations or bylaws referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art15.sent1.clause1:short].

content.text:
Electrical wiring installed in a concealed space shall be enclosed
in rigid conduit or otherwise protected against damage. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote7:short].)
Wires and cables installed in [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art3:long]

If a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area or part of a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area has been designed for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load other than that prescribed in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art6.sent1:long] or this Part, a permanent sign indicating
that [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load shall be posted in
a conspicuous location.

subsections.title: Building Size and Construction Relative to Major Occupancy

articles.title: Farm Buildings with Multiple Agricultural Major Occupancies

content.text:
In a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building containing
more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]agricultural major occupancy classified in more than one Division, the [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and [REF:term:bldng-r]building area of the entire [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building shall
be used in determining the construction requirements and the fire
safety requirements for each of the [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies.

The space above a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine need
not be considered as a [REF:term:tr]storey, provided the
conditions of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent5:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent7:short] are met.

Platforms conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent6:long] need not
be considered as a [REF:term:tr]storey.

articles.title: Group G, Division 1, up to 3 Storeys, Limited Area, Sprinklered

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building classified as Group G,
Division 1 is permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible
construction or [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, used singly or in combination, provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,
the [REF:term:bldng]building is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,
the [REF:term:bldng]building has a [REF:term:bldng-r]building area not more than

subclauses.text:
4 800 m2
                                  (metric), if 1 storey
                                  (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,

2 400 m2
                                  (metric), if 2 storeys
                                  (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, or

1 600 m2
                                  (metric), if 3 storeys
                                  (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,

clauses.text:
floor assemblies, including the floor assembly immediately above
a [REF:term:bmnt]basement, are [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separations with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min (metric), and

[REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing walls, columns and arches
have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less
than that required for the supported assembly.

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building classified as Group G,
Division 1 is permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible
construction or [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, used singly or in combination, provided

clauses.text: it is not more than 1 [REF:term:tr]storey in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, and

except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect2.art4.sent2:short], it has a [REF:term:bldng-r]building area not more than 2 400 m2
                               (metric).

content.text:
Where the [REF:term:bldng]building referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect2.art4.sent1:short] is a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building housing livestock with a below-floor storage area for liquid manure,
the [REF:term:bldng]building is permitted to have a [REF:term:bldng-r]building area of any size.

articles.title: Group G, Division 2, Any Height, Any Area, Sprinklered

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building classified as Group G,
Division 2 of any [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height or [REF:term:bldng-r]building area is permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction or [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, used singly or
in combination, provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,

floor assemblies are [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 45 min (metric), and

[REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing walls, columns and arches
have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less
than that required for the supported assembly.

articles.title: Group G, Division 2, up to 3 Storeys, Any Area

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building classified as Group G,
Division 2 of any [REF:term:bldng-r]building area is permitted
to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction or [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, used singly or
in combination, provided the [REF:term:bldng]building is
not more than 3 storeys
                            (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height.

articles.title: Group G, Division 3, One Storey, Any Area

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building classified as Group G,
Division 3 of any [REF:term:bldng-r]building area is permitted
to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction or [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, used singly or
in combination, provided the [REF:term:bldng]building is
not more than 1 storey
                            (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height.

articles.title: Group G, Division 4, Any Height, Any Area

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building classified as Group G,
Division 4 of any [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height or [REF:term:bldng-r]building area is permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction or [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, used singly or
in combination.

articles.title: Determination of Requirement for a Fire Alarm System

content.text:
A fire alarm system complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent2:short] shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout
and that

clauses.text:
contains a Group G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 25, or

contains a Group G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy

subclauses.text:
with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than
150,
in a [REF:term:bldng]building more than 1 [REF:term:tr]storey in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, or

in a [REF:term:bldng]building with a [REF:term:bmnt]basement used for a purpose other than the housing of service
equipment.

content.text:
Except as otherwise provided in this Section, the fire alarm
system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent1:short] shall
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art5:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art17:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent4:short].
The fire alarm system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] shall be

clauses.text: a single-stage system in a Group G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, and
a single- or 2-stage system in a Group G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy.

content.text: Where a fire alarm system is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent1:long],

clauses.text:
the air-handling system, where provided, shall be designed to
prevent the circulation of smoke upon a signal from a duct-type [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector if the air-handling system
serves more than 1 [REF:term:tr]storey, and
a manual station shall be installed in every [REF:term:flr-r]floor area near every [REF:term:xt]exit.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art4.sent3:short], the fire alarm system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] shall
include

clauses.text:
audible signal devices conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent1:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent4:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent7:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent11:short],

an audible [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal device
with a sound pressure level not less than 110 dBA (metric) installed
on the exterior of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building, and
visible signal devices installed in any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in which

subclauses.text: the ambient noise level is more than 87 dBA (metric),
the occupants use ear protection devices, or
the occupants are located in sound-insulating enclosures.

content.text:
The visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art4.sent1.clause3:medium] shall be installed so that the signal from at least
one device is visible throughout the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area or portion thereof in which they are installed. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote85:long].)

The audible [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal devices
referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art4.sent1.clause1:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art4.sent1.clause2:short] need not be provided in areas where animals are present, provided
that visible signal devices are installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art4.sent2:short].
The fire alarm system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] shall

clauses.text:
be designed so that when an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal is actuated, it cannot be silenced automatically before a period
of time has elapsed that is not less than 20 min (metric), and

not incorporate manual silencing switches other than those installed
inside the fire alarm control unit.

content.text:
Where an automatic sprinkler system is provided, it shall be
electrically supervised to indicate a supervisory signal on a fire
alarm system annunciator or a sprinkler system annunciator for each
condition described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent3:long].
Where a fire alarm system is required in a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent1:long], [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detectors shall be

clauses.text: except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art7.sent2:short], installed throughout the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building, and
connected to the fire alarm system.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detectors referred to
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect3.art7.sent1:short] need not be provided within [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas that are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.
Access for fire department equipment shall be provided to each [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building by means of a [REF:term:trt]street, private roadway or yard.

Where access to a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] is provided
by means of a roadway or yard, the design and location of such roadway
or yard shall take into account connection with public thoroughfares,
weight of firefighting equipment, width of roadway, radius of curves,
overhead clearance, location of fire hydrants, location of fire department
connections and vehicular parking.

Where an automatic sprinkler system is provided, it shall conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long]

Where a fire pump is installed as part of the automatic sprinkler
system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent1:short], it
shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art18:long]

The automatic sprinkler system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent1:short] shall be equipped with waterflow-detecting
devices that are

clauses.text: installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art15.sent1:long], and
connected to

subclauses.text:
the fire alarm system, where provided, so that, upon its actuation,
an [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal or an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal is initiated, or
an audible signal device, where a fire alarm system is not provided.

content.text:
Portable extinguishers shall be provided and installed in accordance
with

clauses.text: provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws, or

the [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc],
in the absence of the regulations or bylaws referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect4.art3.sent1.clause1:short].

content.text:
Where lighting is provided in a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm
building, emergency lighting shall be provided to an average
level of illumination not less than 10 lx (metric) at floor or
tread level in

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt]exits, and
principal routes providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit in open [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas and in [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms.

content.text: The minimum value of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect5.art1.sent1:short] shall be 1 lx (metric).
An emergency power supply shall be

clauses.text:
provided to maintain the emergency lighting required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect5.art1.sent1:short] from a power source such as batteries
or generators that will continue to supply power in the event that
the regular power supply to the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building is interrupted, and

designed and installed such that, upon failure of the regular
power, it will assume the electrical load automatically for a period
of 30 min (metric).

content.text:
[REF:term:mn-f-gr]Means of egress complying with
this Subsection shall be provided from every [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area containing a Group G, Division 1, 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy.

If a platform or contained open space is provided, egress requirements
shall conform to the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art2:long] for rooms.

[REF:term:mn-f-gr]Means of egress from roofs shall
be provided in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent3:long].

[REF:term:mn-f-gr]Means of egress from rooftop enclosures
shall be provided in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art3.sent6:short].
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent2:short], at least one egress doorway shall be provided from every room.

A minimum of 2 egress doorways located so that one doorway could
provide egress from the room as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art3:long] if the other doorway becomes inaccessible to the occupants due
to a fire originating in the room, shall be provided for every room

clauses.text:
that is used for a Group G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, other than one housing livestock with a below-floor
storage area for liquid manure, where the area of the room is more
than

subclauses.text:
15 m2
                                  (metric), in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, or

30 m2
                                  (metric), in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,

clauses.text:
in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout and contains a Group
G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy housing
livestock with a below-floor storage area for liquid manure or a Group
G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy,
where

subclauses.text:
the area of the room is more than 200 m2
                                  (metric), or

the travel distance within the room to the nearest egress doorway
is more than 15 m (metric), or

clauses.text:
in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout and contains a Group
G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy housing
livestock with a below-floor storage area for liquid manure or a Group
G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy,
where

subclauses.text:
the area of the room is more than 300 m2
                                  (metric), or

the travel distance within the room to the nearest egress doorway
is more than 25 m (metric).

content.text:
Where 2 egress doorways are required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent2:short], they shall be placed at a distance from one another
equal to or greater than one third of the maximum overall diagonal
dimension of the area to be served, measured as the shortest distance
that smoke would have to travel between the nearest required egress
doorways.

If more than one egress doorway is required from a room referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent2:long], the travel distance within the
room to the nearest egress doorway shall not exceed the maximum travel
distance specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art5:long] for [REF:term:xt]exits.

Except within a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space, the
minimum headroom clearance in every [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to
exit shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4:long] for [REF:term:xt]exits.
The minimum width of an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit, including obstructions, shall be 750 mm (metric).

A fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliance shall not
be installed in a corridor serving as an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access
to exit.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art6.sent2:short], a door that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from a room shall

clauses.text: be a sliding door, or
swing on its vertical axis.

content.text:
A door that opens into a facility providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from a room that is used for a Group G, Division
1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, other than one housing
livestock with a below-floor storage area for liquid manure, shall
swing on a vertical axis in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt]exit.
A door that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from a room shall

clauses.text: provide a clear opening of not less than 750 mm (metric) if there is only one door leaf,

in a doorway with multiple leaves, have the active leaf providing
a clear opening of not less than 750 mm (metric),
not open onto a step, and

except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art7.sent2:short], have a threshold not more than 13 mm (metric) higher than
the surrounding finished floor surface.

content.text:
The door referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art7.sent1:short] is permitted to have a threshold not more than 100 mm (metric) higher than the surrounding finished floor surface, where the threshold
is used to confine

clauses.text: the spillage of liquids classified as [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods within a room, or
animal litter within an animal containment area.

content.text: Door release hardware shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art8:long]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art8.sent3:short], [REF:term:rmp]ramps and stairways that do not serve
as [REF:term:xt]exits shall

clauses.text: be not less than 750 mm (metric) wide, and

conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art16:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art3:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art9:short]

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art8.sent3:short], the maximum slope of a [REF:term:rmp]ramp shall be 1 in 6 (metric).

[REF:term:rmp]Ramps and stairways need not comply
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art8.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art8.sent2:short], provided

clauses.text: they are intended only

subclauses.text: for occasional use for servicing equipment and machinery, or
for use as animal handling ramps, and

clauses.text: they do not serve as [REF:term:xt]exits.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art10:long], floor openings
shall be provided with a cover at floor level that is capable of resisting
the loads specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3:long] for the adjacent
area of floor.

Openings through the cover required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art9.sent1:short] shall be of a size that prevents the passage of a spherical
object whose diameter is more than 100 mm (metric).
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art10.sent3:short], a [REF:term:guard]guard not less than 1 070 mm (metric) high shall be provided

clauses.text:
around floor openings, where provision of a cover in accordance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art9.sent1:long] is not practical, and

at locations where the difference in elevation between two adjacent
surfaces is more than 600 mm (metric).

content.text: The [REF:term:guard]guard required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art10.sent1:short] shall consist of

clauses.text: a top railing,
an intermediate rail located at the mid-height of the [REF:term:guard]guard, and

where tools or other objects could fall from an upper floor
surface onto a person on an adjacent lower surface, a toe board extending
not less than 125 mm (metric) above the upper floor surface.

content.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect6.art10.sent1:short] does not apply

clauses.text: to vehicle repair pits,
to loading docks, or
where access is provided for maintenance purposes only.

content.text:
Warning signs shall be installed in accordance with [REF:external:nfc]Subsection 2.14.2. of Division B of the 
                           [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc].

A glass or transparent door shall be designed and constructed
so that the existence and position of the door is readily apparent,
by attaching visually contrasting hardware, bars or other permanent
fixtures to it.

Transparent doors and panels shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent6:short].

Transparent panels used in a door that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit that, because of their physical
configuration or design, could be mistaken as a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress shall be made inaccessible by barriers or
railings.

[REF:term:xt]Exit facilities complying with this
Subsection shall be provided from every [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area containing a Group G, Division 1, 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote8:short].)
An [REF:term:xt]exit from any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall be one of the following:

clauses.text:
an exterior doorway conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art6.sent1:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art6.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art7:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art8:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art11:short],
an openable window or panel conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art6.sent3:long], or

an [REF:term:xt]exit facility listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art4:long] that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art5:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art6:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art2.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4:long]

content.text:
Except as provided by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent3:short], every [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall
be served by at least 2 [REF:term:xt]exits.

A [REF:term:flr-r]floor area classified as a Group
G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy is permitted
to be served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit, provided the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is not more than

clauses.text:
10 m2
                               (metric), where the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, or

20 m2
                               (metric), where the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

content.text:
A [REF:term:flr-r]floor area classified as a Group
G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy is
permitted to be served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit, provided
the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is not more than

clauses.text:
200 m2
                               (metric), where the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, or

300 m2
                               (metric), where the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

content.text:
The minimum distance between 2 [REF:term:xt]exits from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall be one half the
maximum diagonal dimension of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art5.sent2:short], the travel distance to at least one [REF:term:xt]exit shall be not more than

clauses.text:
30 m (metric), in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that contains a Group G, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy, other than one housing livestock with a below-floor
storage area for liquid manure,
60 m (metric), in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that contains a Group G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy and that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, and
90 m (metric), in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that contains a Group G, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy and that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

content.text:
A [REF:term:flr-r]floor area containing a Group G,
Division 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy need not
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art5.sent1:short], provided

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt]exits are placed not more than 60 m (metric) apart along the perimeter of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, and
each main aisle in the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area

subclauses.text:
leads directly to an [REF:term:xt]exit in at least
two opposite directions, and
has a minimum width of 750 mm (metric).

content.text:
[REF:term:xt]Exits shall be located and arranged
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent3:long].
The minimum clear width of an exterior doorway used as an [REF:term:xt]exit shall be 750 mm (metric).

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art6.sent3:short], the minimum headroom clearance in every [REF:term:xt]exit shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4:long]
An openable window or panel used as an [REF:term:xt]exit shall have

clauses.text: an opening not less than 900 mm (metric) by 550 mm (metric), and
a fire escape or stair, where required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art9:long]

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art7.sent2:short], every [REF:term:xt]exit door shall

clauses.text:
open in the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel,
and
swing on its vertical axis.

content.text:
[REF:term:xt]Exit doors that serve a Group G, Division
2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy housing animals need
not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art7.sent1.clause1:medium].

Door release hardware on [REF:term:xt]exit doors
shall

clauses.text: be operable with one hand,

permit the door to be readily opened from the inside with not
more than one releasing operation and without requiring keys, special
devices or specialized knowledge of the door-opening mechanism, and

be installed not more than 1 200 mm (metric) above the finished
floor.

content.text:
Where an exterior doorway used as an [REF:term:xt]exit is more than 300 mm (metric) above adjacent ground level, a
stair or fire escape shall be provided.

Where the bottom of an openable window or panel used as an [REF:term:xt]exit is more than 2 500 mm (metric) above adjacent
ground level, a stair or fire escape shall be provided.

Fire escapes required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent2:short] shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7.art7:short]

[REF:term:xt]Exit stairs shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1.sent1.clause1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art6:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8:short]

The minimum width of [REF:term:xt]exit stairs shall
be 900 mm (metric).

[REF:term:frm-bldn]Farm buildings shall comply with
the requirements for [REF:term:xt]exit signs stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art1.sent4:short], the storage, handling and use of hazardous substances
shall be in conformance with

clauses.text: provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws, or
in the absence of the regulations or bylaws referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art1.sent1.clause1:short], the [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc].

content.text:
[REF:term:frm-bldn]Farm buildings or parts of [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings used for the storage, handling,
use and processing of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art7:short]

The production, handling, storage and utilization of biogas
shall be in conformance with [REF:standard:csab149.6]

Where [REF:external:nfc]Article 3.2.9.1. of Division B of
the 
                           [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc] applies due to the quantity and nature of the stored product, [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings used for the storage of ammonium
nitrate shall

clauses.text: be classified as Group G, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies, and

comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent2:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent6:short].

content.text:
Systems for the ventilation of cooking equipment that is used
in processes producing grease-laden vapours shall be designed and
installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art3:short] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote126:long].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent3:short], an exhaust ventilation system designed in conformance with the
appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4:long] shall be
provided in a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building or part
of a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building in which dust, fumes,
gases, vapours or other impurities or contaminants have the potential
to create a fire or explosion hazard.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent3:short], [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art21.sent3:long].

[REF:term:frm-bldn]Farm buildings housing livestock
with a below-floor storage area for liquid manure need not comply
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent2:short], provided they comply
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote10:short].)

articles.title: Below-Floor Storage Areas for Liquid Manure

content.text:
[REF:term:frm-bldn]Farm buildings housing livestock
with a below-floor storage area for liquid manure shall be provided
with a ventilation system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2:long]

Where the ventilation system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art3.sent1:short] relies on electrical power for normal operation, it
shall be provided with an emergency power supply conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art3.sent3:short].
The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art3.sent2:short] shall be

clauses.text: supplied from a generator, batteries or a combination thereof,
equipped with audible and visible trouble indicators,
capable of operating the trouble indicators for not less than 24 h (metric),

capable of operating the ventilation system under full load
for not less than 2 h (metric), and

designed so that, in the event of a failure of the normal power
source to the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building, there is
an immediate automatic transfer to emergency power.

content.text:
Where a fuel-fired engine or turbine for the emergency power
supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art3.sent2:short] is dependent
on a fuel supply located outside the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building, the fuel supply shall be provided with a shut-off valve in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art7:long]

Where exhaust piping for the emergency power supply required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art3.sent2:short] penetrates a required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, the piping shall be enclosed
in a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space that is separated from
the remainder of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building by
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than that
of the penetrated [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, but
not less than 45 min (metric).

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent2:short], welding and cutting operations shall be carried out in a room
conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art26.sent1:long]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote12:short].)

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1:short] need not apply to [REF:term:grc-ccp]agricultural occupancies where the welding
and cutting operations do not present a fire or explosion hazard to
adjacent areas.

articles.title: Liquid Manure Storage Tanks and Piping Systems

content.text:
This Article does not apply to below-floor storage areas for
liquid manure.

Access covers for liquid manure storage tanks shall be designed
in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3:long] to support the imposed
loads.

Access covers for liquid manure storage tanks that weigh less
than 20 kg (metric) shall be equipped with locking devices.

Ladders shall not be installed on closed liquid manure storage
tanks.

Liquid manure storage tanks without a cover that are located
outdoors shall be surrounded by a permanent safety fence or wall that

clauses.text:
extends not less than 1.5 m (metric) above adjacent ground
level,
is adequately secured at ground level, and
has gates with latches.

content.text:
Where an access point for filling, agitation, emptying or a
similar operation is provided for a liquid manure storage tank described
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art5.sent5:short], a curb or barrier shall
be installed between the access point and the storage tank that is

clauses.text: not less than 450 mm (metric) high, or
of sufficient height to prevent unintended vehicle entry.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art6.sent2:short], where storage tanks for liquids capable of releasing hazardous
gases or vapours are connected to a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building by a piping system, a gas trap or valve shall be installed in the
piping system to prevent such gases or vapours from entering the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building.

Where storage tanks for liquid manure are connected to a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building by a piping system, a pull plug
is permitted to be installed in the piping system to prevent hazardous
gases and vapours from entering the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building.

The storage of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods in
packages or containers in [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings or parts of [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall comply
with [REF:external:nfc]Parts 3 and 4 of Division B of the 
                           [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc].

In addition to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art7:long], pesticide storage areas in [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall be designed in conformance with this Article.
Pesticide storage areas shall be

clauses.text:
ventilated with outdoor air in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2:long] by dedicated natural or mechanical means at
a rate sufficient to prevent the accumulation of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods classified as toxic or flammable gases,
accessible only from the outdoors, and
secured against unauthorized entry.

content.text: Floors of pesticide storage areas shall

clauses.text: be constructed of concrete or other impervious material,
not have a floor drain, and

be provided with a curb at the perimeter of the storage area
that is

subclauses.text:
designed to contain accidental spillage of the largest container
in the storage area, and
not less than 50 mm (metric) high.

content.text: Pesticide storage areas shall be separated from

clauses.text: food, feed and water supplies,
other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric), and
other [REF:term:bldng]buildings by a [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance not less than 6 m (metric).

content.text:
Except as otherwise provided in this Section, the structural
design of [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall conform
to Part 4. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote14:short].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent3:short], [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall be classified
in the Low Importance Category as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect2.art1.table1:long]

Liquid manure storage tanks shall be classified in the Normal
Importance Category as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect2.art1.table1:long]

In lieu of the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect2.art1:long],
a [REF:term:brfc-nvt]subsurface investigation of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building site is permitted to be carried
out by a suitably qualified person prior to or during construction.

subsections.title: Loads Due to Use and Occupancy

articles.title: Loads Supported on a Floor or Suspended from a Ceiling

content.text:
In addition to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art3:long], the specified [REF:term:lv-ld]live load supported on
a floor or suspended from a ceiling shall be not less than the applicable
value listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect2.art1.table1:long]

content.title: Minimum Specified Live Loads on a Floor or Ceiling

header_rows.content:
Minimum Specified [REF:term:lv-ld]Live
Load on Area of Floor or Ceiling, kPa

Minimum Specified [REF:term:lv-ld]Live
Load on Floor Slats, kN/m

content.text:
Areas designed for the accumulation of poultry manure, such
as solid floors and dropping pits under a wire floor, slotted floor
or cage, shall be designed for a specified [REF:term:lv-ld]live
load of not less than 1 kPa (metric) for each 100
mm (metric) depth of manure.

Where machinery or vehicles not exceeding 1 000 kg (metric) in gross weight are used for manure clean-out in a poultry barn,
the barn floor shall be designed for a specified two-wheel [REF:term:lv-ld]live load of not less than 6 kN (metric) in
addition to the specified [REF:term:lv-ld]live load prescribed
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect2.art2.sent1:short].

Floors supporting stored products shall be designed for the
specified [REF:term:lv-ld]live load due to their intended
use and [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, but not for less than 5 kPa (metric). (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote15:short].)

The specified uniformly distributed [REF:term:lv-ld]live
load on an area of floor used for farm machinery or vehicles
shall be

clauses.text: for farm machinery and vehicles not exceeding 4 000 kg (metric) in gross weight, not less than 2.4 kPa (metric),

for farm machinery and vehicles exceeding 4 000 kg (metric) but not exceeding 9 000 kg (metric) in gross weight, not less
than 6 kPa (metric), and
for farm machinery and vehicles exceeding 9 000 kg (metric) in gross weight, not less than 12 kPa (metric).

content.text:
The specified [REF:term:lv-ld]live load due to possible
concentrations of load resulting from the use of an area of floor
for farm machinery or vehicles shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art9:long]

Where an area of floor is used for processing or for loading
or unloading of vehicles, the minimum specified [REF:term:lv-ld]live loads prescribed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent2:short] shall be increased by 50% for the area.

Tops of liquid manure storage tanks that are accessible to vehicular
traffic or used as a floor in a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building shall be designed for the loads due to their intended use and [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

Tops of liquid manure storage tanks that are located outdoors
but not exposed to vehicular traffic shall be designed for the [REF:term:dd-ld]dead load plus the snow and rain loads prescribed
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect6:long] or for the [REF:term:dd-ld]dead load plus 2 kPa (metric), whichever produces the
most critical effect.

Walls and partitions of liquid manure storage tanks shall be
designed for

clauses.text:
an internal lateral pressure based on an equivalent fluid density
of 10 kN/m3
                               (metric) for liquid manure, and
the anticipated internal lateral ice pressure.

content.text:
Vertical external walls of liquid manure storage tanks located
below ground level shall be designed for

clauses.text:
the anticipated lateral earth pressure, which shall not be used
to reduce the effects of the internal lateral pressures specified
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent3:short] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote17:short]), and

a lateral surcharge load of 5 kPa (metric), applied uniformly
below ground level, where earth within 1.5 m (metric) of the walls
is subject to vehicular loads.

content.text:
Concrete used for liquid manure storage tanks shall conform
to the appropriate exposure class of [REF:standard:csaa23.1]

Liquid manure storage tank walls, bases and appurtenances, including
piping for the conveyance of liquid manure and associated connections
and joints, shall be designed and constructed to minimize leakage
of liquid manure. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote18:short].)

For unobstructed slippery roofs of [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm
buildings with a roof slope, α, greater than 15° (metric) but not greater than 60° (metric) from the horizontal, where
snow and ice can slide completely off the roof, the slope factor,
C_{s} shall be calculated as follows:[EQ:display:](See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote19:short].)

content.text:
In a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building classified
as a Group G, Division 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy where heating and drainage systems are installed to prevent the
accumulation of snow and water, the supporting structure for the light-transmitting
roof areas is permitted to be designed for a specified roof snow load
of not less than 1 kPa (metric), provided

clauses.text:
the heating system is capable of maintaining a minimum interior
temperature of 10°C (metric) throughout the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building, and
an emergency power supply is provided that

subclauses.text:
is supplied from a power source such as batteries, a generator,
or a combination thereof, and

will continue to supply power to the heating system in the event
that the regular power supply to the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building is interrupted.

content.text:
[REF:term:frm-bldn]Farm buildings need not be designed
for loads due to earthquakes in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect8:long] where

clauses.text: the Seismic Category is SC1, or

the Seismic Category is SC2, and the R_{d}R_{o} value of the seismic force resisting system (SFRS) is equal to or
greater than 3.0 (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote21:short]).

content.text:
For the purpose of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect4.art1.sent1:short],
the Seismic Category is permitted to be determined on the basis of
I_{E}S(0.2) alone.

For the purpose of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect4.art1.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect4.art1.sent2:short], the Seismic Category is permitted to be determined by assigning
Site Class D without carrying out a [REF:term:brfc-nvt]subsurface
investigation.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect1.art1.sent2:short], and except as otherwise provided in this Section, systems and
equipment for heating, ventilating and air-conditioning services in [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings shall conform to Part 6.

[REF:term:frm-bldn]Farm buildings need not comply
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect4.subsect1.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect2.art8.sent3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect2.art10.sent13:long].

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent2:short], the rates at which outdoor air is supplied in [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings by ventilation systems shall be in accordance
with good engineering practice as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect2.subsect1.art1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote22:short].)

Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm buildings containing a Group G, Division
4 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent1:short].

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art2.sent2:short], where a fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliance is installed
in a [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building containing a Group
G, Division 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, separate
combustion air and [REF:term:fl]flue systems shall be provided.

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art2.sent1:short] need not apply where
the fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliance

clauses.text:
is specifically designed as a generator of carbon dioxide for
enrichment of the atmosphere in the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building, and
conforms to [REF:standard:csab149.1]

content.text:
This Article applies to controlled-atmosphere storage areas
that, during storage periods, contain an atmosphere with an oxygen
content less than 19.5% or more than 23% by volume.

During storage periods, controlled-atmosphere storage areas
need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent1:long].

Prior to a controlled-atmosphere storage area being accessed
after a storage period and while the storage area is accessible between
storage periods, the ventilation system of the storage area shall

clauses.text:
supply outdoor air to the storage area at a rate in accordance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art1.sent1:long], and

ensure that the atmosphere in the storage area has an oxygen
content not less than 19.5% and not more than 23% by volume.

content.text:
A warning sign shall be provided at each entrance to a controlled-atmosphere
storage area in accordance with [REF:external:nfc]Sentence 2.14.2.1.(5)
of Division B of the
                           [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc].

Where an enclosed tower silo, horizontal silo, or grain storage
bin is connected to an adjacent feed room, mechanical exhaust ventilation
shall be provided to remove air from the lowest floor level of the
feed room to the outdoors at a rate not less than 3 air changes
per hour (metric).

The ventilation system of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building in which the feed room referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent1:short] is located shall be designed to prevent airflow from
the feed room to any other part of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building.
Enclosed horizontal silos shall be ventilated by

clauses.text:
openings at roof or eave level with an area not less than 1%
of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area of the silo that consist
of

subclauses.text: a continuous ridge opening,
openings in both gable ends, or
openings in the eaves on each side of the roof, and

clauses.text: openings at floor level with an area not less than 1% of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area of the silo (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote25:short]).

content.text:
[REF:term:frm-bldn]Farm buildings housing livestock
with below-floor storage of liquid manure shall be provided with a
ventilation system that supplies outdoor air at a rate that is

clauses.text:
sufficient to limit the concentrations of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods classified as flammable gases to not more
than 25% of their lower explosive limit,

sufficient to limit the concentrations of [REF:term:dngr-gd] dangerous goods classified as toxic gases to those permitted
in the applicable provincial or territorial regulations or municipal
bylaws or, in the absence of such regulations or bylaws, in the ACGIH's [REF:standard:acgih-iv-mrp] and
not less than 2 air changes per hour (metric).

content.text:
Fuel-fired heating [REF:term:pplnc]appliances shall
be located and separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:frm-bldn]farm building in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art9:long]

For the purpose of compliance with this Code as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent1.clause2:long], the objectives and functional statements
attributed to the acceptable solutions in this Part shall be the objectives
and functional statements listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect5.subsect1.art1.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect3.appnote1:long].)

content.title:
Objectives and Functional Statements Attributed to the
Acceptable Solutions in Part 2

header_rows.content:
Functional
Statements and ObjectivesSee Parts
2 and 3 of Division A.

paragraphs.content:
Part 2
of the NBC contains specific requirements pertaining to farm buildings
because they have distinct characteristics compared to other types
of buildings: they have low occupant loads, are typically located
in rural settings, and house unique activities and contents. Part
2 does not apply to large farm buildings that do not qualify as having
“low human occupancy,” i.e., an occupant load of not more than 1 person (metric) per 40 m2
                      (metric) of
floor area.

The intent of Part 2 is to set forth measures to ensure the safety
of persons in farm buildings.

application_notes.title:
Major Occupancy Classifications
for Farm Buildings

paragraphs.content:
The following are
examples of the agricultural major occupancy classifications described
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect1.subsect4.art1.table1:long]:
                        
                           <bold>Group G, Division 1</bold>
                           
                              Farm buildings housing livestock with a below-floor storage
area for liquid manure
                              Feed mills
                              Grain elevators
                              Rooms for the bulk storage of dangerous goods classified
as flammable gases or compressed gases
                              Rooms for the bulk storage of flammable liquids
                              Rooms for the bulk storage of reactive materials
                           
                        
                        
                           <bold>Group G, Division 2</bold>
                           
                              Animal exercise facilities
                              Animal housing facilities, including, but not limited to,
facilities for livestock, facilities for alternative livestock and
game animals, facilities for fur-bearing animals, and facilities for
cultured fish and shellfish
                              Animal training facilities
                              Facilities for the packaging and processing of agricultural
products
                              Facilities for the production of plants and fungi, excluding
greenhouses
                              Farm workshops
                              Feed preparation centres
                              Feed storage facilities
                              Fruit and vegetable storage facilities
                              Grain, forage and feed structures
                              Milking facilities 
                              Storage facilities for farming equipment, implements and
machinery
                              Viniculture facilities
                           
                        
                        
                           <bold>Group G, Division 3</bold>
                           
                              Greenhouses
                           
                        
                        
                           <bold>Group G, Division 4</bold>
                           
                              Biomass facilities
                              By-product facilities
                              Digesters
                              Grain bins
                              Horizontal silos
                              Storage bins
                              Vertical silos

It is intended that portions of farm buildings that contain
permitted major occupancies other than agricultural major occupancies
be subject to the requirements of Part 3. Unless specifically referenced
in Part 2, the requirements of Part 3 are not intended to be applied
to portions of farm buildings meeting the criteria for the application
of Part 2 (see [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art5:long]
                     [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art6:long]).

The materials used in the construction of fire separations and closures
in farm buildings should be selected to minimize deterioration caused
by exposure to corrosive or humid environmental conditions.

application_notes.title:
Concealed Spaces Used as Supply
Air Plenums

paragraphs.content:
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art8.sent1:long] is not intended
to prohibit a concealed attic or roof space from being used as a supply
air plenum for the distribution of air through a porous ceiling or
ceiling inlets to the space below.

The protection required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect1.art15.sent2:long] is intended
to prevent rodents from damaging electrical wiring that is installed
in a concealed space, such as a space within an assembly, an attic
space, or a service space.

The intent of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent1:long] is that each floor
level be served by its own exits. This approach to providing exits
is consistent with that in Part 3.

Overhead doors and sliding doors are not permitted to be used
as exits from farm buildings with human occupants because such doors
could delay their egress.

application_notes.title:
Ventilation of Below-Floor Storage
Areas for Liquid Manure

paragraphs.content:
Where a farm building housing
livestock with a below-floor storage area for liquid manure is provided
with a ventilation system in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art3:long], the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent1:long]
                     [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent2:short] are considered
to be satisfied with respect to the fire and explosion hazard posed
by manure gases. Should other hazardous substances or conditions be
present in the farm building, the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent1:long]
                     [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent2:short] must be applied with respect to those
substances or conditions.

application_notes.title:
Below-Floor Storage Areas for Liquid
Manure

paragraphs.content:
The following are examples of manure-handling
equipment and systems that are not considered to be below-floor storage
areas for liquid manure:
                        gutters, pumps and pump chambers designed to be emptied
or flushed every few days
                        shallow gutters
                        gutters scraped with an alley scraper or stable cleaner
                        gutters equipped with a belt manure removal system
                        normally empty transfer gutters and pipes

The room referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1:long] is a space where
significant and regular welding and cutting operations are routinely
performed, such as a welding shop supporting the farm operation. [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1:long] is not intended to apply to occasional welding
and cutting operations, such as those carried out during repairs of
farm machinery.

Refer to [REF:external:nfc]Section 5.2. of Division B of
the 
                     [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc] for requirements relating to hot works, including cutting, welding,
soldering, brazing, grinding and adhesive bonding.

application_notes.title:
Liquids Capable of Releasing Hazardous
Gases or Vapours

paragraphs.content:
Examples of liquids that are capable
of releasing hazardous gases or vapours include liquid manure, wash
water from a milking facility, and waste water in a septic system.

Information on the design of bins and silos can be found in
the Commentary entitled Farm Buildings in the [REF:standard:nrcc-nbcug4]

specific weight, γ, of the products as follows:[EQ:display:] where
                        
                           γ

tables.title: Bulk Densities of Agricultural Products

body_rows.content:
Grains and
SeedsThe bulk densities of grains
listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote15.table1:long] are determined by filling a
small container with grain and weighing the filled container. If grain
is dropped from a distance into a bin, the bulk density may be up
to 5% higher than the listed density. If a grain spreader is used
to load the grain into the bin, the bulk density will be even higher
(but wall pressures in the bin will be more uniform and slightly lower).
Therefore, it is recommended that the listed density be multiplied
by a factor of 1.06 for grain stored in a bin.

application_notes.title:
Lateral Ice Pressure in Liquid
Manure Storage Tanks

paragraphs.content:
The lateral ice pressure in liquid
manure storage tanks in the Québec City region has been found to reach 50 kPa (metric) acting over an ice thickness of 0.5 m (metric).
The ice thickness, and therefore the lateral ice load, depends on
the geographic location. To calculate the lateral ice load for a particular
location, a lateral ice pressure of 50 kPa (metric) is applied
over the ice thickness expected in that location, which can be estimated
from the location's degree-days below 18°C (metric) listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixC.table2:long] of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixC:long] as follows: [EQ:display:]

application_notes.title:
Lateral Earth Pressure on Walls
of Liquid Manure Storage Tanks

paragraphs.content:
The lateral earth pressure
referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent4.clause1:long] should be based on the
equivalent fluid density of the earth surrounding the liquid manure
storage tank. Equivalent fluid densities for different types of soil
are listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote17.table1:long].

tables.title: Equivalent Fluid Densities for Soil

body_rows.content: Sand and gravel with fines, restricted permeability
Soft silts and clays, poorly drained

application_notes.title:
Design of Liquid Manure Storage
Tanks to Minimize Leakage

paragraphs.content:
In designing walls and bases
of liquid manure storage tanks to minimize leakage of liquid manure,
all factors that may influence the formation of cracks should be taken
into account, including thermal effects, concrete shrinkage, structural
movement, and material choice and installation. The control of crack
formation to minimize leakage is particularly important for reinforced
concrete structures to prevent corrosion of the reinforcing steel.

application_notes.title:
Reduced Snow Loads for Unobstructed
Slippery Roofs

paragraphs.content:
Research has shown that sloped roofs covered
with pre-painted steel have reduced snow loads relative to roofs covered
with asphalt shingles. [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] allows a reduction
of the slope factor, C_{s}, for unobstructed slippery roofs
of farm buildings where the roof slope, α, is greater than 15° but
not greater than 60°. [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.appnote19.figure1:long] shows the C_{s} versus α curve calculated in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect3.subsect3.art1.sent1:long].

Before using the reduced slope factor, the designer should carefully
examine the proposed roof configuration to ensure that snow will freely
slide off the roof. The reduced slope factor does not apply to sloped
roofs terminating at grade, at a roof valley, or at another roof of
lower slope because the snow may pile up or not slide freely at the
transition in slope. The reduced slope factor also does not apply
to roofs with obstructions, such as chimneys, silos or ice guards.
