application_notes.title:
Seismic Design of Above-Ground Liquid
Manure Storage Tanks

paragraphs.content:
Information on the seismic design
of above-ground liquid manure storage tanks can be found in the Commentary
entitled Farm Buildings in the [REF:standard:nrcc-nbcug4]

application_notes.title:
SFRSs for Farm Buildings in
Seismic Category SC2

paragraphs.content:
Information on SFRSs with RdRo ≥ 3.0 (metric) for farm buildings in Seismic
Category SC2 can be found in the Commentary entitled Farm Buildings
in the [REF:standard:nrcc-nbcug4]

Guidance on ventilation in farm animal housing and indoor plant agriculture
facilities can be found in the chapter entitled Environmental Controls
for Animals and Plants in the [REF:standard:ashr-hb-hvaca]

Controlled-atmosphere storage areas are typically used to preserve
fruits and vegetables, and are not intended to contain hazardous gases.

application_notes.title:
Gas Hazards in Enclosed Horizontal
Silos

paragraphs.content:
In enclosed horizontal silos, gases produced by
tractors during loading and unloading operations and by silage fermentation
present a hazard. Providing openings at both roof or eave level and
floor level in horizontal silos promotes airflow to remove these gases,
most of which are heavier than air.

application_notes.title:
Openings at Floor Level in Enclosed
Horizontal Silos

paragraphs.content:
The requirement of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent3.clause2:long] can be met by providing a single opening at floor
level, which may also serve as a tractor access opening.

The ventilation requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art5:long] are
intended to address the specific hazards due to manure gases in farm
buildings housing livestock with below-floor storage of liquid manure.
Where these requirements are met, it is not necessary to apply the
provisions of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art5:long]
                     [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art2:long] with respect to manure gases. However,
where the farm building contains other hazardous substances (air contaminants
or hazardous gases, dusts or liquids), the provisions of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art5:long]
                     [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art2:long] must be applied with respect to those substances.

The minimum ventilation rate required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1:long] is intended to limit the concentrations of flammable gases and
toxic gases produced by the decomposition of liquid manure. Higher
ventilation rates may be necessary to promote farm animal health and
production. Where requested by the authority having jurisdiction,
compliance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause1:long]
                     [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part2.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause2:short] can be demonstrated
through periodic in situ monitoring of gas concentrations or through
calculation of gas concentrations using a reliable method (such as
that described in the following publication: Massé, D.I., Croteau,
F., Patni, N.K. and Masse, L. Methane Emissions from Dairy Cow and
Swine Manure Slurries Stored at 10°C and 15°C. Canadian Biosystems

parts.title: Fire Protection, Occupant Safety and Accessibility

content.text: The scope of this Part shall be as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3:long].
Words that appear in italics are defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect4.subsect1.art2:long].

For the purposes of this Part, the term “storage tank” shall
mean a vessel for [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable liquids or [REF:term:cmbtbl-l]combustible liquids having a capacity of more
than 230 L (metric) and designed to be installed in a fixed location.

Information to be submitted regarding major components of fire
protection shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divC.part2.sect2.subsect3:long].

subsections.title:
Classification of Buildings or Parts of Buildings by Major
Occupancy

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art5:long], and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art7:long], every [REF:term:bldng]building or part thereof shall be classified according to its [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy as belonging to one of the Groups or Divisions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art1.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote3:short].)

A [REF:term:bldng]building intended for use by more
than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall be classified
according to all [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies for
which it is used or intended to be used.

content.title: Major Occupancy Classification

body_rows.content:
[REF:term:mbl-ccpn]Assembly occupancies intended for the production and viewing
of the performing arts
[REF:term:mbl-ccpn]Assembly occupancies not elsewhere classified in Group A

[REF:term:mbl-ccpn]Assembly occupancies in which occupants are gathered in the
open air

content.text:
Any [REF:term:bldng]building is deemed to be occupied
by a single [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, notwithstanding
its use for more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, provided that all [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies are classified
as belonging to the same Group classification or, where the Group
is divided into Divisions, as belonging to the same Division classification
described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art1.table1:long]

An arena-type [REF:term:bldng]building intended for
occasional use for trade shows and similar exhibition purposes shall
be classified as a Group A, Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote4:short].)

A police station with detention quarters is permitted to be
classified as a Group B, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy provided the station is not more than 1 [REF:term:tr]storey in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and 600 m2
                            (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-r]building area.

articles.title: Convalescent, Children's Custodial, and Residential Care Homes

content.text:
Convalescent homes and children's custodial homes are permitted
to be classified as [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancies within the application of Part 3, provided that occupants are ambulatory
and live as a single housekeeping unit in a [REF:term:t]suite with sleeping accommodation for not more than 10 persons.

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings or parts thereof used for
the storage of baled [REF:term:cmbtbl-fbr]combustible fibres shall be classified as [REF:term:mdm-hzrd]medium-hazard industrial
occupancies.

articles.title: Group A, Division 2, Low Occupant Load

content.text: A [REF:term:t]suite of Group A, Division 2 [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancy, except a child or infant daycare facility, is permitted to be classified as a Group D, [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and personal services occupancy provided

clauses.text: the number of persons in the [REF:term:t]suite does not exceed 30, and

except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art7.sent2:short], the [REF:term:t]suite is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not less than 1 h (metric).

content.text: The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art7.sent1:short] need not have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating where the [REF:term:t]suite is located in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

A permanent sign, with lettering not less than 50 mm (metric) high with a 12 mm (metric) stroke, indicating the lesser of the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load for the [REF:term:t]suite or 30 persons, shall be posted in a conspicuous location near the [REF:term:t]suite's principal entrance.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect3.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect3.art1.sent3:short], [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies  shall
be separated from adjoining [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies  by [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations having [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance ratings conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect3.art1.table1:long]

In a [REF:term:bldng]building not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, if not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units are contained together with a Group E [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy, the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between the
two [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies need not be more
than 1 h (metric).

In a [REF:term:bldng] building conforming to the
requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long], the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect3.art1.sent1:short] for [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations between [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies do not apply
at the vertical plane around the perimeter of an opening through the
horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

revisions.change_summary: Repealed and substituted Table 3.1.3.1 Major Occupancy Fire Separations

content.text:
No [REF:term:mjr-ccpn] major occupancy of Group F,
Division 1 shall be contained within a [REF:term:bldng]building with any [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy classified as Group
A, B or C.

Not more than one [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy shall be contained within
a [REF:term:bldng]building classified as a Group F, Division
2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy.

A [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction is permitted to be
constructed of [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible materials,
with or without [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible components.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote5:short].)

The [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating on any
exposed surface of foamed plastic insulation, and on any surface that
would be exposed by cutting through the insulation in any direction,
shall be not more than 500.

clauses.text:
by one of the interior finishes described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect29.subsect4:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect29.subsect9:long],

provided the [REF:term:bldng]building does not contain
a Group A, Group B or Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, by sheet metal

subclauses.text:
mechanically fastened to the supporting assembly independent
of the insulation,
not less than 0.38 mm (metric) thick, and
with a melting point not below 650°C (metric), or

clauses.text: by any thermal barrier that meets the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art15.sent2:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote8:short]).

content.text:
A walk-in cooler or freezer consisting of factory-assembled
wall, floor or ceiling panels containing foamed plastics is permitted
in a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction, provided the panels

clauses.text: are protected on both sides by sheet metal not less than 0.38 mm (metric) thick having a melting point not less than 650°C,
do not contain an air space, and

when a sample panel with an assembled joint typical of field
installation is subjected to the applicable test described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect12:long], have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating not more than that permitted for the space in which
they are located or the space that they bound, as applicable.

content.text:
The [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of doors
containing foamed plastics shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art2.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art2.sent3:short].

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art3.sent2:short], optical fibre cables and electrical wires and cables with [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible insulation, jackets or sheathes
that are installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted
to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction shall

clauses.text:
not convey flame or continue to burn for more than 1 min when
tested in conformance with the Vertical Flame Test (FT1 rating) in [REF:standard:csac22.2no.0.3] or
be located in

subclauses.text: totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote10:short]),
masonry walls,
concrete slabs, or
totally enclosed non-metallic raceways conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art23.sent1.clause2:long].

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art3.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art3.sent4:short], optical fibre cables and electrical wires and cables
with [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible insulation, jackets or
sheathes that are used for the transmission of voice, sound or data
and are installed in a [REF:term:plnm]plenum in a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction shall exhibit the following characteristics
when tested in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs102.4] (FT6 rating):

clauses.text: a horizontal flame distance of not more than 1.5 m, (metric)
an average optical smoke density of not more than 0.15, and
a peak optical smoke density of not more than 0.5.

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art3.sent4:short], where totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways are  used in a [REF:term:plnm]plenum, exposed
components of  wiring systems with [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible insulation,  jackets or sheathes, including optical fibre cables
and electrical  wires and cables that are used for the transmission
of voice, sound  or data, that are installed in the [REF:term:plnm]plenum or that extend  not more than 9 m (metric) from
the [REF:term:plnm]plenum, including drop down to the floor
level,  are permitted, provided they exhibit a vertical char of not
more than 1.5 m (metric) when tested in conformance with the Vertical
Flame Test  – Cables in Cable Trays (FT4 rating) in [REF:standard:csac22.2no.0.3]

Cables or wires within [REF:term:plnm]plenums that
are used for the transmission of signals in fire alarm systems need
not comply with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art3.sent2:short].

Totally enclosed non-metallic raceways used in a [REF:term:plnm]plenum in a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction shall meet the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art23.sent1.clause1:long].
If [REF:term:fr-rtrdn]fire-retardant-treated wood is specified in this Part, the wood shall

clauses.text:
be pressure impregnated with fire-retardant chemicals in conformance
with [REF:standard:csao80series] and

have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating not
more than 25.

content.text:
If [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction is
permitted and is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating more than 45 min (metric), [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction is permitted to be used.

If [REF:term:hv-tmbr-] heavy timber construction is
permitted, it shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art7:long]

Wood elements in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction shall be arranged in heavy solid masses and with essentially smooth
flat surfaces to avoid thin sections and sharp projections.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art7.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art7.sent6:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art7.sent12:short], the minimum dimensions of wood elements in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art7.table1:long]

content.title: Heavy Timber Dimensions

body_rows.content:
Arches
supported on the tops of walls or abutments

Arches
supported at or near the floor line

content.text:
Where splice plates are used at splices of roof arches supported
on the tops of walls or abutments, roof trusses, roof beams and roof
girders in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction, they shall be not less than 64 mm (metric) thick.
Floors in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction shall be of glued-laminated or solid sawn plank not less than

clauses.text: 64 mm (metric) thick, splined or tongued and grooved, or

38 mm (metric) wide and 89 mm (metric) deep set on edge
and well spiked together.

content.text: Floors in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction shall be laid

clauses.text:
so that no continuous line of end joints will occur except at
points of support, and covered with

subclauses.text: tongued and grooved flooring not less than 19 mm (metric) thick laid crosswise or diagonally, or

tongued and grooved phenolic-bonded plywood, strandboard or
waferboard not less than 12.5 mm (metric) thick, and

clauses.text:
not closer than 15 mm (metric) to the walls to provide for
expansion, with the gap covered at the top or bottom.

content.text:
Roofs in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction shall be of tongued and grooved phenolic-bonded plywood, strandboard
or waferboard not less than 28 mm (metric) thick, or glued-laminated
or solid sawn plank that is

clauses.text:
not less than 38 mm (metric) thick, splined or tongued and
grooved, or

not less than 38 mm (metric) wide and 64 mm (metric) deep set on edge and laid so that no continuous line of end joints
will occur except at the points of support.

content.text: Wood columns in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction shall be continuous or superimposed throughout all [REF:term:tr]storeys.

Superimposed wood columns in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber
construction shall be connected by

clauses.text: reinforced concrete or metal caps with brackets,
steel or iron caps with pintles and base plates, or

timber splice plates fastened to the columns by metal connectors
housed within the contact faces.

content.text:
Where beams and girders in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber
construction enter masonry, wall plates, boxes of the self-releasing
type or hangers shall be used.

Wood girders and beams in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber
construction shall be closely fitted to columns, and adjoining
ends shall be connected by ties or caps to transfer horizontal loads
across the joints.

In [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction,
intermediate wood beams used to support a floor shall be supported
on top of the girders or on metal hangers into which the ends of the
beams are closely fitted.

Roof arches supported on the top of walls or abutments, roof
trusses, roof beams and roof girders in [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy
timber construction are permitted to be not less than 64 mm
wide provided

clauses.text:
where two or more spaced members are used, the intervening spaces
are

subclauses.text: blocked solidly throughout, or
tightly closed by a continuous wood cover plate not less than 38 mm (metric) thick secured to the underside of the members, or

clauses.text: the underneath of the roof deck or sheathing is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art8.sent2:short], cladding on an exterior wall assembly of a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] shall consist of

clauses.text: [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible cladding, or

except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art8.sent4:short], a wall assembly that satisfies the criteria of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art5.sent1.clause2:long].

content.text: For [REF:term:bldng]buildings described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art8.sent1:short], [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible cladding representing up to 10% of the cladding on the face of an exterior wall facing a [REF:term:trt]street or access route shall be permitted, provided all portions of the [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible cladding are located not more than 15 m (metric) from a [REF:term:trt]street or access route conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art6:long], measured horizontally from the face of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

A wall assembly conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art8.sent1.clause2:medium] that includes [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible cladding made of [REF:term:fr-rtrdn]fire-retardant-treated wood shall be tested for fire exposure after the cladding has been subjected to the accelerated weathering test specified in [REF:standard:astmd2898]
Exterior wall assemblies constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:ex000109.7:long] of Appendix D are deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art8.sent1.clause2:medium].
Cladding described in this Article must also comply with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art7:long].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art1.sent4:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art24:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art4:number] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art16:number], a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building required
to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction shall be constructed with [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible materials. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13:long] for the requirements
regarding the [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of
interior finishes.)

Notwithstanding the definition of [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible materials stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect4.subsect1.art2:long], a
material is permitted to be used in [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible
construction provided that, when tested in accordance with [REF:standard:ulcs135] at a heat flux of 50 kW/m2
                            (metric),

clauses.text:
its average total heat release is not more than 3 MJ/m2
                               (metric),

its average total smoke extinction area is not more than 1.0 m2
                               (metric), and

the test duration is extended beyond the time stipulated in
the referenced standard until it is clear that there is no further
release of heat or smoke.

content.text:
If a material referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art1.sent2:short] consists of a number of discrete layers and testing
reveals that the surface layer or layers protect the underlying layers
such that complete combustion of the underlying layers does not occur,
the test shall be repeated by removing the outer layers sequentially
until all layers have been exposed during testing, or until complete
combustion has occurred.

The acceptance criteria for a material tested in accordance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art1.sent3:short] shall be based on the
cumulative emissions from all layers, which must not exceed the criteria
stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art1.sent2.clause1:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art1.sent2.clause2:short].

The following minor [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible components
are permitted in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to
be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction:

clauses.text: paint (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art1.sent2.clause2:long]),

self-adhesive tapes, mastics and caulking materials, including
foamed plastic air sealants, applied to provide a seal between the
major components of exterior wall construction, (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art3:long] for limits on the use of [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible materials in [REF:term:plnm]plenum spaces),
[REF:term:fr-tp]firestops and [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long],

tubing for pneumatic controls provided it has an outside diameter
of not more than 10 mm (metric),

adhesives, [REF:term:vpr-brrr]vapour barriers and
sheathing papers,
electrical outlet and junction boxes,

wood blocking intended
for the attachment of window elements within exterior wall assemblies,

wood blocking within wall assemblies intended for the attachment
of handrails, fixtures, and similar items mounted on the surface of
the wall, and
similar minor components.

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  roof covering that
has an A, B, or C classification determined in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect15:long] is permitted on a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction.

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  roof sheathing and
roof sheathing supports installed above a concrete deck are permitted

than 38 mm (metric) thick and [REF:term:prttn]partitions that contain wood framing are permitted to be used in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered  throughout, and
the [REF:term:prttn]partitions are not

subclauses.text: located in a [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:trtm]treatment or [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention occupancy,
installed as enclosures for [REF:term:xt]exits or [REF:term:vrtcl-rv] vertical service spaces, or
used to satisfy the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art1.sent1.clause1:long].

content.text:
Storage lockers in storage rooms are permitted to be constructed
of wood in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art3.sent1:long], [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible ducts, including [REF:term:plnm]plenums  and duct connectors, are permitted to
 be used in a [REF:term:bldng] building required to be
of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction  provided
these  ducts and duct connectors are used only in horizontal runs.

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  duct linings, duct
coverings, duct insulation, vibration isolation connectors, duct tape,
pipe insulation and pipe coverings are permitted to be used in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction provided they conform to the appropriate
requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5:long]

In a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible ducts need not comply with the requirements
 of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art1.sent2:short] provided the ducts are

clauses.text: part of a duct system conveying only ventilation air, and

contained entirely within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
 unit.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art2.sent1.clause4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art19.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art19.sent3:short], [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible piping and tubing and associated adhesives are
permitted to be used in a [REF:term:bldng]building required
to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction provided that, except when concealed in a wall or concrete floor
slab, they

clauses.text:
have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating not
more than 25, and

if used in a [REF:term:bldng]building described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long], have a smoke developed classification not
more than 50.

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible sprinkler piping is
permitted to be used within a [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered
                           [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13:long])

Polypropylene pipes and fittings are permitted to be used for
drain, waste and vent piping for the conveyance of highly corrosive
materials and for piping used to distribute distilled or dialyzed
water in laboratory and hospital facilities in a [REF:term:bldng] building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible
construction, provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,
the piping is not located in a vertical shaft, and

piping that penetrates a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation is sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation when
subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] with a pressure differential of 50 Pa (metric) between the exposed and unexposed sides, with the higher pressure
on the exposed side.

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible plumbing fixtures, including
wall and ceiling enclosures that form part of the plumbing fixture,
are permitted in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to
be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction provided
they are constructed of material having a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating and smoke developed classification not more than that
permitted for the wall surface of the room or space in which they
are installed.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art22:long], optical fibre cables and electrical
wires and cables with [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible insulation,
jackets or sheathes are permitted in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, provided

clauses.text:
the wires and cables exhibit a vertical char of not more than 1.5 m (metric) when tested in conformance with the Vertical Flame Test
– Cables in Cable Trays (FT4 rating) in [REF:standard:csac22.2no.0.3]
the wires and cables are located in

subclauses.text: totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote10:long]),
masonry walls,
concrete slabs,

a [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room separated from the
remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric), or
totally enclosed non-metallic raceways conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art23.sent1.clause2:long], or

clauses.text:
the wires and cables are communication cables used at the service
entry to a [REF:term:bldng]building and are not more than 3 m (metric) long.

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent4:short], optical fibre cables and electrical wires and cables
with [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible insulation, jackets or
sheathes that are used for the transmission of voice, sound or data
and are not located in totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways are permitted to be installed in a [REF:term:plnm]plenum in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, provided the
wires and cables exhibit a horizontal flame distance of not more than 1.5 m (metric), an average optical smoke density of not more than 0.15,
and a peak optical smoke density of not more than 0.5 when tested
in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs102.4] (FT6 rating).

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent4:short], where totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways are used in a [REF:term:plnm]plenum, exposed
components of wiring systems with [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible insulation, jackets or sheathes, including optical fibre cables
and electrical wires and cables that are used for the transmission
of voice, sound or data, that are installed in the [REF:term:plnm]plenum or that extend not more than 9 m (metric) from
the [REF:term:plnm]plenum including drop down to the floor
level, are permitted provided they exhibit a vertical char of not
more than 1.5 m (metric) when tested in conformance with the Vertical
Flame Test – Cables in Cable Trays (FT4 rating) in [REF:standard:csac22.2no.0.3]

Cables or wires within [REF:term:plnm]plenums that
are used for the transmission of signals in fire alarm systems need
not comply with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent3:short].

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible travelling cables are
permitted on elevating devices in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction.

Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art23.sent2:short], subject to the limits on the size of elements that penetrate [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations  when complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art2:long], within a [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment of a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, totally enclosed
non-metallic raceways not more than 175 mm (metric) in outside
diameter, or of an equivalent rectangular area, are permitted to be
used to enclose optical fibre cables and electrical wires and cables,
provided

clauses.text:
where the wires and cables in the raceways meet or exceed the
requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent1.clause1:long], the non-metallic raceways
meet the requirements for at least an FT4 rating in

subclauses.text: [REF:standard:csac22.2no.262] or
[REF:standard:ulcs143] and

clauses.text:
where the wires and cables in the raceways do not meet or exceed
the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art21.sent1.clause1:long], the non-metallic
raceways exhibit a vertical char of not more than 1.5 m (metric) when tested in conformance with the Vertical Flame Test (FT4) –
Conduit or Tubing on Cable Tray in [REF:external:csac22.2no.211.0]Clause 6.16 of

content.text:
Totally enclosed non-metallic raceways used in a [REF:term:plnm]plenum in a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction shall exhibit a horizontal flame distance of not more than 1.5 m (metric), an average optical smoke density of not more than 0.15,
and a peak optical smoke density of not more than 0.5 when tested
in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs102.4] (FT6 rating).

On [REF:term:bldng]buildings required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, decorative wood
cladding is permitted to be used on the exterior  fascias and soffits
of marquees or canopies on the [REF:term:bldng]building face of a [REF:term:tr]storey having direct access  to
a [REF:term:trt]street or access route,  provided the wood
cladding is [REF:term:fr-rtrdn]fire-retardant-treated  wood that has been conditioned in conformance with [REF:standard:astmd2898] before being tested in accordance
 with [REF:standard:ulcs102]
[REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]Encapsulated mass timber construction permitted in this Part shall conform to this Subsection.

Except as otherwise provided in this Part and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect4.subsect3.art1.sent1:long], materials used in a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be
of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass timber construction shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5:long]

Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art16:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19:long], a [REF:term:bldng]building or part
of a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass timber construction is
permitted to include structural mass timber elements, including beams,
columns, arches, and wall, floor and roof assemblies, provided they
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.sent3:short].
Structural mass timber elements referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text: except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.sent4:short], be arranged in heavy solid masses containing no concealed spaces,

have essentially smooth flat surfaces with no thin sections
or sharp projections, and

except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art17.sent1:long], conform to
the minimum dimensions stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.table1:long]

content.text:
Adhesives used in structural mass timber elements referred to
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.sent1:short] that are constructed of
cross‐laminated timber shall conform to the elevated temperature performance
requirements in [REF:standard:apaprg320]

Concealed spaces are permitted within structural mass timber
elements referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.sent2:short] and
need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art4.sent1:long], provided the concealed
spaces are

clauses.text:
[REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered and divided into compartments
by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11:long],

completely filled with rock or slag fibre insulation conforming
to [REF:standard:ulcs702] and
having a density not less than 32 kg/m3
                               (metric),

if horizontal, lined with not less than a single layer of 12.7 mm thick (metric) Type X gypsum board or [REF:term:cmbtbl]noncombustible material providing an [REF:term:ncps-rtng]encapsulation rating of not less than 25 min (metric),
or

if vertical, lined with not less than a single layer of 12.7 mm thick (metric) Type X gypsum board or [REF:term:cmbtbl]noncombustible material providing an [REF:term:ncps-rtng]encapsulation rating of not less than 25 min (metric) and
vertically divided into compartments by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire
blocks in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11:long]

articles.title:
Exposed Construction Materials and Components in Concealed
Spaces

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art16.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long], and except as otherwise provided
in this Subsection, only construction materials and components permitted
in [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]noncombustible construction shall
be permitted to have exposed surfaces in concealed spaces within floor,
roof, and wall assemblies in a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be
of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass timber construction.

Exposed surfaces are permitted in a concealed space created
by the attachment of a material or assembly of materials conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art4.sent1:long], provided the concealed space is not
more than 25 mm deep (metric).

The minimum dimensions stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art3.table1:long] need
not apply at cutouts in vertical or horizontal structural mass timber
elements where outlet boxes are installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art3:long] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote37:long].)

The exposed surfaces of the cutouts described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art17.sent1:short] need not be protected in accordance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art4.sent1:long].

Outlet boxes on opposite sides of a structural mass timber element
having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating shall
be separated by a distance of not less than 600 mm (metric).

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent4:short], and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art5:long], the rating of a material, assembly of materials or a structural member that is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, shall be determined on the basis of the results of tests conducted in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs101]

A material, assembly of materials or a structural member is
permitted to be assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating on the basis of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long].
A ceiling assembly is permitted to be assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating on the basis of Assembly Number R1 in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art3.table2:long].

A ceiling membrane is permitted to be assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating on the basis of Assembly Number M1 or M2 in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art3.table2:long].

The limit on the rise of temperature on the unexposed surface
of an assembly as required by the tests referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect7.art1.sent1:long] shall not apply to an exterior
wall that has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance of 1.2 m (metric) or more, provided correction is made for radiation from
the unexposed surface in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art1.sent9:long].

Floor, roof and ceiling assemblies shall be rated for exposure
to fire on the underside.

[REF:term:frwll]Firewalls and interior vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations shall be rated for exposure
to fire on each side.

Exterior walls shall be rated for exposure to fire from inside
the [REF:term:bldng]building.

The use of materials or assemblies having a greater [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating than required shall
impose no obligation to exceed in whole or in part the minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance ratings required by this Part.

and between walls at corners need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art3.sent2:short]

 with [REF:standard:nfpa80] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote28:long].)

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art8:long], a [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper having a [REF:term:fr-prtct]fire-protection rating conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent2:long] shall be installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10:long] in ducts or air-transfer openings that penetrate an assembly required
to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art9:long], a smoke damper
or a combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper shall
be installed in conformance  with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art11:long] in ducts
 or air-transfer openings that penetrate an assembly required to be
 a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, where the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire  separation

clauses.text: separates a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor,
contains an egress door referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent2:long],

occupancy, or
is installed to meet the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:long].

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art8.sent2:short], the requirement  for [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived
for

clauses.text: ducts that serve commercial cooking equipment (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long]),

continuous [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible ducts
 having a melting point above 760°C that penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent1:long] between [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly, [REF:term:mrcntl-c]mercantile, [REF:term:lw-hzrd-]low-hazard industrial, [REF:term:mdm-hzrd]medium-hazard industrial or [REF:term:hgh-hzrd]high-hazard industrial occupancy,
ducts or air-transfer openings that penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, or

[REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible ducts or air-transfer
 openings that penetrate a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating.

content.text:
The requirement for [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived
for [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible branch ducts having
a melting point above 760°C (metric) that  penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation,

clauses.text: provided the ducts

subclauses.text:
have a cross-sectional area not more than 0.013 m2
                                  (metric) and serve only air-conditioning units or combined
 air-conditioning and heating units discharging air not more than 1.2 m (metric) above the floor, or

extend not less than 500 mm (metric) inside [REF:term:xht-dct]exhaust duct risers that are under negative
 pressure and in which the airflow is upward as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art4:long], or

clauses.text:
where the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation separates
a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space from the remainder
 of the [REF:term:bldng]building, provided each individual
duct exhausts  directly to the outdoors at the top of the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art9.sent2:short], the requirement for smoke dampers or combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent2:long] is permitted to be waived for ducts

clauses.text: that serve commercial cooking equipment (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long]),
in which all inlet and outlet openings serve not more than one [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment, or

that penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:long] or in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:long], provided

subclauses.text: the movement of air is continuous, and

the configuration of the air-handling system prevents the recirculation
of exhaust or return air under fire emergency conditions.

content.text:
The requirement for smoke dampers or combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7.sent2:long] is permitted to be waived for [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible branch ducts having a melting point above 760°C (metric) that
penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation,

clauses.text: provided the ducts

subclauses.text:
have a cross-sectional area not more than 0.013 m2
                                  (metric) and serve only air-conditioning units or combined
 air-conditioning and heating units discharging air not more than 1.2 m (metric) above the floor,

extend not less than 500 mm (metric) inside [REF:term:xht-dct]exhaust duct risers that are under negative
pressure and in which the  airflow is upward as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3.art4:long], or

are required to function as part of a smoke control system,
 or

clauses.text:
where the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation separates
 a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space from the remainder
of the [REF:term:bldng]building, provided each individual
duct exhausts directly  to the outdoors at the top of the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical  service space.

content.text:
A [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper shall be installed
in the plane of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation so
as to stay in place should the duct become dislodged during a fire.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote31:short].)

A [REF:term:fr-dmpr] fire damper shall be arranged
so as to close automatically upon the operation of a fusible link
conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs505] or other
heat-actuated or smoke-actuated device.
A heat-actuated device referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10.sent2:short] shall

clauses.text:
be located where it is readily affected by an abnormal rise
in temperature in the duct, and

have a temperature rating approximately 30°C (metric) above
the maximum temperature that would exist in the system, whether it
is in operation or shut down.

content.text:
A [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper tested in the vertical
or horizontal position shall be installed in the position in which
it was tested.

A tightly fitted access door shall be installed for each [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper to provide access for the inspection
of the damper and the resetting of the release device. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote32:short].)

Where smoke dampers are used as a [REF:term:clr]closure in an  air-transfer opening, they shall be installed in the plane
of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Where combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers are used as  a [REF:term:clr]closure in a duct, they
shall be installed within 610 mm (metric) of the plane of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided  there is no inlet
or outlet opening between the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation and the damper.

Except as required by a smoke control system, smoke dampers
 and combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers shall
be configured  so as to close automatically upon a signal from an
adjacent [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector located as described
in [REF:standard:ulcs524] within 1.5
m (metric) horizontally  of the duct or air-transfer opening in the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation

clauses.text: on both sides of the air-transfer opening, or
in the duct downstream of the smoke damper or combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper.

content.text:
Smoke dampers or combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire
dampers shall be installed in the vertical or horizontal position
in which they were tested.

A tightly fitted access door shall be installed for each smoke
 damper and combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper to provide access  for their inspection and the resetting of the
release device. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote32:long].)

A door assembly having a [REF:term:fr-prtct]fire-protection
rating not less than 20 min (metric) is permitted to be
used as a [REF:term:clr]closure in

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation not required
to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating more
than 1 h (metric), located between

subclauses.text: a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor and a [REF:term:t]suite,
a corridor and adjacent sleeping rooms, or

a corridor and adjacent classrooms, offices and libraries in
Group A, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies, or

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation not required
to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating more
than 45 min (metric), located in a [REF:term:bldng]building not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height.

content.text:
The requirements for [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible sills and [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible floor coverings
in [REF:standard:nfpa80] do not apply to a door
described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent1:short].

A door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art12.sent1:short] shall
have clearances of not more than 6 mm (metric) at the bottom and
not more than 3 mm (metric) at the sides and top.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art13.sent2:short], every door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation,
other than doors to freight elevators and dumbwaiters, shall be equipped
with a self-closing device designed to return the door to the closed
position after each use.

A self-closing device need not be provided on a door that is
located between

clauses.text:
a classroom and a corridor providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access
to exit from the classroom in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not more than 3 storeys
                               (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,

a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor and an adjacent
room of [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and personal services occupancy in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not more than 3 storeys
                               (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height  provided the door is not located in a dead-end
portion of the corridor,

a patients' sleeping room and a corridor serving the patients'
sleeping room, provided the room and corridor are within a [REF:term:fr-cmprt] fire compartment in a hospital or nursing
home with [REF:term:trtm]treatment that complies with the
requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5:long], or

a patients' sleeping room and an adjacent room that serves the
patients' sleeping room, provided these rooms are within a [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment in a hospital or nursing
home with [REF:term:trtm]treatment that complies with the
requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5:long]

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10.sent2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art11.sent3:number],
a hold-open device is permitted to be used on a [REF:term:clr]closure  in a required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, other than on an [REF:term:xt]exit stair door in a [REF:term:bldng]building more than 3 storeys
                            (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and on a
door for a vestibule required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7:long], provided
the device is designed to release the [REF:term:clr]closure in conformance with this Article.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent5:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent6:short],  where the [REF:term:bldng]building is
provided with a fire alarm system,  a hold-open device permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:short] shall release

clauses.text:
in a single-stage system, upon any signal from the fire alarm
 system, and
in a 2-stage system,

subclauses.text:
upon any [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal from the
fire alarm system,  or

upon actuation of any adjacent [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke
detectors.

content.text:
Where the [REF:term:bldng]building is provided with
a fire alarm system, a hold-open device permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:short] shall release upon a signal from a [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector connected to the fire alarm
system and located as described in [REF:standard:ulcs524] where the hold-open device is used
on

clauses.text: an [REF:term:xt]exit door,
a door opening into a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor,
an egress door referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent2:long],
a [REF:term:clr]closure serving an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly, [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment, [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention, or [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy,

a door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:long],
or
a door required to function as part of a smoke control system.

content.text:
Where the [REF:term:bldng]building is not provided
with a fire  alarm system, a hold-open device permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent1:short] shall release upon a signal from a [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm located  on each side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation at ceiling level  within 1.5 m (metric) horizontally of the [REF:term:clr]closure opening in the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, where
the hold-open  device is used on [REF:term:clr]closures described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent3.clause1:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent3.clause5:short].

Where a hold-open device is used on [REF:term:clr]closures other  than those described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent4:short],  it is permitted to be released upon actuation of
a heat-actuated device.

A hold-open device used on a door located between a corridor
used by the public and an adjacent sleeping room in a [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancy need not release automatically
as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14.sent2:short].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5:long], a swing-type
door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation shall be equipped
with a positive latching mechanism designed to hold the door in the
closed position after each use.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art18:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19:long] for the
separation of [REF:term:xt]exits, an opening in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not more than 1 h (metric) is permitted
to be protected with fixed wired glass assemblies or glass blocks
installed in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa80] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17:long])

Wired glass assemblies permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent1:short] and described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] are permitted
to be used as [REF:term:clr]closures in vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations without being tested in accordance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4.sent1:long].

Glass blocks permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16.sent1:short] shall be installed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect3.subsect2:long] and reinforced with steel reinforcement in each horizontal joint.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art19:long], the maximum
temperature rise on the opaque portion of the unexposed side of a
door used as a [REF:term:clr]closure  in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation in a location shown in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art17.table1:long] shall conform to the Table when tested in conformance

rating shall be

clauses.text:

content.text:
