in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent6:short], penetrations of a [REF:term:frwll]firewall or a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation that is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2:long] shall be sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to the fire test
method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT
rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Except as
permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent6:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent7:short], penetrations of a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art2.sent2:long] shall be sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to the fire test
method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT
rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation of the assembly.

Sprinklers are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming part of an assembly
required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short], provided the annular
space created by the penetration of a fire sprinkler is covered by
a metal escutcheon plate in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13]

Unless specifically designed with a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop, [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers are permitted to penetrate
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming
part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short], provided the [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper is installed
in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa80]

Service equipment penetrations through a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] that are contained within
the cavity of a wall above and below the horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation are permitted to be sealed
at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that,
when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Service equipment penetrations through a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short] are permitted to be sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to the fire test
method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an F
rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided the
penetration

clauses.text:
is contained within the concealed space of a floor or ceiling
assembly having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating,
is located above a ceiling membrane that is a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, or

is contained within a [REF:term:hrzntl-r]horizontal service
space conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4:long] that is
directly above or below the floor.

content.text:
Ducts, electrical
outlet boxes, pipes, totally enclosed raceways, optical fibre cables,
electrical wires and cables, and other similar service equipment are
permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided they are
protected at the penetration with a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent1:long]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote37:short].)

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  totally enclosed raceways
that are embedded in a concrete floor slab are permitted in an assembly
required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided the concrete cover between the raceway and the bottom
of the slab is not less than 50 mm (metric).

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art3.sent3:short], outlet boxes are permitted to penetrate the membrane of an assembly
 required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided they  are sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that has  an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation when subjected to the fire
test  method in [REF:standard:ulcs115]

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible outlet boxes are permitted
to penetrate the membrane of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided they are
sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than
the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art1.sent3:short], [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible outlet boxes that
penetrate a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire  separation or a membrane forming part of an assembly required  to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art3.sent1:short], provided

clauses.text: they do not exceed

subclauses.text:
0.016 m2
                                  (metric) in area, and

an aggregate area of 0.065 m2
                                  (metric) in
 any 9.3 m2
                                  (metric) of surface area, and

clauses.text:
the annular space between the membrane and the [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible electrical outlet boxes does
not exceed 3 mm (metric).

content.text:
Outlet boxes on opposite sides of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating shall be separated by

clauses.text: a horizontal distance of not less than 600 mm (metric),
a [REF:term:fr-blk]fire block conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long], or

a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop installed on each outlet
box that has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115]

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible sprinkler piping is
permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation provided the [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments on
each side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  water distribution
piping is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation that is required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating, provided the piping is protected at the penetration
with a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4.clause1:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4.clause2:short].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent5:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent7:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent8:short],  [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible piping shall not be used in a drain, waste and
vent piping system if any part of that system penetrates

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required to have
a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, or
a membrane that forms part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating.

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  drain, waste and vent
piping is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating or a membrane that forms part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided

clauses.text:
except as provided
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4.clause2:short], the piping
is sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating  required for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115]

in [REF:term:bldng]buildings more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, the piping is
sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating required for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] with a pressure differential of 50 Pa (metric) between the exposed and unexposed sides, with the higher pressure
on the exposed side, and

the piping is not located in a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical
service space.

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible drain, waste and vent
piping is permitted on one side of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation provided it is not located in a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space.

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible piping for central vacuum
systems is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided the installation conforms to the requirements that apply
to [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible drain, waste and vent piping
specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent4:short].

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect9.art4.sent8:short], penetrations of a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation that incorporate transitions between [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible and [REF:term:cmbtbl]noncombustible drain, waste and
vent piping shall be sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating  required for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] with a pressure differential of 50 Pa (metric) between the exposed and unexposed sides, with the higher pressure
on the exposed side.

Transitions between vertical [REF:term:cmbtbl]noncombustible drain, waste and vent piping and [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible branches for drain, waste and vent piping are permitted on either
side of a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided they
are not located in a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote39:short].)
A ceiling assembly used as a [REF:term:plnm]plenum shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect4.art3:long]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art1.sent2:short], the connections and supports for structural framing members that
are connected to or supported on a [REF:term:frwll]firewall and have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating less
than that required for the [REF:term:frwll]firewall, shall
be designed so that the failure of the framing systems during a fire
will not affect the integrity of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall during the fire.

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art1.sent1:short] does not apply to a [REF:term:frwll]firewall consisting of two separate wall assemblies
each tied to its respective [REF:term:bldng] building frame
but not to each other, provided each wall assembly is

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having one half
of the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required
for the [REF:term:frwll]firewall by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent1:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent2:short], and

designed so that the collapse of one wall assembly will not
cause collapse of the other.

content.text:
A [REF:term:frwll]firewall is permitted to be supported
on the structural frame of a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction provided the supporting
frame has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than that required for the [REF:term:frwll]firewall.

Piping, ducts and totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways shall be installed so that their collapse will not cause
collapse of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall.

A [REF:term:frwll]firewall that separates a [REF:term:bldng]building or [REF:term:bldng]buildings with [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas containing a Group E
or a Group F, Division 1 or 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction having
a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 4 h (metric), except that where the upper portion of a [REF:term:frwll]firewall separates [REF:term:flr-r]floor
areas containing other than Group E or Group F, Division 1
or 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies, the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of the upper portion
of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall is permitted to be not
less than 2 h (metric).

A [REF:term:frwll]firewall  that separates a [REF:term:bldng]building  or [REF:term:bldng]buildings with [REF:term:flr-r] floor areas containing [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies other than Group E or Group
F, Division 1 or 2 shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-] noncombustible
construction having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating not less than 2 h (metric).

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art2.sent4:short], the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of a [REF:term:frwll]firewall, except for [REF:term:clr]closures, shall be provided by masonry or concrete.
A [REF:term:frwll]firewall permitted to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not more than 2 h (metric) need not be constructed of masonry or concrete, provided

clauses.text:
the assembly providing the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating is protected against damage that would compromise the
integrity of the assembly, and
the design conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art17:long]

content.text:
A [REF:term:frwll]firewall shall extend from the
ground continuously through, or adjacent to, all [REF:term:tr]storeys of a [REF:term:bldng]building or [REF:term:bldng]buildings so separated, except that a [REF:term:frwll]firewall located above a [REF:term:bmnt] basement
                           [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2:long] is permitted to commence at the floor assembly
immediately above the [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage.
(See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art1.sent3:long].)

A [REF:term:frwll]firewall is permitted to terminate
on the underside of a reinforced concrete roof slab, provided

clauses.text:
the roof slab on both sides of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less
than

subclauses.text:
1 h (metric) if the [REF:term:frwll]firewall is
required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 2 h (metric), or

2 h (metric) if the [REF:term:frwll]firewall is
required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 4 h (metric), and

clauses.text:
there are no concealed spaces within the roof slab in that portion
immediately above the [REF:term:frwll]firewall.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art4.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art3.sent2:long], a [REF:term:frwll]firewall shall extend above the roof
surface to form a parapet not less than

clauses.text: 150 mm (metric) high for a [REF:term:frwll]firewall required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than  2 h (metric), and
900 mm (metric) high for a [REF:term:frwll]firewall required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than  4 h (metric).

content.text:
A [REF:term:frwll]firewall that separates 2 [REF:term:bldng]buildings with roofs at different elevations
need not extend above the upper roof surface to form a parapet, provided
the difference in elevation between the roofs is more than 3
m (metric).

Openings in a [REF:term:frwll] firewall shall conform
to the size limits described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art6:long]

The aggregate width of openings in a [REF:term:frwll]firewall within a [REF:term:tr]storey shall be not more than 25%
of the entire length of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall.

The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14:long] shall apply
to the external walls of 2 [REF:term:bldng]buildings that
meet at a [REF:term:frwll]firewall at an angle less than 135° (metric).

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible material shall not extend
across the end of a [REF:term:frwll] firewall but is permitted
to extend across a roof above a [REF:term:frwll]firewall that is terminated in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art3.sent2:long].

If [REF:term:bldng]buildings  are separated by a [REF:term:frwll]firewall, [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible projections on the exterior of one [REF:term:bldng]building, including balconies, platforms, canopies, eave projections and
stairs, that extend outward beyond the end of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall, shall not be permitted within 2.4 m (metric) of [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible projections and window
or door openings of the adjacent [REF:term:bldng]building. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art6:long])

Concealed spaces in interior wall, ceiling and crawl spaces
shall be separated from concealed spaces in exterior walls and [REF:term:ttc-r-rf]attic or roof spaces by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art2.sent2:short], [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided to block off concealed spaces
within a wall assembly

clauses.text: at every floor level,

at every ceiling level where the ceiling forms part of an assembly
required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, and
so that the maximum horizontal dimension is not more than 20 m  (metric) and the maximum vertical dimension is not more than 3 m (metric).

content.text: [REF:term:fr-blk]Fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art2.sent1:short] are not required, provided

clauses.text: the wall space is filled with insulation,

the exposed construction materials and any insulation within
the wall space are [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible,

the exposed materials within the space, including insulation
but not including wiring, piping or similar services, have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating not more than 25 on any
exposed surface, or any surface that would be exposed by cutting through
the material in any direction, and [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks are installed so that the vertical distance between them is not
more than 10 m (metric), or

the insulated wall assembly contains not more than one concealed
air space, and the horizontal thickness of that air space is not more
than 25 mm (metric).

articles.title: Fire Blocks between Nailing and Supporting Elements

content.text:
In a [REF:term:bldng] building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, a concealed space
in which there is an exposed ceiling finish with a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating more than 25 shall be
provided with [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] between wood nailing elements so that the maximum
area of the concealed space is not more than 2 m2
                            (metric).

In a [REF:term:bldng] building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided in the concealed spaces created
by the wood members permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art10.sent2:long] so that
the maximum area of a concealed space is not more than 10 m 2
                            (metric).

In a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass timber construction,
a concealed space in which there is an exposed ceiling finish with
a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating more than 25 shall
be provided with [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] between wood nailing elements so that
the maximum area of the concealed space is not more than 2 m2
                            (metric). (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote41:short].)

In a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass timber construction, [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided in the concealed spaces created
by the wood members permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect6.art12.sent1:long] so that
the maximum area of a concealed space is not more than 10 m2
                            (metric).

articles.title: Fire Blocks between Vertical and Horizontal Spaces

content.text: [REF:term:fr-blk]Fire blocks conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] shall be provided

clauses.text:
at all interconnections between concealed vertical and horizontal
 spaces in interior coved ceilings, drop ceilings and soffits in which
 the exposed construction materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating more than 25, and

at the end of each run and at each floor level in concealed
 spaces between stair stringers in which the exposed construction
materials  within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating more than 25.

articles.title: Fire Blocks in Horizontal Concealed Spaces

content.text:
Except for crawl spaces conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art6.sent1:long] and as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art5.sent3:short], horizontal
concealed spaces within a floor assembly or roof assembly of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction, in which sprinklers
are not installed, shall be separated by construction conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] into compartments

clauses.text:
not more than 600 m2
                               (metric) in area with
no dimension more than 60 m (metric) if the exposed construction
materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating not more than 25, and

not more than 300 m2
                               (metric) in area with
no dimension more than 20 m (metric) if the exposed construction
materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating more than 25.

content.text:
A concealed space in an exterior cornice, a mansard-style roof,
a balcony or a canopy in which exposed construction materials within
the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating  more than 25, shall be separated by construction conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long]

clauses.text:
at locations where the concealed space extends across the ends
of required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations, and

so that the maximum dimension in the concealed space is not
more than 20 m (metric).

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art5.sent5:short], in [REF:term:bldng]buildings or parts thereof conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long], horizontal
concealed spaces within a floor assembly or roof assembly of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction shall be separated
by construction conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect11.art7:long] into compartments
that are

clauses.text:
not more than 600 m2
                               (metric) in area with
no dimension more than 60 m (metric), if the exposed construction
materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating not more than 25, and

not more than 300 m2
                               (metric) in area with
no dimension more than 20 m (metric), if the exposed construction
materials within the space have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread

subsections.title: Building Size and Construction Relative to Occupancy

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art3:long], a [REF:term:bldng]building shall be constructed in conformance
with this Subsection to prevent fire spread and collapse caused by
the effects of fire. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect3:long] for [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations  between [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies.)

A structure that cannot be identified with the characteristics
of a [REF:term:bldng]building in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] shall
be protected against fire spread and collapse in conformance with
good fire protection engineering practice.  (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote50:short].) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote94:long].)
Fire protection is not required for

clauses.text:
steel lintels above openings not more than 2 m (metric) wide
in [REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing walls and not more than 3 m (metric) wide in non-[REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing walls,

steel lintels above openings more than 2 m (metric) wide
in [REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing walls and more than 3 m (metric) wide in non-[REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing walls
provided the lintels are supported at intervals of not more than 2 m (metric) by structural members with the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating,

the bottom flanges of shelf angles and plates that are not a
part of the structural frame,

steel members for framework around elevator hoistway doorways,
steel for the support of elevator and dumbwaiter guides, counterweights
and other similar equipment, that are entirely enclosed in a hoistway
and are not a part of the structural frame of the [REF:term:bldng]building,

steel members of stairways and escalators that are not a part
of the structural frame of a [REF:term:bldng]building,

steel members of porches, exterior balconies, exterior stairways,
fire escapes, cornices, marquees and other similar appurtenances,
provided they are outside an exterior wall of a [REF:term:bldng]building, and

[REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing steel or concrete members
wholly or partly outside a [REF:term:bldng]building face
in a [REF:term:bldng] building not more than 4 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and classified as Group A, B, C, D or F, Division 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy provided the members are

subclauses.text:
not less than 1 m (metric) away from any [REF:term:nprtctd-] unprotected opening in an exterior wall,
or

shielded from heat radiation in the event of a fire within the [REF:term:bldng]building by construction that will provide the
same degree of protection that would be necessary if the member was
located inside the [REF:term:bldng]building, with the protection
extending on either side of the member a distance equal to the projection
of the member from the face of the wall.

content.text:
The requirements restricting fire spread and collapse for a [REF:term:bldng]building of a single [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy classification are provided in this Subsection according
to its [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and [REF:term:bldng-r]building area.

If a [REF:term:bldng] building contains more than
one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, classified in more
than one Group or Division, the requirements of this Subsection concerning [REF:term:bldng]building size and construction relative to [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall apply according to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art8:long]

In determining the fire safety requirements of a [REF:term:bldng]building in relation to each of the [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies contained therein, the [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and [REF:term:bldng-r]building area of the entire [REF:term:bldng]building shall be used.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art7:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art8:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48.sent4:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51.sent5:medium]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57.sent3:medium]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60.sent4:medium], in a [REF:term:bldng]building containing more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn] major occupancy, the requirements of this
Subsection for the most restricted [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy contained shall apply to the whole [REF:term:bldng]building.

less than 1 200 mm (metric) on either side of it, and shall apply
to all openings through the soffit within this limit.

of the [REF:term:ttc-r-rf]attic or roof space by the use
of [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks, the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art16.sent1:short] do not apply.
The protection required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art16.sent1:short] for projections is permitted to be omitted if

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments behind the
window and door openings are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long], and

all rooms, including closets and bathrooms, having openings
in the wall beneath the soffit are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, notwithstanding exceptions permitted in the standards referenced
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] for the installation of automatic sprinkler
systems.

articles.title: Canopy Protection for Vertically Separated Openings

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent3:short], if a [REF:term:tr]storey classified as
a Group E or Group F, Division
1 or 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy is required to
be separated from the [REF:term:tr]storey above by a [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation,

clauses.text: every opening in the exterior wall of the lower [REF:term:tr]storey  that is located vertically below an opening in the [REF:term:tr] storey above shall be separated from the [REF:term:tr]storey above by a canopy projecting not less than 1 m (metric) from the face of the [REF:term:bldng]building at the intervening floor level, and

the canopy required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent1.clause1:short] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than that required for the floor assembly but need not
be more than 1 h (metric), except as required elsewhere in this
Subsection.

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent3:short], the canopy required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent1:short] is permitted to be omitted if the exterior wall of the upper [REF:term:tr]storey is recessed not less than 1 m (metric) behind the exterior wall containing the opening in the lower [REF:term:tr]storey.

The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art17.sent2:short] are permitted to be waived if the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd] sprinklered throughout.

A covered vehicular passageway designed as a receiving or shipping
area shall be separated from every [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building adjoining it by
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1.5 h (metric).

A covered vehicular passageway constructed below [REF:term:grade]grade shall be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible
construction.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art20.sent2:long], if [REF:term:bldng] buildings are connected by a [REF:term:wlkw]walkway, each [REF:term:bldng]building shall be
separated from the [REF:term:wlkw] walkway by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min (metric).

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19.sent4:short], a [REF:term:wlkw]walkway connected to a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction shall also be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19.sent4:short], a [REF:term:wlkw]walkway connected to a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass
timber construction shall be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible
construction or [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass
timber construction.

A [REF:term:wlkw]walkway connected to a [REF:term:bldng]building required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction or to a [REF:term:bldng]building or part
of a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:ncps-mt-nstr]encapsulated mass timber construction is
permitted to be of [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction, provided

clauses.text:
not less than 50% of the area of any enclosing perimeter walls
is open to the outdoors, and
the [REF:term:wlkw]walkway is at ground level.

content.text:
A [REF:term:wlkw]walkway  of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction used only as a pedestrian thoroughfare
need not conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art14:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art15:long]
A [REF:term:wlkw]walkway between [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall be not more than 9 m (metric) wide.

An underground [REF:term:wlkw] walkway shall not
be designed or used for any purpose other than pedestrian travel unless

clauses.text:
the purpose is acceptable to the [REF:term:thrt-hvn]authority
having jurisdiction, and
sprinklers are installed in any space in the [REF:term:wlkw]walkway containing an [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

content.text:
[REF:term:bldng]Buildings connected by an underground [REF:term:wlkw]walkway shall be separated from the [REF:term:wlkw]walkway by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 1 h (metric).

An underground [REF:term:wlkw]walkway shall be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction suitable for an
underground location.
In an underground [REF:term:wlkw] walkway

clauses.text:
smoke barrier doors shall be installed at intervals of not more
than  100 m (metric), or

the travel distance from the door of an adjacent room or space
to the nearest [REF:term:xt]exit shall be not more than
one and a half times the least allowable travel distance to an [REF:term:xt]exit for any of the adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1:long].

content.text: An underground [REF:term:wlkw]walkway between [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall be not more than 9 m (metric) wide.

articles.title: Storage and Process Equipment Located Outdoors

content.text: Location of outdoor storage and outdoor process equipment in relation to [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall conform to Parts 3 and 4 of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code.

articles.title: Installation of Service Lines Under Buildings

content.text:
When a [REF:term:bldng]building is erected over existing
buried flammable gas mains, such service lines shall be encased in
gas-tight conduits in conformance with [REF:standard:csaz662]

articles.title: Determination of Requirement for a Fire Alarm System

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent3:short], a fire alarm system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng]buildings in which an automatic sprinkler system is required by this Part.

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings in which a sprinkler system
is installed in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13d] need
not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent1:short].

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings that contain fewer than
9 sprinklers conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:long] need not comply
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent1:short].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent5:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:number], a fire
alarm system  shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is  not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout
and that contains

clauses.text: a [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area,
an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-]impeded egress zone,

more than 3 storeys
                               (metric), including
 the [REF:term:tr] storeys below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey,

a total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than
 300, other than in open air seating areas,

an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 150
 above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey, other
 than in open air seating areas,
a school, college, or child care facility, including a daycare facility for children, with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 40,

a licensed beverage establishment or a licensed restaurant,
 with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 150,

a [REF:term:lw-hzrd-]low-hazard industrial occupancy with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 75
 above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey,

a [REF:term:mdm-hzrd]medium-hazard industrial  occupancy with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 75
above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey,

a [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy with sleeping
 accommodation for more than 10 persons (metric),

a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd]high-hazard industrial occupancy with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 25,
 or

an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 300
 below an open air seating area.

content.text:
A fire alarm system
is not required in a [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, where

clauses.text:
not more than 4 suites
                               (metric) share a common [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress, or
each [REF:term:t]suite has direct access to an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit facility leading to ground level.

content.text:
A fire alarm system is not required in a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] that
is contained in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered provided there are no other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies in the [REF:term:bldng]building.

revisions.text: A fire alarm system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng]buildings designed and constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10:long]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.1-2:long].)
revisions.change_summary: Added new sentence requiring fire alarm systems in buildings designed per Subsection 3.2.10.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent6:short], if there are openings through a [REF:term:frwll]firewall, other than those for piping, tubing, wiring and totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways, the requirements in
this Subsection shall apply to the [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas on both sides of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall as if they
were in the same [REF:term:bldng]building.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:short], if a [REF:term:bldng]building contains more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy and a fire alarm system is
required, a single system shall serve all [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:short], if a fire alarm system is required in any portion of a [REF:term:bldng]building, it shall be installed throughout the [REF:term:bldng]building.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent5:short], the requirements in this Subsection are permitted to be applied
to each portion of a [REF:term:bldng]building not more
than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building
height, in which a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 1 h (metric) separates the portion from the remainder
of the [REF:term:bldng]building as if it were a separate [REF:term:bldng]building, provided there are no openings through
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, other than those
for piping, tubing, wiring and totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways.

The permission in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art2.sent4:short] to
consider separated portions of a [REF:term:bldng]building as separate [REF:term:bldng]buildings does not apply
to [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms and storage rooms.

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings interconnected by [REF:term:wlkw]walkways permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art20:long] or by
vestibules provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:long] shall be treated as separate [REF:term:bldng]buildings for the purpose of fire alarm installation required by this Subsection.
A fire alarm system shall be

clauses.text: a single-stage system in a Group F, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy,
except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art3.sent1.clause3:short], a 2-stage system in a Group B [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy,

a single- or 2-stage system in a Group B, Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy where the [REF:term:bldng]building is 3 storeys
                               (metric) or less in [REF:term:bldng-hg] building height, and
a single- or 2-stage system in all other cases.

content.text:
A single stage fire alarm system shall, upon the operation of
any manual station, waterflow detecting device, or [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detector, cause an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal to sound on all audible signal devices in the
system. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote64:short].)
A 2-stage fire alarm system shall

clauses.text:
cause an [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal to sound
upon the operation of any manual station, waterflow detecting device,
or [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detector,

automatically cause an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal to sound if the [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal is not
acknowledged within 5 min (metric) of its initiation, and

have manual stations, each of which is equipped so that the
use of a key or other similar device causes an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal to sound that continues to sound upon removal
of the key or similar device from the manual station (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote65:short]).

content.text:
A 2-stage fire alarm system is permitted to be zone coded so
that, upon the operation of any manual station, waterflow detecting
device, or [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detector,

clauses.text:
a coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal is sounded
indicating the zone of alarm initiation,

the coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal is repeated
in its entirety not less than 4 times, and

a continuous [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal is sounded
upon completion of the coded signals referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent3.clause2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent4:short].

content.text:
If a second manual station, waterflow detecting device, or [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detector is operated in a fire alarm
system with zone coding as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent3:short], in a zone other than that for which the first [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal was sounded, the coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal for the first zone shall be completed
before the coded [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal for the
second zone is repeated not less than 4 times.

articles.title: Installation and Verification of Fire Alarm Systems

content.text:
Fire alarm systems, including the voice communication capability
where provided, shall be installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs524]

Fire alarm systems shall be verified in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs537] to ensure they are operating
satisfactorily.

A fire alarm system shall be designed so that when an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal is actuated, it cannot be silenced
automatically before a period of time has elapsed that is not less
than

clauses.text: 5 min (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building not required to be equipped with an annunciator, and
20 min (metric) for any other [REF:term:bldng]building.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent8:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent3:short], a fire alarm system shall not incorporate
manual silencing switches other than those installed inside the fire
alarm control unit. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote67:short].)

A single stage fire alarm system installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancy that has an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than
300 shall be designed to notify the fire department, in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:short], that an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal has been initiated.

A fire alarm system that includes waterflow-indicating devices
shall be designed to notify the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:short] when an alarm is initiated.

A 2-stage fire alarm system shall be designed to notify the
fire department, in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:short], that an [REF:term:lrt-gnl] alert signal has been initiated.

Notification of the fire department, as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent3:short], shall be provided in
conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs561] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote68:short].)

Where a single stage fire alarm system is installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent1:short] does not
apply, a legible notice that is not easily removed shall be affixed
to the wall near each manual station stating

clauses.text:
that the fire department is to be notified in the event of a
fire emergency, and

the emergency telephone number for the municipality or for the
fire department (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote69:short]).

content.text:
Helicopter landing areas on roofs shall be provided with telephone
extensions or means to notify the fire department.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent5:short], an annunciator shall be installed in close proximity
to a [REF:term:bldng]building entrance that faces a [REF:term:trt]street or an access route for fire department vehicles
that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent1:long].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent6:short], the annunciator required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] shall have separate zone indication of the actuation of the alarm
initiating devices in each

clauses.text:
[REF:term:flr-r]floor area so that the area of coverage
for each zone in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd] sprinklered is not more than 2 000 m2
                               (metric),

[REF:term:flr-r]floor area so that the area of coverage
for each zone is neither

subclauses.text: more than one [REF:term:tr]storey, nor
more than the system area limits specified in [REF:standard:nfpa13]

clauses.text:
shaft required to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr] smoke
detectors,
air-handling system required to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr] smoke detectors,
fire extinguishing system required by [REF:standard:nfpa96]
[REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area,
[REF:term:mpdd-gr-]impeded egress zone, and
[REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:long].

content.text:
An annunciator need not be provided for a fire alarm system
if not more than one zone indicator is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2:short].

If an annunciator is not installed as part of a fire alarm system
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:short], a visible
and audible trouble signal device shall be provided inside the main
entrance of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] are
waived in a [REF:term:bldng]building

clauses.text: in which an automatic sprinkler system is not installed,

that has an aggregate area for all [REF:term:tr]storeys of not more than 2 000 m2
                               (metric), and
that is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height.

content.text:
The area limits of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2.clause1:medium] are waived for an interior undivided open space used as an arena,
a rink, or a swimming pool provided that other spaces in the [REF:term:bldng]building  that are separated from the open space
are individually zoned in accordance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2:short].

A fire alarm control unit installed in close proximity to a [REF:term:bldng]building entrance that faces a [REF:term:trt]street or an access route for fire department vehicles that
complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent1:long] is deemed to satisfy the
requirement for an annunciator, provided all indicators required for
an annunciator or trouble signal device are included on the control
unit.
Electrical supervision shall be provided for a fire alarm system.

If a fire alarm system in a [REF:term:bldng]building is required to have an annunciator by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent1:long], except for hose valves, all valves controlling water supplies
in a standpipe system shall be equipped with an electrically supervised
switch for transmitting a trouble signal to the annunciator in the
event of movement of the valve handle.

An automatic sprinkler system shall be electrically supervised
to indicate a supervisory signal on the [REF:term:bldng]building fire alarm system annunciator for each of the following:

clauses.text:
movement of a valve handle that controls the supply of water
to sprinklers,

loss of excess water pressure required to prevent false alarms
in a wet pipe system,
loss of air pressure in a dry pipe system,
loss of air pressure in a pressure tank,

a significant change in water level in any water storage container
used for firefighting purposes,
loss of power to any automatically starting fire pump (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote71:short]), and

a temperature approaching the freezing point in any dry pipe
valve enclosure or water storage container used for firefighting purposes.

content.text: A fire pump shall be electrically supervised as stipulated in [REF:standard:nfpa20]

Heat-tracing cables installed on standpipe risers and sprinkler
lines shall be electrically supervised by the fire alarm system for
loss of power.

Indication of a supervisory signal in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent5:short] shall be transmitted to the fire department
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:long].

[REF:term:fr-dtctr]Fire detectors required by this
Code shall be connected to the fire alarm system.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10.sent3:short], if a fire alarm system is required in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detectors shall be installed in the following
spaces:

clauses.text: storage rooms not within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units,
[REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms not within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units,
janitors' rooms,

rooms in which hazardous substances are to be used or stored
(see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote125:long]),
elevator hoistways and dumbwaiter shafts, and
laundry rooms in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy, but not those within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units.

content.text: [REF:term:fr-dtctr]Fire detectors required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10.sent2:short] need not be provided within [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas that are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

[REF:term:fr-dtctr]Fire detectors required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10.sent2:short] shall be installed in elevator hoistways
and dumbwaiter shafts where a sprinkler system is not installed within
the hoistway or shaft.
If a fire alarm system is installed, [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors shall be installed in

clauses.text:
except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent2:short], each sleeping room and each corridor serving as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from sleeping rooms in portions
of a [REF:term:bldng] building classified as a Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy,
each room in a [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area and corridors serving those rooms,

each corridor in portions of a [REF:term:bldng]building classified as a Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy,

each [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor in portions
of a [REF:term:bldng]building classified as a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy,

each [REF:term:xt]exit stair shaft other than those
serving only a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy or an open [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage,
the vicinity of draft stops required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art6:long], and
elevator machine rooms.

content.text:
[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors need not be installed
in sleeping rooms and in corridors serving the sleeping rooms within
a [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy where [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms are installed in
accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long]

[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors required in the
sleeping rooms of a [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment or [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention
occupancy shall, upon actuation, provide an audible and visible
signal to staff serving those rooms so that the room or location containing
the actuated [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector can be easily
identified. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote73:short].)

[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent1.clause7:medium] shall, upon actuation, recall the
elevators served by the elevator machine room in which the [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector is installed.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent6:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent7:short], [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors installed
in [REF:term:bldng]buildings required to be equipped with
a fire alarm system shall be located near the entrance to [REF:term:wlkw]walkways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art19:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art20:long] or vestibules
provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:long]

[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors installed at the
entrance to the [REF:term:wlkw]walkways in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14:long] shall be deemed to meet the requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent5:short].

[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11.sent5:short] may be replaced with [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detectors in Group F [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies where the [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors may be subjected to false alarms due to the activities within the [REF:term:bldng]building.

If a fire alarm system is installed, an air-handling system
shall be designed to prevent the circulation of smoke upon a signal
from a duct-type [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector  if
the air-handling system

clauses.text: serves more than one [REF:term:tr]storey,
serves more than one [REF:term:t]suite in a [REF:term:tr] storey, or
serves more than one [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:long].

content.text:
A central vacuum cleaning system in a [REF:term:bldng]building equipped with a fire alarm system shall be designed to shut down
upon actuation of the fire alarm system.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art14.sent3:short], in a [REF:term:bldng]building having elevators that
serve [REF:term:tr]storeys above the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey and that are equipped with an automatic emergency
recall feature, [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors shall
be installed in the elevator lobbies on the recall level so that when
these [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors are actuated,
the elevators will automatically return directly to an alternate floor
level.
[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art14.sent1:short] shall be designed as part of the [REF:term:bldng]building fire alarm system.

The alternate floor recall feature required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art14.sent1:short] is not required if the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area containing the recall level is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

An automatic sprinkler system shall be equipped with waterflow
detecting devices and, if an annunciator is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8:long], shall be installed so that each device serves

clauses.text: not more than one [REF:term:tr]storey, and

except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8.sent2:short], an area on each [REF:term:tr]storey that is not more than the system area limits as specified in [REF:standard:nfpa13]

content.text:
Waterflow-detecting devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art15.sent1:short] shall be connected to the fire alarm system so that,
upon its actuation, an [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal or
an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal is initiated.

The actuation of each waterflow detecting device required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art15.sent1:short] shall be indicated separately on the
fire alarm system annunciator.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent3:short], where a fire alarm system is installed, a manual station shall be installed in every [REF:term:flr-r]floor area near

clauses.text: every principal entrance to the [REF:term:bldng]building, and
every required [REF:term:xt]exit, and
every other egress facility that has been designed and identified as an [REF:term:xt]exit and has all the features of a required [REF:term:xt]exit.

content.text:
In a [REF:term:bldng]building that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, a manual station is
not required at an exterior egress doorway from a [REF:term:t]suite that does not lead to an interior shared [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress in a hotel or motel not more
than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building
height, provided each [REF:term:t]suite is served
by an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit facility leading directly
to ground level.

In a [REF:term:bldng]building that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, a manual station is
not required at an exterior egress doorway from a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit that does not lead to an interior shared [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress in a [REF:term:bldng]building not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height containing only [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, provided each [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is served by an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit facility leading directly to ground level.

In a [REF:term:bldng]building referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art16.sent3:short], manual stations shall be installed near doorways leading
from shared interior corridors to the exterior.

Where a fire alarm system is installed, a manually operated
fire alarm station shall be installed on the roof at each [REF:term:xt]exit from a helicopter landing area.

In a 2-stage fire alarm system described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art4.sent2:long], the same audible signal devices are permitted
to be used to sound the [REF:term:lrt-gnl] alert signals and the [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals.

If audible signal devices with voice reproduction capabilities
are intended for paging and similar voice message use, other than
during a fire emergency, they shall be installed so that [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signals and [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm
signals take priority over all other signals.

Audible signal devices forming part of a fire alarm or voice
communication system shall not be used for playing music or background
noise.
Audible signal devices forming part of a fire alarm system shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building so that

clauses.text: [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals are clearly audible throughout the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area and throughout any [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy on a roof, and

[REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signals are clearly audible in continuously staffed locations, and where there are no continuously staffed locations, throughout the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area and throughout any [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy on a roof.

content.text:
The sound pattern of an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal shall conform to the temporal pattern defined in[REF:external:iso8201] Clause 4.2 of 
                           [REF:standard:iso8201] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote77:short].)

The sound patterns of [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signals shall be significantly different from the temporal patterns of [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote78:short].)

The fire [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal sound pressure
level shall be not more than 110 dBA (metric) in any normally
occupied area. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote79:short].)

The sound pressure level in a sleeping room from a fire alarm
audible signal device shall be not less than 75 dBA (metric) in
a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy when any intervening
doors between the device and the sleeping room are closed. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote80:short].)

Audible signal devices in sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy shall emit a low frequency signal.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote81:short].)

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent5:short], the sound pressure level from a fire alarm system's audible
signal device within a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall
be not less than 10 dBA (metric) above the ambient noise level
and not less than 65 dBA (metric)  when any intervening doors between the device and
the rest of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area are closed.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent12:short], audible signal devices located within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit shall include a means for them to be manually
silenced for a period of not more than 10 min (metric), after
which time the devices shall restore themselves to normal operation.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote82:short].)

Audible signal devices within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
unit or a [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy shall
be connected to the fire alarm system

clauses.text:
in a manner such that a single open circuit at one device will
not impair the operation of other audible signal devices on that same
circuit that serve the other [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units or [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy, or

on separate signal circuits that are not connected to the devices
in any other [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy.

content.text:
In a [REF:term:bldng]building or part thereof classified
as a [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy,

clauses.text:
separate circuits shall be provided for audible signal devices
on each [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, and

audible signal devices within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
units or [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy shall
be wired on separate signal circuits from those not within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units or [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy.

content.text: Audible signal devices shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] and shall be connected to the fire alarm system.

Audible signal devices within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
units that are wired on separate signal circuits in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent9.clause2:medium] need not include a
means for manual signal silencing as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent8:short], provided the fire alarm system includes
a provision for an automatic signal silence within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, where

clauses.text: the automatic signal silence cannot occur within the first 60 s (metric) of operation or within the zone of initiation,
a subsequent alarm elsewhere in the [REF:term:bldng]building will reactuate the silenced audible signal devices within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units,

after a period of not more than 10 min (metric), the silenced
audible signal devices will be restored to continuous audible signal
if the alarm is not acknowledged, and

the voice communication systems referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art23:long] have a provision to override the automatic signal
silence to allow the transmission of voice messages through silenced
audible signal device circuits that serve the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units.

content.text:
If a 2-stage fire alarm system has been installed with an automatic
signal silence as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art18.sent12:short], the system shall be designed so that any silenced audible signal
devices serving [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units are reactuated
whenever an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal is required
to be transmitted as part of the second stage. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote82:long].)

Where a fire
alarm system is installed, visible signal devices shall be provided
in addition to [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal devices

clauses.text: in [REF:term:bldng]buildings or portions thereof intended for use primarily by persons who are deaf or hard of hearing,

in [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancies in which
music and other sounds associated with performances could exceed 100 dBA (metric),

in any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in which the ambient
noise level is more than 87 dBA (metric),
in any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in which the occupants

subclauses.text: use ear protection devices,
are located in an audiometric booth, or
are located in sound-insulating enclosures,

clauses.text:
in [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors serving a
Group B, C, D or E [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy,
in corridors used by the public serving a Group A [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy,

in not less than 10% of the [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy in a hotel or motel
(see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote84:short]), and
in washrooms, except those located within

subclauses.text:
[REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancy,
[REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy, or
patients' sleeping rooms.

content.text:
Visible signal devices are permitted to be installed in lieu
of audible signal devices in the compartments referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art6:long]

Visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1:short] shall be installed so that the signal from at least one device
is visible throughout the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area or
portion thereof in which they are installed. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote85:short].)
Visible signal devices shall be installed in the rooms and spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8:long] and shall

clauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent5:short] where a fire alarm system is provided,
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent6:short] where a fire alarm system is not provided,
have a luminous intensity of not less than

subclauses.text: 75 candela (metric), if the strobe light is located in a sleeping room or bed space, and
15 candela (metric), if the strobe light is not located in a sleeping room or bed space,

clauses.text: produce between 1 and 3 flashes per second, with the flashes synchronized when more than one strobe light is visible from a single location, and
be installed in each

subclauses.text: sleeping room or bed space,
room closed off from the living area by a door, including bathrooms, and
living area and any hallway serving the living area.

content.text: The visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent4:short] shall

clauses.text: consist of strobe lights conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs526] that are designed to operate as part of the fire alarm system, and
be located in conformance with the installation requirements for visible signal devices in [REF:standard:ulcs524].

content.text: Where a fire alarm system is not provided, the visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent4:short] shall

clauses.text: consist of strobe lights conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs526],
be connected to, and activated by,

subclauses.text: the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art19.art1:long], or

the [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art21:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art19.art8:long], and

clauses.text: be located not less than 2 100 mm (metric) above the floor on a wall or ceiling in a location that will maximize effectiveness.

content.text: Each adaptable [REF:term:dwllng-nt]dwelling unit shall be provided with special outlet boxes and cover plates that

clauses.text: are designed, located and wired specifically to allow strobe lights to operate in conformance with

subclauses.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent5:short] where a fire alarm system is provided, or
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent6:short] where a fire alarm system is not provided,

clauses.text: are permanently identified as "FIRE - Strobe Light Connection Only,"
are installed in the locations described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent4.clause5:medium], and

for the purposes of providing power to the strobe lights that may be connected to the outlet boxes, are assumed that the total special outlets for at least 20 percent of the adaptable [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units in the [REF:term:bldng]building are in use.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art21:long], [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms shall be installed in accordance
with this Article.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent5:short] and permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short], [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs531] shall be installed in each [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit and, except for [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment or [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention occupancies required to have a fire
alarm system, in each sleeping room not within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit or [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy.

At least one [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm shall be
installed on each [REF:term:tr]storey of a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit or [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy.
On any [REF:term:tr]storey of a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit containing sleeping rooms, a [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm shall be installed

clauses.text: in each sleeping room, and

in a location between the sleeping rooms and the remainder of
the [REF:term:tr]storey, and if the sleeping rooms are
served by a hallway, the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm shall
be located in the hallway.

content.text:
Where a [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy has individual [REF:term:t]suites for residents, a [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke
alarm shall be installed

clauses.text: in each sleeping room, and

in a location between the sleeping rooms and the remainder of
the [REF:term:t]suite, and if the sleeping rooms are served
by a corridor within the [REF:term:t]suite, the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm shall be located in the corridor.

content.text:
A [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm shall be installed
on or near the ceiling.

In hotels and motels with a fire alarm system, [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms installed in rooms required to
have a visible signal device connected to the fire alarm system as
specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1.clause7:long] shall have a visible signal
component installed in accordance with [REF:standard:ulcs524]

In hotels and motels without a fire alarm system, [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms installed in sleeping rooms of
not less than 10% of the [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy shall have a visible
signal component installed in accordance with [REF:standard:ulcs524] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote84:long].)
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short], [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms referred in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent2:short] shall

clauses.text:
be installed with permanent connections to an electrical circuit
(see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote86:short]),

have no disconnect switch between the overcurrent device and
the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm, and

except for the
visible signal component required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent7:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent8:short], in case the regular power supply to the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm is interrupted, be provided with
a battery as an alternative power source that can continue to provide
power to the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm for a period
of no less than 7 days in the normal condition, followed by 4 minutes (metric) of alarm.

content.text:
[REF:term:t]Suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancy are permitted to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms, provided the [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors

clauses.text: are capable of independently sounding audible signals with a sound pressure level between 75 dBA (metric) and 110 dBA (metric) within the individual [REF:term:t]suites (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote79:long]),
except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent11:short], are installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs524] and
form part of the fire alarm system.

content.text:
[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors permitted to be
installed in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms as stated
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short] are permitted to sound
localized alarms within individual [REF:term:t]suites,
and need not sound an alarm throughout the rest of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

If more than one [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm is
required in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms shall be interconnected so that the actuation
of one [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm will cause all [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms within the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit to sound.

A [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent2:short] shall be installed in conformance
