with [REF:standard:ulcs553]

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent15:short], a manually operated silencing device shall be incorporated within
the circuitry of a [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm installed
in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit so that it will silence
the signal emitted by the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm for
a period of not more than 10 min (metric), after which the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm will reset and again sound the alarm
if the level of smoke in the vicinity is sufficient to reactuate the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm.

[REF:term:t]Suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancy equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors installed to [REF:standard:ulcs524] as part of the fire alarm system in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent10:short], need not incorporate the manually
operated device required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent14:short]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote87:long].)
The sound patterns of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms shall

clauses.text: meet the temporal patterns of [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote77:long]), or
be a combination temporal pattern and voice relay.

content.text: Sleeping rooms and bed spaces provided in [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancies in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not equipped with a 2-stage fire alarm system shall be equipped with visible signal devices conforming to this Article. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art3.sent1.clause3:medium].)

Except where a fire alarm system is installed or required in
a [REF:term:bldng]building, [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke
detectors forming part of a residential fire warning system
installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs540] are permitted to be installed in lieu of all [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long], provided the system

clauses.text: is capable of sounding audible signals in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5:number],
is powered in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4:long], and
is provided with a silencing device in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6:long]

articles.title: Voice Communication Systems for High Buildings

content.text: A voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] shall

clauses.text:
consist of a two-way means of communication with the central
alarm and control facility and to the mechanical control centre from
each [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, and

be capable of broadcasting prerecorded, synthesized, or live
messages from the central alarm and control facility that are audible
and intelligible in all parts of the [REF:term:bldng]building, except that this requirement does not apply to elevator cars (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote88:short]).

content.text:
The voice communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1:short] shall include a means to silence the [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal in a single stage fire alarm system
while voice instructions are being transmitted, but only after the [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal has initially sounded for not
less than 30 s (metric).

The voice communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1:short] shall include a means to silence the [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal and the [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal in a 2-stage fire alarm system while voice instructions
are being transmitted, but only after the [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert
signal has initially sounded for not less than

clauses.text:
10 s (metric) in hospitals that have supervisory personnel
on duty for twenty-four hours each day, or
30 s (metric) for all other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies.

content.text:
The voice communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1.clause2:medium] shall be designed so that the [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal in a 2-stage fire alarm system
can be selectively transmitted to any zone or zones while maintaining
an [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal or selectively transmitting
voice instructions to any other zone or zones in the [REF:term:bldng]building.

The 2-way communication system referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent1.clause1:medium] shall be installed so that emergency
telephones are located in each [REF:term:flr-r]floor area near [REF:term:xt]exit stair shafts.

Visible signal devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8:long] shall continue to emit a visible signal while voice instructions are being transmitted.

Where the facility is not equipped with staff trained to provide
instructions over the loudspeakers, a pre-recorded message shall be
provided.

Except for Group B, Division 1 and Group F, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies, where a fire alarm system
is required under [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long], a one-way voice
communication system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng]buildings where a 2-stage fire alarm system is installed and whose [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load exceeds 1 000 (metric).

The one-way voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art23.sent1:short] shall consist of loudspeakers that
are

clauses.text:
operated from the central alarm and control facility or, in
the absence of such a facility, from a designated area, and

except in elevator cars, designed and located so that transmitted
messages are audible and intelligible in all parts of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

content.text:
Where the facility is not equipped with staff trained to provide
instructions over the loudspeakers, a pre-recorded message shall be
provided.

The one-way voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art23.sent1:short] shall meet the silencing and transmission
requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent6:short].

Except for [REF:term:tr] storeys below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey, direct access for firefighting
shall be provided from the outdoors to every [REF:term:tr]storey that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout
and whose floor level is less than 25 m (metric) above [REF:term:grade]grade, by at least one unobstructed window or
access panel for each 15 m (metric) of wall in each wall required
to face a [REF:term:trt]street by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long]
An opening for access required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art1.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text:
have a sill no higher than 900 mm (metric) above the inside
floor, and
be not less than 1 100 mm (metric) high by not less than

subclauses.text:
550 mm (metric) wide for a [REF:term:bldng]building not designed for the storage or use of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous
goods, or

750 mm (metric) wide for a [REF:term:bldng]building designed for the storage or use of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous
goods.

content.text:
Access panels above the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey shall be readily openable from both inside and outside, or the opening
shall be glazed with plain glass.

Direct access from at least one [REF:term:trt]street shall be provided from the outdoors in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered to each [REF:term:bmnt]basement having a horizontal dimension more than 25 m (metric).
The access required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art2.sent1:short] is permitted to be provided by

clauses.text:
doors, windows or other means that provide an opening not less
than 1 100 mm (metric) high and 550 mm (metric) wide, with
a sill no higher than 900 mm (metric) above the inside floor,
or
an interior stairway immediately accessible from the outdoors.

content.text:
On a [REF:term:bldng]building more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height where the slope of the roof is less than 1 in 4, all main roof areas
shall be provided with direct access from the [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas immediately below, either by

clauses.text: a stairway, or
a hatch not less than 550 mm (metric) by 900 mm (metric) with a fixed ladder.

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building  which is more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg] building height or more than 600 m2
                            (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-r]building area shall be provided with access
routes for fire department vehicles

clauses.text:
to the [REF:term:bldng-r]building face having a principal
entrance, and

to each [REF:term:bldng]building face having access
openings for firefighting as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art1:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art2:long]

content.text:
Access routes required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] shall
be located so that the principal entrance and every access opening
required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art2:long] are located not less than  3
m (metric) and not more than 15 m (metric) from the closest portion
of the access route required for fire department use, measured horizontally
from the face of the [REF:term:bldng]building.
Access routes shall be provided to a [REF:term:bldng]building so that

clauses.text:
for a [REF:term:bldng]building provided with a fire
department connection, a fire department pumper vehicle can be located
adjacent to the hydrants referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art15:long],

for a [REF:term:bldng]building not provided with
a fire department connection, a fire department pumper vehicle can
be located so that the length of the access route from a hydrant to
the vehicle plus the unobstructed path of travel for the firefighter
from the vehicle to the [REF:term:bldng]building is not
more than 90 m (metric), and

the unobstructed path of travel for the firefighter from the
vehicle to the [REF:term:bldng]building is not more than 45 m (metric).

content.text:
The unobstructed path of travel for the firefighter required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent2:short] from the vehicle to the [REF:term:bldng]building shall be measured from the vehicle to
the fire department connection provided for the [REF:term:bldng]building, except that if no fire department connection is
provided, the path of travel shall be measured to the principal entrance
of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

If a portion of a [REF:term:bldng]building is completely
cut off from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building so that there is no access to the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building, the access routes required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent2:short] shall be located so that the unobstructed
path of travel from the vehicle to one entrance of each portion of
the [REF:term:bldng]building is not more than 45
m (metric).

A portion of a roadway or yard provided as a required access
route for fire department use shall

clauses.text:
have a clear width not less than 6 m (metric), unless it
can be shown that lesser widths are satisfactory,
have a centre-line radius not less than 12 m (metric),
have an overhead clearance not less than 5 m (metric),

have a change of gradient not more than 1 in 12.5 over a minimum
distance of 15 m (metric),

be designed to support the expected loads imposed by firefighting
equipment and be surfaced with concrete, asphalt or other material
designed to permit accessibility under all climatic conditions,

have turnaround facilities for any dead-end portion of the access
route more than 90 m (metric) long, and
be connected with a public thoroughfare.

content.text:
For [REF:term:bldng]buildings conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long], no portion
of the access route described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art10.sent3:long] shall
be more than 20 m below the uppermost floor level.

Every [REF:term:bldng]building shall be provided
with an adequate water supply for firefighting. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote91:short].)

revisions.text: [REF:term:bldng]Buildings that are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout with a sprinkler system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] or have a standpipe system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10:long] are deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art7.sent1:short].

Except for [REF:term:bldng]buildings constructed of [REF:term:ncps-mss-tmbr]encapsulated mass timber construction in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long], [REF:term:bldng]buildings that are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout with a sprinkler system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long] or have a standpipe system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:long] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10:long] are deemed to comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art7.sent1:short].
revisions.change_summary: Added exemption for buildings constructed of encapsulated mass timber construction conforming to Articles 3.2.2.48, 3.2.2.57 or 3.2.2.93

content.text: Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8.sent2:short], a standpipe system shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is

clauses.text: more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,
more than 14 m (metric) high measured between [REF:term:grade] grade and the ceiling of the top [REF:term:tr]storey, or

not more than 14 m (metric) high measured between [REF:term:grade] grade and the ceiling of the top [REF:term:tr]storey but has a [REF:term:bldng-r]building area exceeding the area shown in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8.table1:long] for the
applicable [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height unless the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd] sprinklered throughout.

content.text: A standpipe system need not be installed in a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long], provided the [REF:term:bldng]building is not more than 15 m high (metric).

content.title: Building Limits without Standpipe Systems

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art9.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art9.sent5:short], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art11:long], and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent2:long],
the design, construction, installation and testing of a standpipe
system shall conform to [REF:standard:nfpa14]

A dry standpipe that is not connected to a water supply shall
not be considered as fulfilling the requirements of this Article.

If more than one standpipe is provided, the total water supply
need not be more than 30 L/s (metric).

The residual water pressure at the design flow rate at the topmost
hose connection of a standpipe system that is required to be installed
in a [REF:term:bldng] building is permitted to be less
than 690 kPa (metric) provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered  throughout,

the water supply at the base of the sprinkler riser is capable
of meeting, without a fire pump, the design flow rate and pressure
demand of the sprinkler system, including the inside and outside hose
allowance, and

fire protection equipment is available to deliver, by means
of the fire department connection, the full demand flow rate at a
residual water pressure of 690 kPa (metric) at the topmost hose
connection of the standpipe system (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote92:short]).

content.text:
A fire department connection shall be provided for every standpipe
system.
Hose connections shall be located in [REF:term:xt]exits, in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa14]
Hose connections are not required within a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area.

Hose connections shall be provided with sufficient clearance
to permit the use of a standard fire department hose key.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art10.sent5:short], 64 mm (metric) diam hose connections shall be installed in
a standpipe system.

Hose connections for 64 mm (metric) diam hose are not required
in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not more than 25 m (metric) high, measured between [REF:term:grade]grade and the ceiling level of the top [REF:term:tr]storey and
in which an automatic sprinkler system is not installed.

Hose stations for 38 mm (metric) diam hose shall be installed
for a standpipe system in a [REF:term:bldng]building that
is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

Hose stations for a 38 mm (metric) diam hose shall be installed
for a standpipe system within every [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote93:short].)

Hose stations shall be located in the [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area within 5 m (metric) of [REF:term:xt]exits and at other locations to provide coverage of the entire [REF:term:flr-r]floor area.
A hose station located on one side of a [REF:term:hrzntl-x]horizontal exit shall be considered to serve only the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area on that side of the [REF:term:hrzntl-x]horizontal exit.

A hose cabinet shall be located so that its door, when fully
opened, will not obstruct the required width of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress.

Where a [REF:term:bldng]building or part thereof
is used as a [REF:term:dstr]distillery and the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long], small hose (38 mm (metric)) stations are permitted to be supplied from interior
sprinkler piping.

Where a hose station is provided in grain handling and storage
facilities in which [REF:term:cmbtbl-dst]combustible dusts are produced in quantities or concentrations that create an explosion
or fire hazard, fog and fine spray nozzles shall be used instead of
nozzles that discharge a solid stream of water to prevent [REF:term:cmbtbl-dst]combustible dusts from being raised into
suspension.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent9:short], an automatic
sprinkler system shall be designed, constructed, installed and tested
in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa13] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote94:short].)

Instead of the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short], [REF:standard:nfpa13r] is permitted to be
used for the design, construction and installation of an automatic
sprinkler system installed

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:bldng]building of Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy containing no other [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies that

subclauses.text:
is not more than 4 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art47:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art49:number]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:medium], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art52:number] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art55:number], or
is not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect1.art3:long], or

clauses.text:
in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy with not more than 10 occupants that is not
more than 3 storeys
                               (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height and conforms to one of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art42:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art46:long]

content.text:
Instead of the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short], [REF:standard:nfpa13d] is permitted to be
used for the design, construction and installation of an automatic
sprinkler system installed

clauses.text:
in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy throughout that contains not more than
two [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units,
in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy, provided

subclauses.text: it contains not more than two [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy,
it has not more than five residents throughout, and
a 30-minute water supply demand can be met, and

clauses.text:
in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy throughout that contains more than two dwelling units
                               (metric), provided

subclauses.text: except for a [REF:term:scnd-t]secondary suite, no [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is located above another [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit,

all [REF:term:t]suites are separated by a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not less than 1 h (metric) that
provides continuous protection from the top of the footing to the
underside of the roof deck, with any space between the top of the
wall and the roof deck tightly filled with mineral wool or [REF:term:cmbtbl]noncombustible material,

each [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit has its own
sprinkler water supply provided in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13d]

a passive purge sprinkler system design is used as described
in [REF:standard:nfpa13d] and

where the sprinkler system is taken into consideration for the
reduction of [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance, all
rooms, including closets, bathrooms and attached garages, that adjoin
an [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face are sprinklered,
notwithstanding any exemption stated in [REF:standard:nfpa13d]

content.text:
If a [REF:term:bldng]building contains fewer than
9 sprinklers, the water supply for these sprinklers is permitted to
be supplied from the domestic water system for the [REF:term:bldng]building provided the required flow for the sprinklers can
be met by the domestic system.

If a water supply serves both an automatic sprinkler system
and a system serving other equipment, control valves shall be provided
so that either system can be shut off independently.

Notwithstanding the requirements of the standards referenced
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] regarding the installation
of automatic sprinkler systems, sprinklers shall not be omitted in
any room or closet in the [REF:term:tr]storey immediately
below a roof assembly. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote96:short].)

revisions.text:
Notwithstanding the requirements of the standards referenced
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] regarding the installation
of automatic sprinkler systems, in [REF:term:bldng]buildings conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long], sprinklers shall be provided for balconies and
decks exceeding 610 mm (metric) in depth measured perpendicular
to the exterior wall. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote97:short].)

Notwithstanding the requirements of the standards referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:short]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] regarding the installation of automatic sprinkler systems, in [REF:term:bldng]buildings conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art48:long]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long], balconies and exterior decks shall not be required to be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.
revisions.change_summary: Added reference to Article 3.2.2.93 (changed "or 3.2.2.60" to ", 3.2.2.60 or 3.2.2.93")

content.text:
Sprinklers in elevator machine rooms shall have a temperature
rating not less than that required for an intermediate temperature
classification and shall be protected against physical damage. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote98:short].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8:long], closely
spaced sprinklers and associated draft stops need not be installed
around floor openings in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa13]

Fast response sprinklers shall be installed in [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancies, [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancies, [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancies and [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention occupancies. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote12a:short].)

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  sprinkler piping shall
be used only for sprinkler systems in [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancies and other light-hazard [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote99:short].)

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible  sprinkler piping shall
meet the requirements of [REF:standard:ulcc199p]

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent5:short], [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible sprinkler piping shall
be separated from the area served by the sprinkler system, and from
any other [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment, by ceilings,
walls, or soffits consisting of, as a minimum,

clauses.text: lath and plaster,
gypsum board not less than 9.5 mm (metric) thick,
plywood not less than 13 mm (metric) thick, or
a suspended membrane ceiling with

subclauses.text: steel suspension grids, and

lay-in panels or tiles having a mass not less than 1.7
kg/m2
                                  (metric).

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent5:short], [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible sprinkler piping may be
located above a ceiling provided that the distance between the edge
of any ceiling opening that is not protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent3:short] and the nearest sprinkler is not more
than 300 mm (metric).

Where [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible sprinkler piping
has been tested in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcc199p] and has been shown to meet the requirements
therein without additional protection, conformance to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art13.sent4:short] is not required.

An automatic sprinkler system shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] if flooring for access within the [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space is other than catwalks.

The sprinkler system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art14.sent1:short] shall be equipped with waterflow detecting devices,
with each device serving not more than one [REF:term:tr]storey.

The waterflow detecting devices required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art14.sent2:short] shall be connected to the fire alarm
system, to

clauses.text:
initiate an [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signal in a 2-stage
system or an [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signal in a single
stage system, and

indicate separately on the fire alarm system annunciator the
actuation of each device.

content.text:
The fire department connection for a standpipe system shall
be located so that the distance from the fire department connection
to a hydrant is not more than 45 m (metric) and is unobstructed.

The fire department connection for an automatic sprinkler system
shall be located so that the distance from the fire department connection
to a hydrant is not more than 45 m (metric) and is unobstructed.
Portable extinguishers shall be provided and installed in accordance with the British Columbia Fire Code.

In a Group B, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, portable fire extinguishers are permitted to be located in secure
areas, or in lockable cabinets provided

clauses.text:
identical keys for all cabinets are located at all supervisory
or security stations, or

electrical remote release devices are provided and are connected
to an emergency power supply.

content.text:
Equipment forming part of a fire protection system shall be
protected from freezing if

clauses.text: it could be adversely affected by freezing temperatures, and
it is located in an unheated area.

content.text:
If a fire pump is installed, it shall be installed in accordance
with the requirements of [REF:standard:nfpa20] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote100:short].)

Except as provided
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1.sent2:short], this Subsection
applies to a [REF:term:bldng]building

clauses.text: of Group A, D, E or F [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy classification that is more than

subclauses.text: 36 m (metric) high, measured between [REF:term:grade]grade and the floor level of the top [REF:term:tr]storey, or

18 m (metric) high, measured between [REF:term:grade]grade and the floor level of the top [REF:term:tr]storey, and in which the cumulative or total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant
load on or above any [REF:term:tr]storey above [REF:term:grade]grade, other than the [REF:term:frt-tr]first
storey, divided by 1.8 times the width in metres of all [REF:term:xt]exit stairs at that [REF:term:tr]storey, exceeds 300,

clauses.text: containing a Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy in which the floor level of the highest [REF:term:tr]storey of that [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy is more than 18 m (metric) above [REF:term:grade]grade,

containing a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area or part of
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area located above the third [REF:term:tr]storey designed or intended as a Group B, Division
2 or 3 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, or
containing a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy whose floor level is more than 18 m (metric) above [REF:term:grade]grade.

revisions.text:
This Subsection applies to a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building constructed in
conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long]  in which the floor level
of the highest [REF:term:tr]storey is more than 18
m (metric) above [REF:term:grade]grade.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1.sent1.clause3:short], this Subsection applies to a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building constructed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art57:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] in which the floor level of the highest [REF:term:tr]storey is more than 18 m (metric) above [REF:term:grade]grade.
revisions.change_summary: Added reference to Article 3.2.2.93 and reference to Clause 3.2.6.1.(1)(c)

content.text:
A [REF:term:bldng]building to which this Subsection
applies shall be designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:long] to limit the danger to occupants and firefighters
from exposure to smoke in a [REF:term:bldng]building fire.

A [REF:term:bldng]building referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2.sent1:short] shall be designed so that, during
a period of 2 h (metric) after the start of a fire, each [REF:term:xt]exit stair serving [REF:term:tr]storeys below the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl]exit level  will not
contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the fire floor,
assuming an outdoor temperature equal to the January design temperature
on a 2.5% basis determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote102:short].)

Each stairway that serves [REF:term:tr]storeys above
the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl]exit level shall have a vent
to the outdoors, at or near the bottom of the stair shaft, that

clauses.text:
has an openable area of 0.05 m2
                               (metric) for
every door between the stair shaft and a [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area, but not less than 1.8 m2
                               (metric),

opens directly to the outdoors or into a vestibule that has
a similar opening to the outdoors, and
has a door or [REF:term:clr]closure that

subclauses.text: is openable manually, and
can remain in the open position during a fire emergency.

content.text:
Measures shall be taken to limit movement of smoke from a fire
in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area below the lowest [REF:term:xt-tr]exit storey into upper [REF:term:tr] storeys. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote104:short].)

Except for exhaust fans in kitchens, washrooms and bathrooms
in [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, and except for fans
used for smoke venting as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:long],
air moving fans in a system that serves more than 2 [REF:term:tr]storeys shall be designed and installed so that in the event
of a fire these fans can be stopped by means of a manually operated
switch at the central alarm and control facility.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art12:long] or where there
is a conflict with other smoke control measures in the [REF:term:bldng]building, air-handling systems used to provide
make-up air to [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors serving [REF:term:t]suites in a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy shall not shut down automatically upon activation
of the fire alarm so as to maintain corridor pressurization.

If a [REF:term:bldng] building described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1:long] is connected to any other [REF:term:bldng]building, measures shall be taken to limit movement of contaminated air from
one [REF:term:bldng] building into another during a fire.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote105:short].)

Manual emergency recall shall be provided for all elevators
serving [REF:term:tr]storeys above the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey.

Key-operated switches for emergency recall required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art4.sent1:short] shall be provided in a conspicuous
location at

clauses.text: each elevator lobby on the recall level, and
the central alarm and control facility required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7:long]

content.text:
In-car emergency service switches shall be provided in all elevator
cars.

Keys to operate the switches required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art4.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art4.sent3:short] shall be

clauses.text:
provided in a suitably identified box conspicuously located
on the outside of an elevator hoistway near the central alarm and
control facility required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7:long], and
kept at the central alarm and control facility.

content.text:
At least one elevator shall be provided for use by firefighters
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent6:short].

The elevator referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent1:short] shall have a useable platform area not less than 2.2 m2
                            (metric) and shall be capable of carrying a load of 900 kg (metric) to the top floor that it serves from a landing on the [REF:term:tr]storey containing the entrance for firefighter access
referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] within 1 min (metric).
Each elevator for use by firefighters shall

clauses.text:
be provided with a [REF:term:clr]closure at each
shaft opening so that the interlock mechanism remains mechanically
engaged and electrical continuity is maintained in the interlock circuits
and associated wiring for a period of not less than 1 h (metric) when the assembly is subjected to the standard fire exposure described
in [REF:standard:ulcs104]

be protected with a vestibule containing no [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy and separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 45 min (metric), or

be protected with a corridor containing no [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy and separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building  by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating not
less than 1 h (metric).

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent5:short], an elevator referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent1:short] shall be capable of providing transportation from the [REF:term:tr]storey containing the entrance for firefighter access
referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] to every floor that is above [REF:term:grade] grade in the [REF:term:bldng]building and that is normally served by the elevator system.

If it is necessary to change elevators to reach any floor referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent4:short], the system shall be
designed so that not more than one change of elevator is required
when travelling to any floor in the [REF:term:bldng] building from the [REF:term:tr]storey containing the entrance
for firefighter access referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long]

Electrical conductors for the operation of the elevator referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text:
be installed in [REF:term:rvc-pc]service spaces conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6:long] that do not contain other [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible material, or

conform to [REF:standard:ulcs139] including the hose
stream application, to provide a circuit integrity rating of not less
than 1 h (metric) (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote106:short]).

content.text:
Means of venting each [REF:term:flr-r]floor area to
the outdoors shall be provided by windows, wall panels, smoke shafts,
or the [REF:term:bldng]building exhaust system. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote107:short].)

Fixed glass windows shall not be used for the venting required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6.sent1:short] if the breaking of the
windows could endanger pedestrians below.

Openable windows used for the venting required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6.sent1:short] shall be permanently marked so that
they are easily identifiable.

Elevator hoistways shall not be designed for the venting required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6.sent1:short].

A central alarm and control facility shall be provided on the [REF:term:tr]storey containing the entrance for firefighter access
referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] in a location that

clauses.text: is readily accessible to firefighters entering the [REF:term:bldng] building, and

takes into account the effect of background noise likely to
occur under fire emergency conditions, so that the facility can properly
perform its required function under these conditions.

content.text: The central alarm and control facility required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7.sent1:short] shall include

clauses.text: means to control the voice communication system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art8:long], so that messages can be sent to

subclauses.text: all loudspeakers simultaneously,
individual [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas, and
[REF:term:xt]exit stairwells,

clauses.text: means to indicate audibly and visually [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signals  and [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals and a switch to

subclauses.text: silence the audible portion of these signals, and
indicate visually that the audible portion has been silenced,

clauses.text: means to indicate visually that elevators are on emergency recall,
an annunciator conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art8:long],

means to transmit [REF:term:lrt-gnl]alert signals and [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals to the fire department
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7:long],
means to release hold-open devices on doors to vestibules,

means to manually actuate [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals in the [REF:term:bldng]building selectively to any zone
or zones,

means to silence the [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art7.sent2.clause7:short] in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent2:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22.sent3:long],

means, as appropriate to the measure for fire safety provided
in the [REF:term:bldng]building, to

subclauses.text: actuate auxiliary equipment identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art3:number] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:number], or

communicate with a continually staffed auxiliary equipment control
centre,

clauses.text: means to communicate with telephones in elevator cars, separate from connections to firefighters' telephones, if elevator cars are required by the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations to be equipped with a telephone,

means to indicate visually, individual sprinkler system waterflow
signals,

means to indicate audibly and visually, sprinkler and standpipe
system supervisory signals and trouble signals,

a switch to silence the audible portion of a supervisory signal
or a trouble signal, and

visual indication that the audible portion of a supervisory
signal or a trouble signal has been silenced.

content.text: A voice communication system conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22:long] shall be provided in a [REF:term:bldng]building if

clauses.text:
the floor of the top [REF:term:tr]storey is more
than  36 m (metric) above [REF:term:grade]grade, or

a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area or part of a [REF:term:flr-r] floor area located above the third [REF:term:tr]storey is designed or intended for use as a Group
B, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

content.text:
The systems for control of smoke movement and mechanical venting
required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:long] shall be tested to ensure satisfactory
operation. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote110:short].)

An accessible path of travel required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8:long], an [REF:term:xt]exit, a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, or a corridor providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit for the public or serving patients' sleeping rooms or classrooms shall be equipped to provide illumination to an average level not less than 50 lx (metric) at floor or tread level and at angles and intersections at changes of level where there are stairs or [REF:term:rmp]ramps.
The minimum level of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent1:short] shall be 10 lx (metric).

Rooms and spaces used by the public shall be equipped to provide illumination as
described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect34.subsect2.art7:long]

The minimum level of illumination over the entire length of
escalators and moving walks shall be not less than 100 lx (metric) at the level of the treads and walking surfaces.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent6:short] and except for light switches and internally illuminated controls,
the minimum level of illumination at controls required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art6:long] shall be not less than 100 lx (metric).

Where visual information is provided at controls referred to
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent5:short], the minimum level of
illumination at the controls shall be not less than 200 lx (metric), except where the visual information is internally illuminated.

Except for internally illuminated signs, the minimum level of
illumination at signs displaying visual information required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10.sent5.clause2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause7:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause12.subclause2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6.clause4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art18.sent4.clause1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art19:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:medium] shall be
not less than 200 lx (metric).

Lighting outlets in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy  shall be provided in
conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect34.subsect2:long]

A recessed lighting fixture shall not be located in an insulated
ceiling unless the fixture is designed for this type of installation.

Emergency lighting shall be provided to an average level of
illumination not less than 10 lx (metric) at floor or tread level
in

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt]exits,
principal routes providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit in open [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas and in [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms,
corridors used by the public,
corridors serving sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancy,

corridors serving sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:ca-cc]care
occupancy, except corridors serving sleeping rooms within individual [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy,
corridors serving classrooms,
underground [REF:term:wlkw]walkways,
[REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors,

[REF:term:flr-r]floor areas or parts thereof where
the public may congregate

subclauses.text: in Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies, or
in Group A, Division 2 and 3 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of 60 or more,

clauses.text:
[REF:term:flr-r]floor areas or parts thereof of daycare
centres where persons are cared for,
[REF:term:flr-r]floor areas or parts thereof where persons are cared for that are within daycare facilities, including daycare facilities for children,

public washrooms that are equipped to serve more than one person
at a time,

locations where
doors are equipped with an electromagnetic lock as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause11:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6.clause7:medium], and

universal washrooms,
universal shower rooms and accessible change spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8:long]

content.text:
Emergency lighting to provide an average level of illumination
of not less than 10 lx (metric) at floor or catwalk level shall
be included in a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space  referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long].

The minimum value of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent2:short] shall be not less than 1 lx (metric).

In addition to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3.sent3:short], the installation of battery-operated emergency lighting
in buildings or part thereof where [REF:term:trtm]treatment is provided shall conform to the appropriate requirements of [REF:standard:csaz32]
An emergency power supply shall be

clauses.text:
provided to maintain the emergency lighting required by this
Subsection from a power source such as batteries or generators that
will continue to supply power in the event that the regular power
supply to the [REF:term:bldng] building is interrupted,
and

so designed and installed that upon failure of the regular power
it will assume the electrical load automatically for a period of

subclauses.text:
2 h (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building within
the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long],

1 h (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building of
Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy classification
that is not within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long],

1 h (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building constructed
in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long], and
30 min (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building of any other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

content.text:
If self-contained emergency lighting units are used, they shall
conform to [REF:standard:csac22.2no.141]

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art6:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art7:long], an emergency electrical
power supply system shall be installed in conformance with [REF:standard:csac282] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:long] for emergency electrical power supply for voice
communication systems.)

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art7:long], an emergency
electrical power supply system for emergency equipment required by
this Part for [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancies shall
be installed in conformance with [REF:standard:csaz32] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote112:short].)

If a liquid or gas fuel-fired engine or turbine for an emergency
electric power supply is dependent on a fuel supply from outside the [REF:term:bldng]building, the fuel supply shall be provided with
a suitably-identified separate shut-off valve outside the [REF:term:bldng]building.

articles.title: Emergency Power for Fire Alarm Systems

content.text:
Fire alarm systems, including those incorporating a voice communication
system, shall be provided with an emergency power supply conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent4:short].
The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:short] shall be supplied from

clauses.text: a generator,
batteries, or
a combination thereof.

content.text: The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:short] shall be capable of providing

clauses.text: supervisory power for not less than 24 h (metric), and

immediately following that period, emergency power under full
load for not less than

subclauses.text:
2 h (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building within
the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long],

1 h (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building classified
as a Group B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy that is
not within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long],

1 h (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building constructed
in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art51:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art60:long],
5 min (metric) for a [REF:term:bldng]building not required to be equipped with an annunciator, and
30 min (metric) for any other [REF:term:bldng]building.

content.text:
The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art8.sent1:short] shall be designed so that, in the event of a failure
of the normal power source, there is an immediate automatic transfer
to emergency power with no loss of information.

An emergency power supply capable of operating under a full
load for not less than 2 h (metric) shall be provided by an emergency
generator for

clauses.text:
every elevator serving [REF:term:tr]storeys above
the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is more than 36 m (metric) high measured
between [REF:term:grade] grade and the floor level of the
top [REF:term:tr]storey and every elevator for firefighters
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent2:short],

except as provided
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent4:short], equipment that supplies water for fire
suppression as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art7:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:medium]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art18.sent1:medium], if the supply depends solely on electrical
power supplied to the [REF:term:bldng]building,

fans and other electrical equipment that are installed to maintain
the air quality specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art6:medium],
fans required for venting by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art6:long], and

fans required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1.clause3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art7:long] in [REF:term:bldng]buildings within
the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long]

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent3:short], the emergency power supply for elevators required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent1.clause1:medium] shall be capable of operating all
elevators for firefighters plus one additional elevator simultaneously.

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent2:short] does not apply if the
time to recall all elevators under emergency power supply is not more
than 5 min (metric), each from its most remote [REF:term:tr]storey to

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:tr]storey containing the entrance for
firefighter access referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long], or
to a transfer lobby.

content.text:
The emergency power supply required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art9.sent1.clause2:medium] for the equipment that supplies water for fire suppression
need not be provided for sprinkler systems conforming to [REF:standard:nfpa13d]

The protection of electrical and emergency conductors referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1.clause1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1.clause3:short] shall conform to the
requirements stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent11:short]:

clauses.text: electrical conductors located within [REF:term:bldng]buildings identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art1:long] serving

subclauses.text: fire alarms,
emergency lighting, or

emergency equipment within the scope of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art2:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art8:long],

clauses.text:
emergency conductors serving fire pumps required to be installed
under [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art18:long], and
electrical conductors serving mechanical systems serving

subclauses.text:
areas of refuge identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art6.sent1.clause2:long],
or

[REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use areas identified
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent4.clause1:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent4.clause2:short].

content.text:
Except as otherwise required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent3:short] and permitted by this Article, electrical conductors
that are used in conjunction with systems identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text:
conform to [REF:standard:ulcs139] including
the hose stream application, to provide a circuit integrity rating
of not less than 1 h (metric) (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote115:short]) (see
also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent6.clause2:long]), or

be located in a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space that
is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation that has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric).

content.text: Electrical conductors identified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1.clause3:medium] shall

clauses.text:
conform to [REF:standard:ulcs139] including
the hose stream application, to provide a circuit integrity rating
of not less than 2 h (metric) (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote115:short]), or

be located in a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space that
is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation that has a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 2 h (metric).

content.text:
The [REF:term:rvc-pc]service spaces referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2.clause2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent3.clause2:medium] shall not contain
any [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible materials other than the
conductors being protected.

Except as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent7:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent9:short], the electrical conductors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent1:short] are those that extend from the source of emergency
power to

clauses.text: the equipment served, or

the distribution equipment supplying power to the equipment
served, if both are in the same room (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote116:short]).

content.text:
If a fire alarm transponder or annunciator in one [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment is connected to a central
processing unit or another transponder or annunciator located in a
different [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment, the electrical
conductors connecting them shall be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short].

Fire alarm system branch circuits within a [REF:term:tr]storey that connect transponders and individual devices need
not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote117:short].)

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent9:short], if a distribution panel supplies power to emergency lighting,
the power supply conductors leading up to the distribution panel shall
be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short].

Conductors leading from a distribution panel referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent8:short] to emergency lighting units in the
same [REF:term:tr]storey need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short].

Distribution panels serving emergency lighting units located
 on other [REF:term:tr]storeys shall be installed in a [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room separated from the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
at least 1 h (metric).

Conductors leading from a distribution panel to emergency lighting
 units located on other [REF:term:tr]storeys shall be protected
in  accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art10.sent2:short] between
the  distribution panel and the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area where the emergency  lighting units are located.

subsections.title: Mezzanines and Openings through Floor Assemblies

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3:long], the portions of a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area or a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine that do not terminate
at an exterior wall, a [REF:term:frwll]firewall or a vertical
shaft shall

clauses.text:
terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than that required for the floor assembly and extending from
the floor assembly to the underside of the floor or roof assembly
above, or

be protected in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long]

content.text:
The penetration of a floor assembly by an [REF:term:xt]exit or a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space shall
conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6:long]

A [REF:term:flr-r]floor area containing sleeping
rooms in a [REF:term:bldng]building of Group B, Division
2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall not be constructed
as part of an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space.

A [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine  need not terminate at
a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation nor be protected
in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long] provided
the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine

clauses.text: serves a Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy,

serves a Group A, Division 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy  in a [REF:term:bldng]building not more than 2 storeys
                               (metric) in [REF:term:bldng]building height, or

serves a Group A, C, D, E or F [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancy and

subclauses.text:
is 500 m2
                                  (metric) or less in area, and

conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent3:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent4:short].

content.text: Except for floors referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect10.art3.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art2:long], openings through a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation for vehicular ramps in a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage are not required to be protected with [REF:term:clr]closures  and need not conform to this Subsection.

If a [REF:term:clr]closure  in an opening in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation would disrupt the nature of
a manufacturing process, such as a continuous flow of material from [REF:term:tr]storey to [REF:term:tr]storey, the [REF:term:clr]closure for the opening is permitted to be omitted
provided precautions are taken to offset the resulting hazard.  (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote118:short].)

An [REF:term:ntrcnnct] interconnected floor space in a Group B, Division
1 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy need not conform to the requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long] provided the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected
floor space does not interconnect more than 2 adjacent [REF:term:tr]storeys.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent6:short], openings for escalators and inclined moving walks need not conform
to the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long] provided

clauses.text:
the opening for each escalator or walk does not exceed 10 m2
                               (metric),
the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered  throughout,

closely spaced sprinklers
and associated draft stops are installed around the openings in conformance
with [REF:standard:nfpa13] and

the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space contains only Group A, Division 1, 2 or 3, Group D or Group E [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote120:long]).

content.text:
An [REF:term:ntrcnnct] interconnected floor space need not conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long], provided

clauses.text:
it consists of the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey and
the [REF:term:tr] storey next above or below it, but not
both,

it is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout or,
where the [REF:term:bldng-r]building area is not more than
one half of the area permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long],
the openings through the floor are used only for stairways, escalators
or moving walks (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote119:short]), and

it contains only Group A, Division 1, 2 or 3, Group D, Group
E, or Group F, Division 2 or 3 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote120:short]).

content.text: A [REF:term:bldng]building containing an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space shall be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

Except for large floor openings as defined in [REF:standard:nfpa13] closely spaced sprinklers and associated
draft stops shall be installed around floor openings in conformance
with [REF:standard:nfpa13].

An [REF:term:xt]exit  opening into an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space  shall be protected
at each opening into the [REF:term:ntrcnnct] interconnected floor
space by a vestibule

clauses.text: with doorways that are not less than 1.8 m (metric) apart,

that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation that is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote27:long]), and

that is designed to limit the passage of smoke so that the [REF:term:xt]exit stair shaft does not contain more than 1% by
volume of contaminated air from the fire floor, assuming an outdoor
temperature equal to the January design temperature on a 2.5% basis
determined in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote121:short]).

content.text:
An [REF:term:xt]exit  opening into an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space  shall conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6:long].

If an elevator hoistway opens into an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space and into [REF:term:tr]storeys above the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space, either the elevator doors opening into the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space or the elevator doors opening into
the [REF:term:tr]storeys above the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space shall be protected by vestibules
conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1:short].

A [REF:term:prt-flr-spc]protected floor space used
to satisfy the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6.clause2:long] shall

clauses.text:
be separated from the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected
floor space by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than that required for the floor assembly of the [REF:term:tr]storey in which it is located,

have all openings in the vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separation between a [REF:term:prt-flr-spc]protected floor
space and the adjacent [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected
floor space protected by vestibules conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art4.sent1:long], and
be designed so that it is not necessary to enter the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space to reach an [REF:term:xt]exit.

content.text:
A draft stop shall be provided at each floor level within an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space, immediately adjacent
to and surrounding the opening, and shall be not less than 500
mm (metric) deep measured from ceiling level down to the underside of
the draft stop.

A mechanical exhaust system shall be provided to remove air
from an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space at
a rate of 4 air changes per hour. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote122:short].)

The mechanical exhaust system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art7.sent1:short] shall be actuated by a switch located
on the [REF:term:tr]storey containing the entrance for
firefighter access referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5:long] near
the annunciator for the fire alarm system.

An [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space shall
be designed so that the [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible contents,
excluding interior finishes, in those parts of a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in which the ceiling is more than 8 m (metric) above the floor, are limited to not more than 16 g (metric) of [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible material for each cubic metre of
volume of the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space.

subsections.title: Integrated Fire Protection and Life Safety Systems

content.text:
Where fire protection and life safety systems and systems with
fire protection and life safety functions are integrated with each
other, they shall be tested as a whole in accordance with [REF:standard:ulcs1001] to verify that they have been
properly integrated. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote123:short].)

subsections.title: Requirements for Residential Buildings with a Single Exit

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art1.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art1.sent4:short], this Subsection applies to [REF:term:bldng]buildings of only [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy that

clauses.text: are not more than six [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,

have a height not more than 18 m (metric) measured between the floor of the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey and the uppermost floor level, excluding any floor level within a rooftop [REF:term:ncls]enclosure that is not considered as a [REF:term:tr]storey in calculating [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent1:long],
contain not more than four [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units on each floor,
does not exceed an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of 24 persons (metric) per floor, and
have a [REF:term:trvl-dst]travel distance from

subclauses.text: any part of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area to an [REF:term:xt]exit not more than 25 m (metric), and
each [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit to an [REF:term:xt]exit of not more than 6 m (metric).

content.text: This Subsection does not apply to [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art1:long] to be served by one [REF:term:xt]exit.
This Subsection does not apply to detached houses, semi-detached houses, houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite, duplexes, triplexes, townhouses or row houses.

[REF:term:rdntl-cc]Residential
                                    [REF:term:bldng]buildings with a single [REF:term:xt]exit are not permitted for

clauses.text: hotels, motels, dormitories or lodging houses,
[REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential clubs, colleges or schools,
monasteries,
seniors' residences, or
care facilities accepted for residential use pursuant to provincial legislation.

content.text: This Subsection, in accordance with the application of this Article and in conformance with the provisions of this Subsection and all other applicable provisions of this Code, may be used as an alternate to the requirements for a second [REF:term:xt]exit in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2:long].

Notwithstanding the permissions in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent2:short] to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:short], a [REF:term:bldng]building to which this Subsection applies shall be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout with an automatic sprinkler system designed, constructed, installed and tested in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa13], "Standard for the Installation of Sprinkler Systems." (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.1-2:long].) (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1.sent7:long].)

All balconies and decks shall be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect10.art2.sent1:short]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnoteA-3.2.10.2.1-2:long].)

The [REF:term:xt]exit facility shall be constructed either of [REF:term:nncmbst]noncombustible construction or, notwithstanding the application of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art7:long], with finishes that do not exceed the maximum [REF:term:flm-sprd]flame-spread rating and maximum smoke developed classification for [REF:term:xt]exit stairways in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art7.table1:long], and shall
