If more than one egress doorway is required from a room or [REF:term:t]suite referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art5:long],
the travel distance within the room or [REF:term:t]suite to the nearest egress doorway shall not exceed the maximum travel
distances specified in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause6:short] for [REF:term:xt]exits.

articles.title: Protection on Floor Areas with an Accessible Path of Travel

content.text: Every [REF:term:flr-r] floor area that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout and that has an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall (See Note A-3.3.1.7.(1).)

clauses.text: be served by an elevator

subclauses.text:
conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent4:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent6:short],

protected against fire in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent3.clause2:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6.art5.sent3.clause3:short], and

in a [REF:term:bldng]building over 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys  in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,
protected against smoke movement so that the hoistway will not contain
more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from a fire floor during
a period of 2 h (metric) after the start of a fire, assuming an
outdoor temperature equal to the January design temperature on a 2.5%
basis determined in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3:long],

clauses.text:
be divided into at least 2 zones by [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separations  conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent2:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent3:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art5.sent6:long] so that (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote128:short])

subclauses.text: persons with disabilities can be accommodated in each zone, and

the travel distance from any point in one zone to a doorway
leading to another zone shall be not more than the value for travel
distance permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1:long] for the [REF:term:ccpnc] occupancy classification of the zone,

clauses.text: in the case of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancies, be provided with balconies conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent4:short], except on a [REF:term:tr]storey containing an accessible entrance that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art2:long],
have an accessible exterior [REF:term:xt]exit at ground level, or
have a [REF:term:rmp]ramp conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] leading to ground level.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent3:short], the [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separations referred to
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:medium] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric).

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separations referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:medium] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: A balcony required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause3:medium] shall

clauses.text: have direct access from the [REF:term:t]suite or [REF:term:flr-r]floor area
be not less than 1 500 mm (metric) deep from the outside face of the exterior wall to the inside edge of the balcony with a clear perpendicular dimension of not less than 1 700 mm (metric), and
provide not less than 2 m m² (metric) of balcony space for each accessible sleeping room or bed space.

content.text: The [REF:term:flr-r]floor area on either side of a horizontal [REF:term:xt]exit conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10:long] is permitted to be considered as a zone in applying the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause2:medium].

Except within the [REF:term:flr-r] floor area of
a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage, the minimum headroom
clearance in every [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit shall
conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4:long] for [REF:term:xt]exits. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent5:long].)

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art8.sent3:short] and except for paths of travel in [REF:term:rvc-rm]service
rooms and [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, protruding [REF:term:bldng]building elements located within 1 980
mm (metric) of the floor shall not project more than 100 mm (metric) horizontally into paths of travel in a manner that would create
a hazard. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote129:short].)

The horizontal projection of a protruding [REF:term:bldng]building element referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art8.sent2:short] is permitted to be more than 100 mm (metric), provided
the clearance between the protruding element and the floor is less
than 680 mm (metric). (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote129:short].)
The minimum width of a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor shall be 1 100 mm (metric).

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent3:long], the minimum
unobstructed width of a corridor used by the public or a corridor
serving classrooms or patients' sleeping rooms shall be 1 100
mm (metric).

If a corridor contains an [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, the [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy shall not reduce the unobstructed
width of the corridor to less than its required width.

If a [REF:term:pblc-crr] public corridor conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause4:long] contains an [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy,

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy shall be located so
that for pedestrian travel there is an unobstructed width not less
than 3 m (metric) at all times adjacent and parallel to all rooms
and [REF:term:t]suites  that front onto the [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, and

the combined area of all [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies in the [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor shall be not
more than 15% of the area of the [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor.

content.text:
Except for a dead-end corridor that is entirely within a [REF:term:t]suite or as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent6:long], a dead-end
corridor is permitted provided it is not more than 6 m (metric) long.
Except as otherwise stated in this Section, aisles shall be provided in conformance with the British Columbia Fire Code.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12:long], a door that opens into a corridor
or other facility providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit  from a [REF:term:t]suite or room not located within a [REF:term:t]suite shall swing on a vertical axis.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12:long], a door that
opens into a corridor or other facility providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit  from a room or [REF:term:t]suite that is used or intended for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant
load more than 60 or for a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd]high-hazard
industrial occupancy shall swing in the direction of travel
to the [REF:term:xt]exit.

Every door that divides a corridor that is not wholly contained
within a [REF:term:t]suite shall swing on a vertical axis
in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt]exit.

If a pair of doors is installed in a corridor that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit in both directions, the doors
shall swing in opposite directions, with the door on the right hand
side swinging in the direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt]exit.

Doors that serve storage [REF:term:t]suites not more
than 28 m2
                            (metric) in area in warehousing [REF:term:bldng]buildings need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent1:short].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent5:medium], a sliding door provided in the locations described
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11:long] shall

clauses.text:
be designed and installed to swing on the vertical axis in the
direction of travel to the [REF:term:xt]exit when pressure
is applied, and

be identified as a swinging door by means of a label or decal
affixed to it.

content.text: In a Group B, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, or in an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-]impeded egress zone in other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies, sliding doors used in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11:long]

Movable [REF:term:prttn]partitions used to separate
a [REF:term:pblc-crr] public corridor from an adjacent [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and personal services occupancy or
a [REF:term:mrcntl-c]mercantile occupancy need not conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art12.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art11.sent2:short], provided the [REF:term:prttn] partitions are not located in the only [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote130:short].)

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art4:long], a door that
opens into or is located within a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or other facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to
exit from a [REF:term:t]suite shall

clauses.text:
provide a clear opening of not less than 850 mm (metric) if
there is only one door leaf,

in a doorway with multiple leaves, have the active leaf providing
a clear opening of not less than 850 mm (metric),
not open onto a step, and

have a threshold not more than 13 mm (metric) higher than the surrounding finished floor surface, and where it is higher than 6 mm (metric), shall be beveled to a slope not steeper than 1 in 2, except where it

subclauses.text: is used to confine the spillage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable liquids within a [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room or within a room in an [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancy, or
provides access to an exterior balcony, unless the balcony is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent1.clause3:long].

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent7:short], a door in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit shall be readily openable in travelling to an [REF:term:xt]exit without requiring keys, special devices or specialized knowledge
of the door-opening mechanism.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent4:short], door release hardware shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and the door shall be openable with not more than one releasing
operation. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent4:long].)

An egress door from an individual [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
unit or from a [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy is permitted to be provided
with additional devices that require a releasing operation additional
to the main door release hardware, provided the devices are readily
operable from the inside without the use of keys, special devices
or specialized knowledge. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote131:short].)

Except as provided
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art17.sent9:long], door release hardware shall be installed
between 900 mm (metric) and 1 100 mm (metric) above
the finished floor.

An egress door in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit serving a [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area or an [REF:term:mpdd-gr-]impeded egress zone is permitted to be equipped
with locking devices, provided they can be released either locally
or remotely in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent8:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent9:short]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote132:short].)

A door in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit is
permitted to be equipped with an electromagnetic lock conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6:short].
Local locking devices permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short] shall be operable by a key from both sides of the door.

Controls for the remote release of door locking devices permitted
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short] shall be located in an
area readily available to security personnel.
Locking devices permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:short] that are electrically operated shall be

clauses.text: designed to operate on emergency power, and
capable of manual release by security personnel.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art14.sent2:short], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2:long], [REF:term:rmp]ramps and stairways that do not serve
as [REF:term:xt]exits shall conform to the  requirements
for [REF:term:xt]exit
                           [REF:term:rmp]ramps and
stairways stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent8:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4:long], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art9:long]

[REF:term:rmp]Ramps and stairways that serve [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms, [REF:term:rvc-pc]service
spaces or [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancies need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art14.sent1:short], provided

clauses.text:
they are intended only for occasional use for servicing equipment
and machinery, and
they do not serve as [REF:term:xt]exits.

content.text: An exterior passageway leading to a required [REF:term:xt]exit shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4:long] for exterior [REF:term:xt]exit passageways.

articles.title: Tapered Treads in a Curved Flight

content.text:
[REF:term:flght]Flights of stairs shall consist solely
of

clauses.text: straight [REF:term:flght]flights, or
curved [REF:term:flght]flights complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art16.sent2:short].

content.text: [REF:term:tpr-thr]Tapered treads in a curved [REF:term:flght]flight that is not required as an [REF:term:xt]exit shall have

clauses.text: a minimum [REF:term:run]run of 150 mm (metric),

a [REF:term:run]run not less than 280 mm (metric) when measured at a point 300 mm (metric) from the centre line
 of the handrail at the narrow end of the tread, and
a riser conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8.sent2:long].

content.text:
[REF:term:tpr-thr]Tapered treads shall have a consistent
angle and uniform [REF:term:run]run and rise dimensions
in accordance with the construction tolerances stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art8:long] when measured at a point 300 mm (metric) from
the centre line of the handrail at the narrow end of the tread.
All [REF:term:tpr-thr]tapered treads within a [REF:term:flght]flight shall turn in the same direction.
The capacity of an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit shall be based on the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of the portion of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area served.

In an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit the required
width of [REF:term:rmp]ramps with a slope not more than
1 in 8, doorways, and corridors shall be based on not less than 6.1 mm (metric) per person.

In an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit the required
width of a [REF:term:rmp]ramp with a slope more than 1
in 8 shall be based on not less than 9.2 mm (metric) per person.

In an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area used or intended to be used for patients
in a Group B, Division 2 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy or residents
in a Group B, Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, the
required width of corridors, doorways, and [REF:term:rmp]ramps shall be based on not less than 18.4 mm (metric) per person.

The capacity of stairs in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to
exit shall conform to the requirements for stairs in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent3:short].

In a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:long], an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit that is part of the principal entrance serving a dance hall or a
licensed beverage establishment with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant
load more than 250 shall provide at least one half of the required [REF:term:xt]exit width.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent5:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9:long], a [REF:term:guard]guard not less than 1 070 mm (metric) high shall be provided

clauses.text:
around any roof to which access is provided for purposes other
than maintenance,

at openings into smoke shafts referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long] that are less than 1 070 mm (metric) above
the floor, and

at each raised floor, [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine,
balcony, gallery, interior or exterior vehicular ramp, and at other
locations where (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote41:long])

subclauses.text: the difference in elevation is more than 600 mm (metric) between the walking surface and the adjacent surface, or

the adjacent surface within 1.2 m (metric) of the walking
surface has a slope of more than 1 in 2.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art7:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art10:number], openings through [REF:term:guard]guards shall be of a size that prevents the passage of a spherical
object whose diameter is more than 100 mm (metric).

Openings through [REF:term:guard]guards other than
those required  by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent1:short] that serve [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies other  than [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancies shall be  of a size that

clauses.text: prevents the passage of a spherical object whose diameter is 100 mm (metric), or
permits the passage of a spherical object whose diameter is 200 mm (metric).

content.text:
Except for [REF:term:guard]guards conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art10:long], [REF:term:guard]guards that protect
a level located more than one [REF:term:tr]storey or 4.2 m (metric) above the adjacent level shall be designed so that no
member, attachment or opening located between 140 mm (metric) and 900 mm (metric) above the level protected by the [REF:term:guard]guard facilitates climbing. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote47:long].)
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18.sent1:short] does not apply

clauses.text: to the front edges of [REF:term:tg]stages,
to floor pits in [REF:term:rpr-grg]repair garages,
to loading docks, or
where access is provided for maintenance purposes only.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art19.sent2:short], tactile attention indicators complying with [REF:external:csab651]Clauses 4.3.5.3.1, 4.3.5.3.3 and 4.3.5.3.4 of 
                           [REF:standard:csab651] shall be
installed

clauses.text:
at the top of [REF:term:flght]flights of stairs that
are unenclosed, and
at drop-off edges with a change in elevation greater than 300 mm (metric) that are unprotected by a [REF:term:guard]guard.

content.text:
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art19.sent1:short] does not apply to [REF:term:rvc-pc]service spaces, bleachers addressed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2:long], [REF:term:tg]stages, loading docks, [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancies, within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, and to stairs and drop-off
edges serving not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent5:short], a glass or transparent door shall be designed and constructed
so that the existence and position of the door is readily apparent,
by attaching visually contrasting hardware, bars or other permanent
fixtures to it.

The visibility of fully glazed transparent doors, sidelights
and panels shall be enhanced through the inclusion of mullions, markings
or other elements that

clauses.text: are visually contrasting,
are at least 50 mm (metric) high,
extend the full width of the door, sidelight or panel, and
are located between 1 350 mm (metric) and 1 500 mm (metric) above the floor.

content.text: A glass door shall be constructed of

clauses.text: laminated or tempered safety glazing conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1] or
wired glass conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-12.11]

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent5:short], transparent panels used in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt] access to
exit that, because of their physical configuration or design,
could be mistaken as a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress shall be made inaccessible by barriers or railings.

Sliding glass [REF:term:prttn] partitions that separate
a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor from an adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy and that are open during normal working
hours need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent4:short], provided the [REF:term:prttn]partitions are suitably
marked in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20.sent2:short] to indicate their existence and position.

Where vision glass is provided in doors or transparent sidelights,
the lowest edge of the glass shall be no higher than 900 mm above
floor level.

Glass in doors and in sidelights that could be mistaken for
doors, within or at the entrances to [REF:term:dwllng-n] dwelling
units and in public areas, shall conform to the requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect6.subsect1.art4:long]

A window in a public area that extends to less than 1 000
mm  (metric) above the floor and is located above the second [REF:term:tr] storey in a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc] residential occupancy, shall be
protected by a barrier or railing to not less than 1 070 mm (metric) above the floor, or the window shall be non-openable and designed
to withstand the lateral design loads for balcony [REF:term:guard]guards required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art14:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art21.sent2:short], an exhaust ventilation system designed in conformance with the
appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6:long] shall be provided
in a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building in which dust, fumes, gases, vapour
or other impurities or contaminants have the potential to create a
fire or explosion hazard. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect2.subsect4.art13:long])

Where a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required
 to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating is
penetrated by a ventilation  system required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art21.sent1:short] for power-ventilated  enclosures in
laboratories, the ducts shall be

clauses.text:
continuously enclosed from the first penetrated [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation to any subsequent [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations or  concealed spaces and all
the way through to the outdoors so that the  highest [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of all the penetrated [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations is maintained, and

exempted from the requirement to be equipped with a [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper, smoke damper and combination smoke/[REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art7:long]

content.text:
Explosion relief devices, vents or other protective measures
conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art2:long] shall be provided for a space in which substances
or conditions that have the potential to create an explosion hazard
are present as a result of the principal use of a [REF:term:bldng]building.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent3:short], a room or space within a [REF:term:flr-r] floor
area for the storage of janitorial supplies shall be separated
from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  not less than 1 h (metric).

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation  required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art22.sent1:short] is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating if the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in which the room or space is located
is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent3:short], in a [REF:term:bldng] building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy, a laundry room in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is not within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit shall be separated from the
remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  not less than 1 h (metric).

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min  (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art23.sent1:short] is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating if the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in which the laundry room is located
is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

No obstruction shall be permitted in any [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy that would restrict the width of a normal [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress  from any part of a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area to less than  750 mm (metric) unless
an alternative [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress  is provided
adjacent to, accessible from, and plainly visible from the obstructed [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote134:short].)

Illuminated signs conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent6:short] shall be provided to indicate the direction to egress points in
a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long].
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art26.sent2:short], welding and cutting operations shall be carried out in a room

clauses.text: separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric), or
protected by an automatic fire extinguishing system.

content.text:
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art26.sent1:short] shall not apply to [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancies where the welding and
cutting operations do not present a fire or explosion hazard to adjacent
areas.
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancies and to outdoor places of assembly.

Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art1.sent3:short], provisions 12.2.3.2, 12.2.3.3, 12.2.5.4, 12.2.5.5, 12.2.5.6, 12.2.11.1,
12.4.1 and 12.4.2 of Chapter 12 of [REF:standard:nfpa101] are
permitted to be used in lieu of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art11:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art12:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote135:short].)

The minimum clear width of aisle accessways between rows of
seats shall be calculated according to provisions 12.2.5.5.2, 12.2.5.5.4.1
and 12.2.5.5.5.1 of Chapter 12 of [REF:standard:nfpa101] except
that in no case shall the width be less than 400 mm (metric).

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art2.sent2:short], the seating area of a Group A, Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy shall be separated from adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies in the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric) if the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load in
the seating area exceeds 200.

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation  required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art2.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text:
If usable space exists under tiers of seats in arena-type [REF:term:bldng]buildings, a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 45 min (metric) shall be provided between the space
and the seats or the space shall be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.
Non-fixed seating shall conform to the British Columbia Fire Code.

Except for the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art8:long] for
bench-type seats and except as required or permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art11:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art12:long], fixed
seats in places of assembly shall be

clauses.text: attached or secured to the floor, platform or platform riser,
provided with arms and back, and

arranged in rows having an unobstructed passage not less than  400 mm (metric) wide measured horizontally between plumb lines from
the backs of the seats in one row and the edges of the furthest forward
projection of the seats in the next row in the unoccupied position.

content.text:
For fixed seats with backs and with folding tablet arms, the
value of 400 mm (metric) required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent1.clause3:medium] shall be measured when the tablet arms are in the
use position, but is permitted to be measured in the stored position
provided

clauses.text:
there are not more than 7 seats between any seat and the nearest
aisle,

the seats are located in a lecture hall or an auditorium used
for instructional purposes, and

the tablet arm, when raised manually to a vertical position,
falls by the force of gravity to the stored position.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4:short], aisles shall be located so that there are not more than 7 seats
with backs or 20 seats without backs between any seat and the nearest
aisle.

The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent3:short] do
not apply if

clauses.text: egress doorways are provided to serve both ends of rows of seats,
each doorway referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4.clause1:short] serves not more than 3 rows of seats, and
each row contains not more than 100 seats.

content.text:
Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art11:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art12:long], aisles leading to [REF:term:xt]exits  shall be provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent17:short] in places of assembly
which contain fixed seats.

The minimum clear width of aisles shall be not less than 1 100 mm (metric), except that the width is permitted to be reduced
to not less than

clauses.text: 750 mm (metric) if serving not more than 60 seats, and
900 mm (metric) if serving seats on one side only.

content.text:
Except in the case of bleacher seats, the minimum clear width
of aisles referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent2:short] shall
be measured at the point farthest from an [REF:term:xt]exit, cross aisle or foyer and shall be increased by 25 mm (metric) for each metre of distance toward the [REF:term:xt]exit, cross aisle or foyer.

Aisles shall terminate in a cross aisle, foyer or [REF:term:xt]exit, and the width of the cross aisle, foyer or [REF:term:xt]exit shall be not less than the required width of
the widest aisle plus 50% of the total required width of the remaining
aisles that it serves.
Dead-end aisles shall be not more than 6 m (metric) long.

The length of travel to an [REF:term:xt]exit door
by any aisle shall be not more than 45 m (metric).

Side aisles shall be not less than 1 100 mm (metric) wide
if seating is provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4:long].

An aisle that has a slope not more than 1 in 8 shall not be
stepped.
An aisle that slopes more than 1 in 8 shall be stepped.

The passageway between rows of seats served by a stepped aisle
shall be level at right angles to the line of travel.
The riser of a step in an aisle shall be

clauses.text: not less than 110 mm (metric) high, and
not more than 200 mm (metric) high.

content.text: Variations are permitted in riser height provided

clauses.text: the height of adjacent risers does not vary by more than 6 mm (metric), and

the width of a tread or a platform in the direction of travel
is not less than 430 mm (metric).

content.text: Steps in an aisle shall

clauses.text:
have a [REF:term:run]run not less than 230
mm (metric) exclusive of nosings,
have a tread width not less than 250 mm (metric),

extend to the adjacent rows of seats in a manner that will not
create a hazard from tripping, and
have a finish on the treads conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1.sent1:long].

content.text:
The location of every riser in an aisle shall be made apparent
from both directions of travel by strategically placed lighting or
contrasting marking stripes.

A platform in an aisle shall be level, except that a slope not
more than 1 in 50 is permitted for a platform that is not less than 430 mm (metric) wide in the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel.

If a step is used at the entry to a row of seats from a stepped
aisle, an unobstructed platform not less than 800 mm (metric) square
shall be provided adjacent to the aisle.

The finish of the surface of a platform in or adjacent to a
stepped aisle shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art1.sent1:long].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent4:short], a corridor used by the public in an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancy as an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 1 h (metric).

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation  required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent1:short] is permitted to be waived
if the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in which the corridor
is located is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

The requirement for a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art6.sent1:short] is permitted
to be waived if the distance from any point in the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area to an [REF:term:xt]exit measured along
the path of travel to the [REF:term:xt]exit does not exceed
the travel distance permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5:long]

A door equipped with a latching mechanism in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from a room or [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancy containing
an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load more than 100 shall
be equipped with a device that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent3:long].

If fixed bench-type seats without arms are provided, the seat
width per person shall be assumed to be 450 mm (metric).

The centre-to-centre spacing between rows of bench-type seats
shall be not less than 760 mm (metric) if back rests are provided,
and not less than 550 mm (metric) if back rests are not provided.

A clear space of not less than 300 mm (metric) shall be
provided between the back of each seat and the front of the seat immediately
behind it.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent4:short] for bleacher seats, [REF:term:guard] guards shall be installed in outdoor and indoor places of assembly with
fixed seats so that

clauses.text:
at the fascia of every box, balcony or gallery where the seats
extend to the edge, the height of [REF:term:guard]guards is not less than

subclauses.text: 760 mm (metric) in front of the seats, and

920 mm (metric) if located at the end of aisles or at the
foot of steps,

clauses.text:
the height of [REF:term:guard]guards along every
cross aisle other than those adjacent to the fascia of every box,
balcony or gallery is not less than 660 mm (metric), except that [REF:term:guard]guards  need not be provided if the backs of
the seats along the front side of the aisle are not less than 600 mm (metric) above the floor of the aisle, and

where the seating is arranged in successive tiers and the height
of rise between platforms is more than 450 mm (metric), the height
of [REF:term:guard]guards is not less than 660 mm (metric) along the entire row of seats at the edge of the platform.

content.text:
The backs and ends of bleacher seats more than 1 200 mm (metric) above the ground or floor that are not adjacent to a wall shall
be protected with a [REF:term:guard]guard

clauses.text:
not less than 1 070 mm (metric) high above an adjacent aisle
surface or foot rest, and

not less than 920 mm (metric) high above the centre of an
adjacent seat board.

content.text:
If the front of a bleacher is more than 600 mm (metric) above
the ground or floor, it shall be protected with a [REF:term:guard]guard not less than 840 mm (metric) high above the front
foot rest.

The size of any opening in a [REF:term:guard]guard required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art9.sent3:short] shall not
allow the passage of a sphere whose diameter is more than 300
mm (metric).

Handrails shall be provided in aisles with steps in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.table1:long]

Aisle Serving Seating on Both Sides

body_rows.content:
a continuous handrail
located on the side of the aisle opposite the seats that conforms
to[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:long]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:short]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:short]

a handrail located
on one side at the end of each row of seats that conforms to[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:long]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:short]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:short]

                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:short]

a centre-line handrail
that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.sent2:short] or a continuous handrail located on the side of the aisle opposite
the seats that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:long]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:short]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:short]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent13:short]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:short], plus a handrail located at the end of each row of
seats that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:long]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent8:short]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:short]
