                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:short]
a centre line handrail that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.sent2:short]

content.text: Handrails installed along aisle centre lines as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art10.table1:long] shall

clauses.text:
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent5:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent7:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent14:short],

have gaps not less than 560 mm (metric) and not more than 915 mm (metric) wide, measured horizontally, at intervals not exceeding
five rows,

comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5.sent11:long] at terminations and
required gaps, and

have an intermediate rail located 305 mm (metric) below
the principal handrail.

content.text:
A Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy and
each tier or balcony that has a capacity of more than

clauses.text:
1 000 persons shall have not less than 3
separate [REF:term:xt]exits, or

4 000 persons shall have not less than 4
separate [REF:term:xt]exits.

content.text:
In a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, every seat shall be located so that the travel distance is not
more than 45 m (metric) measured along the path of travel from
the seat to

clauses.text: the ground,
an [REF:term:xt]exit,
an opening to a passageway leading from the seating area, or

a portal, a vomitory or any other opening through the seating
deck structure.

content.text:
[REF:term:xt]Exits from outdoor stadia or grandstands
shall be located not more than 25 m (metric) apart.

The capacity of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr] means of egress for a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy  shall
conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent3:long].
Aisles in a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy shall

clauses.text:
be located so that there are not more than 20 seats between
any seat and the nearest aisle, and

be not less than 1 200 mm (metric) wide, except that an
aisle serving less than 60 persons (metric) is permitted to be 750 mm (metric) wide.

content.text:
Steps provided in aisles of bleachers of the telescopic type
shall

clauses.text: have risers not more than 250 mm (metric) high, and
have treads with a [REF:term:run]run not less than 280 mm (metric).

content.text:
If the vertical distance between seating platforms in bleachers
is more than 280 mm (metric), an intermediate step shall be provided
the full width of the aisle and proportioned to provide 2 equal risers
between platforms.

If the vertical distance between seating platforms in bleachers
is more than 450 mm (metric),  2 intermediate steps (metric) shall be provided the full width of the aisle so that there are 3 equal risers (metric) between platforms.

If the passageway between rows of seats is not a closed deck,
footboards shall be provided so that

clauses.text:
the total width of the footboards shall be not less than three
quarters of the centre-to-centre spacing between rows of seats, and
the spacing between footboard members shall be not more than 25 mm (metric).

content.text:
Openings above footboards and below the seats in rows of bleacher
seats shall be provided with intermediate construction so that there
is no opening that would permit the passage of a sphere of more than 100 mm (metric) in diameter.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art13.sent2:short], a library book storage room that is not normally accessible to
the public shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 2 h (metric) if it

clauses.text:
is more than 250 m2
                               (metric) in area, or
contains book stacks that

subclauses.text: are more than 10 m (metric) high, or
penetrate more than one floor assembly.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art13.sent1:short] is not required if the book storage
room is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

Open book shelves are permitted above and below a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine floor in a library [REF:term:bldng]building provided the height of the shelves is not more than 2.1 m (metric) but not more than 75% of the floor-to-ceiling height
of the space above or below the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine floor assembly.

A [REF:term:tg]stage for theatrical performances
and ancillary spaces, including workshops, dressing rooms and storage
areas, shall be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

A [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric) shall be provided between a [REF:term:tg]stage for theatrical performances and ancillary spaces, including workshops,
dressing rooms and storage areas.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art14.sent6:short], a [REF:term:tg]stage for theatrical performances and
ancillary spaces, including workshops, dressing rooms and storage
areas, shall be separated from the seating area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  not less than 1 h (metric), except
for a proscenium opening protected with

clauses.text: a sprinkler deluge system conforming to the requirements of [REF:standard:nfpa13]
an unframed fire curtain if the opening is not more than 20 m  (metric) wide, or
a semi-rigid fire curtain if the opening is more than 20 m (metric) wide.

content.text:
A fire curtain required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art14.sent3:short] shall be of a type acceptable to the [REF:term:thrt-hvn]authority
having jurisdiction and designed to close

clauses.text: automatically upon the actuation of the sprinkler system,
automatically upon actuation of the fire alarm system, and

manually by remote control devices located at the curtain control
panel and at each side of the [REF:term:tg]stage.

content.text:
At least 2 vents for the purpose of venting fire and smoke to
the outside of a [REF:term:bldng]building shall be provided
above a [REF:term:tg]stage designed for theatrical performances
and shall

clauses.text:
have an aggregate area not less than one eighth of the area
of the [REF:term:tg]stage behind the proscenium opening,
and

be arranged to open automatically upon actuation of the sprinkler
system.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation referred to
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art14.sent3:short] is not required between
a [REF:term:tg]stage and a seating area in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, provided a sprinkler deluge system is installed at the
boundary between the [REF:term:tg]stage and the seating
area.

In a Group A, Division 2 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy used for the serving of food and beverages, an interior [REF:term:flght]flight of stairs with fewer than 3 risers is
permitted provided it

clauses.text: is not less than 900 mm (metric) wide,

is illuminated at all times that occupants are on the premises,
and
has a handrail on each side.

content.text: Where storage rooms are required by Part 4 of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code for the storage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable liquids or [REF:term:cmbtbl-l]combustible liquids in [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancies, such rooms shall not be located above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent3:short], glazing in all fixed and operable panels of doors shall conform
to Class A of [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1]

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent4:short], glazing in all fixed and operable panels of windows shall conform
to Class A of [REF:standard:cgsb-12.1]

Glazing in individual fixed or operable panels of a door need
not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent1:short], where

clauses.text:
the bottom exposed edge of the glazing is located more than 1 525 mm (metric) above the walking surface on each side of the door,
or

the glazed opening in the door does not permit the passage of
a sphere whose diameter is more than 75 mm (metric).

content.text:
Glazing in individual fixed or operable panels of a window need
not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art17.sent2:short], where

clauses.text:
the bottom exposed edge of the glazing is located more than 1 525 mm (metric) above the walking surface on each side of the window,
or

the glazing is located more than 915 mm (metric) away from
the walking surface on each side of the window measured perpendicular
to the plane of the glazing.

articles.title: Daycare Facilities for Children under 30 Months

content.text: A daycare facility for children where children under 30 months are accommodated shall be located (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote18:short].)

clauses.text: in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, or
not more than 1 [REF:term:tr]storey above or below a [REF:term:tr]storey with an [REF:term:xt]exit that opens directly to the exterior of the [REF:term:bldng]building at ground level.

content.text: A fire alarm system shall be installed in a [REF:term:bldng]building that contains a daycare facility described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent1:short] if

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng]building contains one or more other [REF:term:t]suites, or
the daycare facility shares an interior [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress.

content.text: If a fire alarm system is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent2:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long] to be installed in a daycare facility described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent1:short], [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors shall be installed in

clauses.text: each room of the daycare facility, and
each corridor serving as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from the daycare facility.

content.text: If a fire alarm system is not installed in a daycare facility described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent1:short], [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs531] shall be installed in

clauses.text: each room of the daycare facility, and
each corridor serving as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from the daycare facility.

content.text: [REF:term:mk-lrm]Smoke alarms required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art18.sent4:short] shall

clauses.text: comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent6:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent12:short], and

if more than one [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm is required, be wired so that the actuation of one of the required [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms will cause all the required [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms to sound.

content.text:
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment and [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention
occupancies. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote138:short].)

articles.title:
Separations between Care, Treatment or Detention Occupancies
and Repair Garages

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art5.sent1:long] between a [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment or [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention
occupancy and a [REF:term:rpr-grg]repair garage shall
have no openings.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent2:short], a corridor used by the public or serving patients' or residents'
sleeping rooms shall have no dead-end portion.
Corridors are permitted to have dead-portions, where

clauses.text: the area served by the dead-end portion has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress, or

the corridor serves a [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy and the dead-end portion does
not exceed 6 m (metric).

content.text: Corridors shall be not less than

clauses.text:
2 400 mm (metric) wide in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancy where the corridors
may be used to move patients or residents in beds,
1 650 mm (metric) wide

subclauses.text:
in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:ca-cc]care or [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancy where
the corridors will not be used to move patients or residents in beds,
and

in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy with more than 10 residents and where the corridors
serve the residents, or

clauses.text:
1 100 mm (metric) wide in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy with not more than
10 residents.

content.text: Paired doors in a corridor referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent3.clause1:medium] shall

clauses.text:
swing in opposite directions, the right-hand door swinging in
the direction of travel, and
be not less than 1 100 mm (metric) wide.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art4.sent2:short] and within individual [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy, the minimum clear width of a
doorway shall be 850 mm (metric) where it opens into or is located
within a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or other facility
that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit for patients
or residents in [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas containing [REF:term:ca-cc]care or [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancies.

The minimum clear width of doorways through which it is necessary
to move patients in bed shall be 1 050 mm (metric). (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote139:short].)

[REF:term:flr-r]Floor areas containing patients'
or residents' sleeping rooms in a [REF:term:ca-cc]care or [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment occupancy where overnight sleeping
accommodation is provided for more than a total of 10 patients (metric) or residents shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent13:short].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent3:short], a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent1:short] shall be divided into not less than
2 [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments, each not more than 1 000 m2
                            (metric) in area.

The [REF:term:flr-r] floor area on either side of
a [REF:term:hrzntl-x]horizontal exit  conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art10:long] is permitted to be considered as a [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment in applying the requirements
of this Article.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent5:short], [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations separating [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric).

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent4:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: The travel distance from any point within each [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] to a door to an adjoining [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment shall be not more than 45 m (metric).

Each [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent2:short] shall be capable of
accommodating, in addition to its own occupants, the occupants of
the largest adjacent [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment based on a clear floor space of 2.5 m2
                            (metric) per patient in the adjacent [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent9:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent13:short], walls between patients' or residents' sleeping rooms
and the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall
be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations but
are not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating unless one is required by other provisions in this Part.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote27:long].)

The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] do not apply to walls
within a group of intercommunicating patients' or residents' sleeping
rooms, provided the group of rooms does not

clauses.text: contain more than 5 patients or residents, or

include storage, bathing or toilet facilities serving persons
not occupying the group of rooms.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] do not apply to walls
within individual [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy.

A door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] is permitted to be equipped
with a roller latch.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent13:short], a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art5.sent8:short] shall not have any grilles, louvres
or other openings.

A door or wall separating a patient's or resident's sleeping
room from an ensuite toilet room, shower room or similar ancillary
space is permitted to incorporate grilles and louvres, provided

clauses.text: the adjacent rooms are not used to store flammable or [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible materials, and

the openings are located so that smoke cannot pass through these
rooms to other parts of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

content.text:
Walls between individual [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy and the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy shall be constructed
as [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than that
specified for [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancies in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent2:short].

Floor assemblies within individual [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy need not be constructed
as [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations, provided the [REF:term:t]suites meet the conditions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3.clause1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3.clause2:short].

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art6.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived if the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation is located between individual [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancy and an attached [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage containing
not more than 5 vehicles (metric), provided the conditions described
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent4:long] are met.

Compartments containing rooms such as operating rooms, recovery
rooms, delivery rooms and intensive care units, from which it is impracticable
to move patients in an emergency, shall be

clauses.text:
separated from adjacent spaces by [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separations having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating not less than 1 h (metric), and

provided with a mechanical air supply so that during a period
of 2 h (metric) after the start of a fire in another space, the
compartments will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated
air from the fire area.

content.text:
A [REF:term:cntnd-r] contained use area shall conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent5:short].

A [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area shall be separated
from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 1 h (metric).

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent4:short], a [REF:term:bldng]building that includes a [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area shall be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

revisions.text:
A [REF:term:cntnd-r] contained use area, in a [REF:term:bldng]building for which [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] do not
require the installation of an automatic sprinkler system, is not
required to be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered as required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent3:short] provided
                              
                                 the [REF:term:bldng]building is designed so that
during a period of 2 h (metric) after the start of a fire in the [REF:term:cntnd-r] contained use area other [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments will not contain more than 1% by volume
of contaminated air from the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area,
                              
                              
                                 the [REF:term:bldng]building is designed so that
during a period of 2 h (metric) after the start of a fire in another
part of the [REF:term:bldng]building the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area  will not contain more than
1% by volume of contaminated air from the other part of the [REF:term:bldng]building,
                              
                              
                                 all doors are designed to be remotely released in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art13.sent6:long], and
                              
                              
                                 the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area does not
contain any rooms lined with [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible padding.

A [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area, in a [REF:term:bldng]building for which [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art20:long]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art93:long] do not require the installation of an automatic sprinkler system, is not required to be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect3.art7.sent3:short] provided
                                 
                                    the [REF:term:bldng]building is designed so that during a period of 2 h (metric) after the start of a fire in the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area other [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments will not contain more than 1% by volume of contaminated air from the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area,
                                 
                                 
                                    the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area does not exceed 500 m2
                                        (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-r]building area,
                                 
                                 
                                    the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area does not exceed one [REF:term:tr]storey in [REF:term:bldng-hght]building height, and
                                 
                                 
                                    the [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not less than 2 h (metric).
revisions.change_summary: Changed reference from 3.2.2.92 to 3.2.2.93

content.text:
A corridor serving a [REF:term:cntnd-r]contained use area shall have no dead-end portion unless the area served by the dead-end
portion has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress.

This Subsection applies to [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancies.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art9.sent2:long], [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancy shall be separated from each other and the remainder
of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating not less than  1 h (metric).

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation  required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: Floor assemblies within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit need not be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separations provided

clauses.text:
the distance between the lowest floor level and the uppermost
floor level within the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is not more than  6 m (metric), and

the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is separated
from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  not less than

subclauses.text:
1 h (metric) if the [REF:term:bldng]building is
not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,

45 min (metric) if the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout and it is
not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, or
1 h (metric) if the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout and it is more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg] building height.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art6.sent1:long] is permitted to be waived if the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation is located between a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit and an attached [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage containing not more than 5 vehicles,
provided

clauses.text: the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit and the attached [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered,

the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit and the attached [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage are separated from the remainder
of the [REF:term:bldng]building in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3:short],
there are no air duct systems connecting the [REF:term:trg-grg] storage garage and the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit,

the construction between the [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage and the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit provides an
effective barrier to gas and exhaust fumes, and
every door between the [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage and the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is

subclauses.text:
tight fitting and weather-stripped to provide an effective barrier
against the passage of gas and exhaust fumes,
fitted with a self-closing device, and
not located in a room intended for sleeping.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art6.sent1:long] is not required between a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit and an attached [REF:term:trg-grg]storage
garage, serving that [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit only, provided

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit and its attached [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage are separated from the remainder
of the [REF:term:bldng]building in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent1:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent3:short],
there are no air duct systems connecting the [REF:term:trg-grg] storage garage and the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit,

the construction between the [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage and the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit provides an
effective barrier to gas and exhaust fumes, and
every door between the [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage and the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is

subclauses.text:
tight fitting and weather-stripped to provide an effective barrier
against the passage of gas and exhaust fumes,
fitted with a self-closing device, and
not located in a room intended for sleeping.

content.text:
Sprinklers shall be installed in a storage room provided for
the use of tenants in a [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy within a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area but not contained
within a [REF:term:t]suite.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art3.sent3:short], a storage room referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art3.sent1:short] shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 1 h (metric).

The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation  required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art3.sent2:short] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) but not less than 45 min (metric) provided the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] is permitted to be less than 1 h (metric) for

clauses.text: the floor assembly above the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or
the floor assembly below the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text: Except for the storage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable liquids and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l]combustible liquids inside a single-family [REF:term:dwllng-nt]dwelling unit and garages or sheds attached to these [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, where storage rooms are required by Part 4 of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code for the storage of [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable liquids or [REF:term:cmbtbl-l]combustible liquids in [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancies, such rooms shall not be located above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey.

Single [REF:term:tr] storey
                           [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units in an apartment [REF:term:bldng]building need not lead to a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or exterior passageway on the same [REF:term:tr]storey  provided the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units are served
by private stairways leading directly to a public [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit on the [REF:term:tr]storey

clauses.text: immediately above, and
immediately below.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent4:short], a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit containing
more than one [REF:term:tr]storey shall have an [REF:term:xt]exit door or an egress door opening directly into
a public [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from the uppermost [REF:term:tr]storey and from the lowest [REF:term:tr]storey of the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit so that each
of these [REF:term:tr]storeys is served by an [REF:term:xt]exit or egress door located not more than 1.5 m (metric) above or below its floor level.
A single [REF:term:xt]exit is permitted from a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit provided the [REF:term:xt]exit is an exterior doorway not more than 1.5 m (metric) above adjacent ground level and

clauses.text: it is not necessary to travel up or down more than one [REF:term:tr]storey to reach the [REF:term:xt]exit door, or
the uppermost floor level opens to a balcony not more than 6 m (metric) above adjacent ground level.

content.text: An egress door from either the uppermost [REF:term:tr]storey or the lowest [REF:term:tr]storey of a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art4.sent2:short], need not be provided if that [REF:term:tr]storey is served by a stairway that

clauses.text: leads to a public [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit,
has no direct access to any other [REF:term:tr]storey in the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, and

is separated from the other [REF:term:tr]storeys in
the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min (metric).

content.text:
In a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy not more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, a doorway from
a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is permitted to open
directly into an [REF:term:xt]exit stairway provided the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress.

If a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit has a second
and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress, one [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is permitted to pass through

clauses.text: an interior corridor served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit,
an exterior balcony served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit stairway, or
an exterior passageway served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit stairway.

content.text: Except for hotels and motels, a door opening onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor which provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from a [REF:term:t] suite shall be designed not to lock automatically. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote143:short].)

Occupants of [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units shall
 be protected from airborne noise in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part5.sect9:long]

articles.title:
Stairs, Ramps, Landings, Handrails and Guards for Dwelling
Units

content.text: Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8:long], stairs, [REF:term:rmp]ramps, landings, handrails and [REF:term:guard]guards within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit shall conform to the appropriate requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8:long]

Exterior stairs, [REF:term:rmp]ramps, landings, handrails
and [REF:term:guard]guards serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, and loads on [REF:term:guard]guards serving not more than two [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
units, shall conform to the appropriate requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect8:long]
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8.sent2:short], openable windows in [REF:term:t]suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy shall be protected by

clauses.text: a [REF:term:guard]guard with a minimum height of 1 070 mm (metric) constructed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art18:long], or

a mechanism that
can only be released with the use of tools or special knowledge to
control the free swinging or sliding operation of the
openable part of the window so as to limit any clear unobstructed
opening to not more than 100 mm (metric) measured either vertically
or horizontally.

content.text: Windows need not be protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8.sent1:short] where

clauses.text:
the only opening having greater dimensions than those allowed
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art8.sent1.clause2:medium] is located higher than 1 070 mm (metric) above the finished floor, or

the bottom edge of the openable portion of the window is located
less than 1 800 mm (metric) above the floor or ground on the other
side of the window.

content.text: [REF:term:dwllng-n]Dwelling units shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art2.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art5:long].

This Subsection applies to [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial
occupancies.

In addition to other requirements in this Code for the installation
of automatic fire extinguishing systems, an appropriate fire extinguishing
system shall be installed in every [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial
occupancy
                           [REF:term:flr-r]floor area to provide
protection if required by

clauses.text: provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws, or

the British Columbia Fire Code,
in the absence of the regulations or bylaws referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art2.sent1.clause1:short].

content.text:
A [REF:term:bmnt]basement shall not be used for the
storage, manufacture or handling of volatile solids, liquids or gases
that generate explosive air-vapour mixtures or for processes that
involve explosive dusts.

Entrances and [REF:term:xt]exits to a [REF:term:bmnt]basement and to rooms containing [REF:term:bldng]building services shall be separate from the remainder of
the [REF:term:bldng]building in a [REF:term:bldng]building in which

clauses.text:
the storage, manufacture or handling of volatile materials can
generate explosive air-vapour mixtures, or
processes occur that produce explosive dusts.

content.text:
[REF:term:bmnt]Basements and rooms referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art3.sent2:short] shall be separated from the remainder
of the [REF:term:bldng]building  with a vapour-tight separation.

If access is provided from a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage to a stair tower or elevator serving [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies above the level of the [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage, the access shall be through a vestibule conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent4:long].

Treads and landings in interior stairs that extend to the roof
of a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage shall be designed
to be free of accumulations of ice and snow.

A mechanical [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage not
more than 4 storeys
                            (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, in which no persons other
than parking attendants are permitted above the [REF:term:trt]street floor level, need not have a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between the [REF:term:xt]exits and
the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

A garage shall be provided with natural or mechanical ventilation
in conformance with the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect9.subsect1.art2:long] to prevent excessive accumulation
of carbon monoxide, exhaust fumes or flammable and toxic vapours.
The clear height in a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage shall be not less than 2 m (metric).

Where garage floors or ramps are 600 mm or more above the adjacent
ground or floor level, every opening through such floors and the perimeter
of floors and ramps shall be provided with

clauses.text:
a continuous curb not less than 140 mm (metric) high, a [REF:term:guard]guard not less than 1 070 mm (metric) high,
and a vehicle guardrail not less than 500 mm (metric) high conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent7:short], or
a full-height wall conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent7:short].

content.text:
Vehicle guardrails and full-height walls required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent6:short] shall be designed and constructed
to withstand the loading values stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part4.sect1.subsect5.art15.sent1:long].

Except for [REF:term:pn-r-tr]open-air storeys, every [REF:term:tr]storey of a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage or [REF:term:rpr-grg]repair garage located below [REF:term:grade]grade shall be [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

A [REF:term:rpr-grg]repair garage and any ancillary
spaces serving it, including waiting rooms, reception rooms, tool
and parts storage areas and supervisory office space, shall be separated
from other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 2 h (metric).

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent5:short], a [REF:term:trg-grg] storage garage shall be separated
from other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies  by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating not less than 1.5 h (metric).

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent2:short], if access is provided through a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage and a Group
A, Division 1 or Group B [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, the
access shall be through a vestibule conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent4:short].

If access is provided through a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage and a Group
B, Division 3 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy with not more than
10 occupants, access need not be through a vestibule, provided the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent5.clause2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect4.art2.sent5.clause4:short].

In a [REF:term:bldng]building more than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, access through a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between
a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage and a Group A, Division
2, 3 or 4, or a Group C [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, shall
be through a vestibule conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent4:short].

If access is provided through a vestibule, as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art7.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent1:long], the vestibule shall

clauses.text: be not less than 1.8 m (metric) long,
be ventilated

subclauses.text:
naturally to outside air by a vent that has an unobstructed
area of not less than 0.1 m2
                                  (metric) for each
door that opens into the vestibule but not less than 0.4 m2
                                  (metric), or
mechanically at a rate of 14 m3/h (metric) for each square metre of vestibule floor surface area, and

clauses.text:
have openings between the vestibule and an adjoining [REF:term:ccpnc] occupancy provided with self-closing doors with
no hold-open devices.

content.text:
Facilities for the dispensing of fuel having a [REF:term:flh-pnt]flash point below 37.8°C (metric) shall
not be installed above any space intended for [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

Facilities for the dispensing of fuel having a [REF:term:flh-pnt]flash point below 37.8°C (metric) shall
not be installed in any [REF:term:bldng]building, except
that this requirement does not apply to a canopy which is open on
not less than 75% of its perimeter.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent5:long] or unless
the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, each individual tenancy in a multiple tenant self storage
warehouse classified as an [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancy shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 45 min (metric).

Except where they serve [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garages, [REF:term:guard]guards in [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial
occupancies are permitted to consist of

clauses.text: a top railing, and

one or more intermediate rails spaced such that openings through
the [REF:term:guard]guard are of a size that prevents the
passage of a spherical object whose diameter is 535 mm (metric).

content.text:
This Subsection applies to design and fire protection requirements
for [REF:term:bldng]buildings or parts thereof used for
the storage, handling, use and processing of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods, including [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable
liquids and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l]combustible liquids, in quantities in excess of those identified in Table 3.2.7.1. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote144:short].)

Solid and liquid [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods classified as oxidizers or organic peroxides shall be separated
from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not less than 2 h (metric).

Reactive materials shall be separated from the remainder of
the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating of not less than 2 h (metric). (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote145:short].)

The design of [REF:term:bldng]buildings or parts
thereof used for the storage of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods classified as explosives shall conform to the [REF:standard:nrcan_ea] and its Regulations,
published by Natural Resources Canada.

Where wiring or electrical equipment is located in areas in which flammable gases or vapours, [REF:term:cmbtbl-dst]combustible dusts or [REF:term:cmbtbl-fbr]combustible fibres are present in quantities sufficient to create a hazard, such wiring and electrical equipment shall conform to the requirements for hazardous locations as required by the Safety Standards Act and pursuant regulations. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote146:short].)

articles.title:
Indoor Storage of Anhydrous Ammonia and Flammable, Toxic and
Oxidizing Gases

content.text: Where required by the British Columbia Fire Code, cylinders of [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods classified as flammable gases stored indoors shall be located in a room

clauses.text: that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a gas-tight [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of at least 2 h (metric),
that is located on an exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng]building,
that can be entered from the exterior, and
whose [REF:term:clr]closures leading to the interior of the [REF:term:bldng]building are

subclauses.text: equipped with self-closing devices that keep the [REF:term:clr]closures closed when not in use, and
constructed so as to prevent the migration of gases from the room into other parts of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

content.text: Where required by the British Columbia Fire Code, cylinders of anhydrous ammonia or [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods classified as toxic or oxidizing gases stored indoors shall be located in a room

clauses.text: that is separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a gas-tight [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of at least 1 h (metric),
that is located on an exterior wall of the [REF:term:bldng]building,
that can be entered from the exterior, and
whose [REF:term:clr]closures leading to the interior of the [REF:term:bldng]building are

subclauses.text: equipped with self-closing devices that keep the [REF:term:clr]closures closed when not in use, and
constructed so as to prevent the migration of gases from the room into other parts of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

articles.title:
Storage and Dispensing Rooms for Flammable Liquids and Combustible
Liquids

content.text: [REF:term:fr-prtn]Fire separations for rooms where [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable liquids and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l]combustible liquids are stored are required to be constructed with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating in conformance with Subsection 4.2.9. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code.

Where Class IA or IB liquids specified in Subsection 4.1.2. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code are dispensed within a storage room, the room shall be designed to prevent critical structural and mechanical damage from an internal explosion in conformance with good engineering practice such as that described in [REF:standard:nfpa68]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote147:short].)

A tire storage area designed to contain more than 375
m3
                            (metric) of rubber tires shall be separated from the
remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not less than 2 h (metric).
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote148:short].)

Where Article 3.2.9.1. of Division B of the British Columbia Fire Code applies due to the quantity and nature of the stored product, and as stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent6:short], [REF:term:bldng]buildings used for the storage of ammonium nitrate shall be classified as [REF:term:mdm-hzrd]medium-hazard industrial occupancies (Group F, Division 2).

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings intended for the storage
of ammonium nitrate shall be not more than one [REF:term:tr]storey in [REF:term:bldng]building height.

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings intended for the storage
of ammonium nitrate shall not

clauses.text: have [REF:term:bmnt]basements or crawl spaces, or

contain open floor drains, tunnels, elevator pits or other pockets
that might trap molten ammonium nitrate.

content.text:
[REF:term:bldng]Buildings intended for the storage
of ammonium nitrate shall have not less than 0.007 m2
                            (metric) of vent area for each square metre of storage area, unless
mechanical ventilation is provided.
All flooring in storage areas described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect6.art6.sent1:short] shall be constructed of [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible materials.

[REF:term:bldng]Buildings intended for the storage
of ammonium nitrate shall be designed to prevent the ammonium nitrate
from coming into contact with [REF:term:bldng]building materials
that

clauses.text: will cause the ammonium nitrate to become unstable,

may corrode or deteriorate by reason of contact with the ammonium
nitrate, or
will become impregnated with the ammonium nitrate.

content.text:
Floors in areas where [REF:term:dngr-gd]dangerous goods are stored shall be constructed of impermeable materials to prevent
the absorption of chemicals.

In [REF:term:prcs-plnt]process plants, areas where
unstable liquids are handled or where small-scale unit chemical processes
occur shall be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
not less than 2 h (metric).

[REF:term:prcs-plnt]Process plants where Class I
and II [REF:term:flmmbl-l]flammable liquids and [REF:term:cmbtbl-l]combustible liquids are handled shall not
be constructed with [REF:term:bmnt]basements or covered
pits.

[REF:term:xt]Exit facilities complying with this
Section shall be provided from every [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is intended for [REF:term:ccpnc] occupancy. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote150:short].)

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art2.sent2:short], if more than one [REF:term:xt] exit is required from
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, each [REF:term:xt]exit shall be separate from every other [REF:term:xt] exit leading from that [REF:term:flr-r]floor area.

If more than 2 [REF:term:xt] exits are provided from
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, [REF:term:xt]exits are permitted to converge in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art1.sent2:long], provided the cumulative capacity of the converging [REF:term:xt]exits does not contribute more than 50% of the total
required [REF:term:xt]exit width for the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area.
[REF:term:cc-t-xt]Access to exits shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3:long]

Subject to the requirements of this Section, an [REF:term:xt]exit from any [REF:term:flr-r] floor area shall
be one of the following, used singly or in combination:

clauses.text: an exterior doorway,
an exterior passageway,
an exterior [REF:term:rmp]ramp,
an exterior stairway,
a fire escape (conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect7:long]),
a [REF:term:hrzntl-x]horizontal exit,
an interior passageway,
an interior [REF:term:rmp]ramp, or
an interior stairway.

content.text:
Access to an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit passageway
from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall be through [REF:term:xt]exit doors at the floor level.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect1.art6.sent2:short], [REF:term:hrzntl-x]horizontal exits shall not comprise
more than one half of the required number of [REF:term:xt]exits from any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area.

In a hospital or nursing home with [REF:term:trtm]treatment, [REF:term:hrzntl-x]horizontal exits serving patients'
sleeping rooms shall comprise not more than two thirds of the required
number of [REF:term:xt]exits from any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote151:short].)

A slide escape shall not be erected on any [REF:term:bldng]building as a required [REF:term:xt]exit, but is
permitted to be provided as an additional egress facility if unusual
hazards are foreseen.

Glass and transparent panels in an [REF:term:xt]exit shall conform to the appropriate requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art20:long] for glass and transparent panels in an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit.
No mirror shall be placed in or adjacent to any [REF:term:xt]exit in a manner that would confuse the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit.

[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible glazing is not permitted
in wall or ceiling assemblies or in [REF:term:clr]closures used to construct an [REF:term:xt]exit enclosure.

subsections.title: Number and Location of Exits from Floor Areas

revisions.text:

egress from a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine shall comply

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art3.sent2:short], the least distance between 2 [REF:term:xt]exits from
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall be

clauses.text:
one half the maximum diagonal dimension of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, but need not be more than 9 m (metric) for
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area having a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, or
one half the maximum diagonal dimension of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, but not less than 9 m (metric) for all other [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas.

content.text: [REF:term:xt]Exits need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art3.sent1:short] where

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is divided so that
not less than one third of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is on each side of a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, and

it is necessary to pass through the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separation to travel from one [REF:term:xt]exit to
another [REF:term:xt]exit.

content.text:
The minimum distance between [REF:term:xt]exits referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art3.sent1:short] shall be the shortest
distance that smoke would have to travel between the [REF:term:xt]exits, assuming that the smoke will not penetrate an intervening [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.
The distance between 2 exterior discharges of [REF:term:xt]exit stairs serving the same [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall be

clauses.text: not less than 9 m (metric), or
not less than 6 m (metric), where

subclauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, and
the 2 exterior discharges are located within 15 m (metric) of a [REF:term:trt]street.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art4.sent2:short], for the purposes of this Subsection, travel distance means the
distance from any point in the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area to an [REF:term:xt]exit measured along the path of travel
to the [REF:term:xt]exit.

The travel distance from a [REF:term:t]suite or a
room not within a [REF:term:t]suite  is permitted to be
measured from an egress door of the [REF:term:t] suite or
room to the nearest [REF:term:xt]exit, provided

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:t]suite or room is separated from the
remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation

subclauses.text:
having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min (metric) in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,
or

which is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating, in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd] sprinklered throughout, and

clauses.text: the egress door opens onto

subclauses.text: an exterior passageway,

a corridor used by the public that is separated from the remainder
of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in conformance with the
requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4:long] for the separation of [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors, or

a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor that is separated
from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area in
conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art4:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote27:long]).

content.text:
Travel distance to an [REF:term:xt]exit shall be
not more than 50 m (metric) from any point in a [REF:term:rvc-pc]service space referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art5.sent6:long], if more than one [REF:term:xt]exit is required from
a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, the [REF:term:xt]exits shall be located so that the travel distance to at least one [REF:term:xt]exit shall be not more than

clauses.text: 25 m in a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd]high-hazard industrial occupancy,

40 m in a [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and personal services
occupancy,

45 m in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that contains
an [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy other than a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd]high-hazard industrial occupancy, provided
it is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout,

105 m in any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, served by
a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, in which rooms and [REF:term:t]suites are not separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided

subclauses.text:
the [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor is not less
than 9 m (metric) wide,
the ceiling height in the [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor is not less than 4 m (metric) above all floor surfaces,
the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, and

not more than one half of the required egress doorways from
a room or [REF:term:t]suite open into the [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor if the room or [REF:term:t]suite is required to have more than one egress doorway,

clauses.text:
60 m in any [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage that
conforms to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long], and

30 m in any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area other than
those referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause1:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause5:short].

content.text:
Except for a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd]high-hazard industrial occupancy, [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1:short] need not apply if [REF:term:xt]exits are placed along the perimeter of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area and are not more than 60 m (metric) apart, measured along the perimeter, provided each main aisle in
the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area leads directly to an [REF:term:xt]exit.

[REF:term:xt]Exits shall be located and arranged
so that they are clearly visible or their locations are clearly indicated
and they are accessible at all times.

For the purposes of this Section, at least one door at every
principal entrance to a [REF:term:bldng]building providing
access from the exterior at ground level shall be designed in accordance
with the requirements for [REF:term:xt]exits.

In a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent1:long], the principal entrance serving a dance hall or
a licensed beverage establishment with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant
load more than 250 shall provide at least one half of the required [REF:term:xt]exit width.

content.text:
For the purpose of determining the aggregate width of [REF:term:xt]exits, the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld] occupant load of every room or [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall be
determined in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect17:long]
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent4:long], the required [REF:term:xt] exit width shall be cumulative if 2 or more [REF:term:xt]exits  converge.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent3:short], the minimum aggregate required width of [REF:term:xt]exits serving [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas intended for [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancies, [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancies, [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and
personal services occupancies, [REF:term:mrcntl-c]mercantile
occupancies, and [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancies shall be determined by multiplying the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant
load of the area served by

clauses.text: 6.1 mm (metric) per person for [REF:term:rmp]ramps with a slope of not more than 1 in 8, doorways, corridors and passageways,

8 mm (metric) per person for a stair consisting of steps
whose rise is not more than 180 mm (metric) and whose [REF:term:run]run is not less than 280 mm (metric), or
9.2 mm (metric) per person for

subclauses.text:

8, or
stairs, other than stairs conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent1.clause2:short].

content.text:
The minimum aggregate width of [REF:term:xt]exits serving [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas intended for a [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:trtm-cc]treatment or [REF:term:dtnt-cc]detention occupancy shall be determined by
multiplying the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of the
area served by 18.4 mm (metric) per person.

The minimum aggregate width of [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of
egress serving a Group A, Division 4 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy shall be determined by multiplying the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant
load of the area served by

clauses.text: 1.8 mm (metric) per person for

subclauses.text: aisles,
stairs other than [REF:term:xt]exit stairs, and

[REF:term:rmp]ramps and passageways in vomitories
and [REF:term:xt]exits, and

clauses.text: 2.4 mm (metric) per person for [REF:term:xt]exit stairs.

content.text:
Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6:short], the required [REF:term:xt] exit width need not be cumulative
in an [REF:term:xt]exit serving 2 or more [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas located one above the other.

The required [REF:term:xt]exit width for an [REF:term:xt]exit stair in an assembly hall or [REF:term:thtr]theatre serving more than one balcony level shall conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.sent6:short].

The required [REF:term:xt]exit width for [REF:term:xt]exit stairs that serve [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected
floor space designed in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art8:long] shall be cumulative, unless

clauses.text:
the stairs provide not less than 0.3 m2
                               (metric) of area of treads and landings for each occupant of the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote154:short]), or

[REF:term:prt-flr-spc]protected floor spaces conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art5:long] are provided at each floor level and
the [REF:term:prt-flr-spc]protected floor space on a floor
level has not less than 0.5 m2
                               (metric) of space
for each occupant of that floor level of the [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected floor space.

content.text:
If more than one [REF:term:xt]exit is required, every [REF:term:xt]exit shall be considered as contributing not more
than one half of the required [REF:term:xt]exit width.

The minimum widths of [REF:term:xt]exits shall conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art2.table1:long]

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art3.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art3.sent4:short], no fixture, turnstile or construction shall project
into or be fixed within the required width of an [REF:term:xt]exit.

Swinging doors in their swing shall not reduce the required
width of [REF:term:xt]exit stairs or landings to less than 750 mm (metric) or reduce the width of an [REF:term:xt]exit passageway to less than the minimum required width.

Doors shall be installed so that, when open, they do not diminish
nor obstruct the required width of the [REF:term:xt]exit.

Handrails and construction below handrails, including handrail
supports and stair stringers, shall not project more than 100
mm (metric) into the required width of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means
of egress.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4.sent4:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4.sent5:short], every [REF:term:xt]exit shall have a clear
height over the clear width of the [REF:term:xt]exit of
not less than 2 050 mm (metric).

The clear height of stairways shall be measured vertically over
the clear width of the stairway, from the straight line tangent to
the tread and landing nosings to the lowest element above. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote38:long])

The clear height of landings shall be measured within the clear
width of the landing vertically to the lowest element above.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect3.art4.sent5:short], the headroom clearance for doorways shall be not less than 2 030 mm (metric).

No door closer or other device shall be installed so as to reduce
the headroom clearance of a doorway to less than 1 980 mm (metric).

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent2:short], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art4.sent3:number], [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art2.sent2:number]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art3.sent1:long], every [REF:term:xt]exit shall be separated
from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation  having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than that required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long], but not less than 45 min (metric), for

clauses.text:
the floor assembly above the [REF:term:tr]storey,
or

the floor assembly below the [REF:term:tr]storey,
if there is no floor assembly above.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:short] need not be more than 2 h (metric).

If an [REF:term:xt]exit  stair in an assembly hall
or [REF:term:thtr]theatre serves more than one balcony
level, the [REF:term:xt]exit stair shall be separated from
the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:short].

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art2.sent2:short], no [REF:term:xt]exit from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey shall lead through a lobby.

Not more than one [REF:term:xt] exit from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is permitted to lead through a lobby,
provided

clauses.text: the lobby floor is not more than 4.5 m (metric) above [REF:term:grade] grade,

the path of travel through the lobby to the outdoors is not
more than  15 m (metric),

the adjacent rooms or premises having direct access to the lobby
do not contain a [REF:term:ca-cc]care, [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial occupancy,

the lobby is not located within an [REF:term:ntrcnnct]interconnected
floor space other than as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8.art2.sent6:long],
the lobby conforms to the requirements for [REF:term:xt]exits, except that

subclauses.text:
rooms other than [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms and
storage rooms are permitted to open onto the lobby,

the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between the
lobby and a room used for the sole purpose of control and supervision
of the [REF:term:bldng] building need not have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating,

the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between the
lobby and adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies that are
permitted to open onto the lobby need not have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  provided the lobby and adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, and

passenger elevators are permitted to open onto the lobby, provided
the elevator doors are designed to remain closed except while loading
and unloading passengers, and

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, constructed
in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:long], is maintained between
the lobby and any [REF:term:xt]exit permitted by this Sentence
to lead through the lobby.

content.text:
The requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art1.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3.art13.sent3:short] do not apply to an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit passageway provided

clauses.text:
not less than 50% of the exterior side is open to the outdoors,
and

an [REF:term:xt]exit stair is provided at each end
of the passageway.

content.text:
A [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation that separates
an [REF:term:xt]exit from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building shall have no openings except for

clauses.text: standpipe and sprinkler piping,
electrical wires and cables, totally enclosed [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible raceways and [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible piping that serve only the [REF:term:xt]exit,
openings required by the provisions of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect6:long],
[REF:term:xt]exit doorways, and
wired glass and glass block permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art16:long]

content.text:
[REF:term:xt]Exits within scissors stairs and other
contiguous [REF:term:xt]exit stairways shall be separated
from each other by a smoke-tight [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  not
less than that required for the floor assembly through which they
pass.

[REF:term:fr-prtn]Fire separations separating contiguous
stairs described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect4.art4.sent2:short] shall
not be pierced by doorways, ductwork, piping or any other openings
that affect the continuity of the separation.

A fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliance shall not
be installed in an [REF:term:xt]exit.

An [REF:term:xt]exit shall not be used as a [REF:term:plnm]plenum for a heating, ventilating or air-conditioning
system.

An [REF:term:xt]exit shall be designed for no purpose
other than for exiting, except that an [REF:term:xt]exit is permitted also to be designed to serve as an access to a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area.

A [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room shall not open directly
into an [REF:term:xt]exit.

Storage rooms, washrooms, toilet rooms, laundry rooms and similar
ancillary rooms shall not open directly into an [REF:term:xt]exit.
[REF:term:rvc-pc]Service spaces referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent8:long] shall not open directly into an [REF:term:xt]exit.

Every [REF:term:xt]exit door shall have an [REF:term:xt]exit sign providing visual information placed over or adjacent
to it if the [REF:term:xt]exit serves

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:bldng]building more than 2 storeys
                               (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building
height,
a [REF:term:bldng]building having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of more than 150, or

a room or [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that has a fire
escape as part of a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress.

content.text: Every [REF:term:xt]exit sign providing visual information shall

clauses.text: be visible on approach to the [REF:term:xt]exit,

consist of a green and white or lightly tinted graphical symbol
meeting the colour specifications referred to in [REF:standard:iso3864-1] and

conform to [REF:standard:iso7010] for the following
symbols (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote157:short]):

subclauses.text: E001 emergency exit (left hand),
E002 emergency exit (right hand),
E005 Direction, arrow (90° increments), safe condition , and
E006 Direction, 45° arrow (90° increments), safe condition .

content.text: Internally illuminated [REF:term:xt]exit signs shall be continuously illuminated and

clauses.text: where illumination of the sign is powered by an electrical circuit, be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:csac22.2no.141] or
where illumination of the sign is not powered by an electrical circuit, be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs572] (See Note A-3.4.5.1.(3).)

content.text:
Externally illuminated [REF:term:xt]exit signs shall
be continuously illuminated and be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs572] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote158:short].)

The circuitry serving lighting for externally and internally
illuminated [REF:term:xt]exit signs shall

clauses.text: serve no equipment other than emergency equipment, and
be connected to an emergency power supply as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art4:long]

content.text:
Where no [REF:term:xt]exit is visible from a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, from a corridor used by the
public in a Group A or B [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, or from principal routes serving an open [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of
more than 150, an [REF:term:xt]exit sign conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2.clause2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2.clause3:short] with an arrow or pointer
indicating the direction of egress shall be provided.

Except for egress doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art4.sent4:long], an [REF:term:xt]exit sign conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent5:short] shall be placed over
or adjacent to every egress doorway from rooms with an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of more than 60 in Group A,
Division 1 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies, dance halls, licensed
beverage establishments, and other similar [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies that, when occupied, have lighting levels below that which would
provide easy identification of the egress doorway.

An [REF:term:xt]exit sign displaying the word “EXIT”
in tactile form that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall
be mounted on the approach side of [REF:term:xt]exit doors
described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art1.sent1:long], in the direction of travel
to the [REF:term:xt]exit.

articles.title: Signs for Stairs and Ramps at Exit Level

content.text:
In a [REF:term:bldng]building more than 2 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, any part of an [REF:term:xt]exit
                           [REF:term:rmp]ramp or stairway that continues up or down past the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl]exit level shall have a posted sign clearly
indicating that it does not lead to an [REF:term:xt]exit.

articles.title: Slip Resistance of Ramps and Stairs

content.text:
The surfaces of [REF:term:rmp]ramps, and landings
and treads

clauses.text: shall have a finish that is slip resistant, and

if accessible to the public, shall have either a colour contrast or a distinctive pattern, readily visible from both directions of travel, to demarcate the leading edge of the tread
and the leading edge of the landing, as well as the beginning and
end of a [REF:term:rmp]ramp.

content.text:
Treads and landings of exterior [REF:term:xt]exit stairs more than 10 m (metric) high shall be designed to be
free of ice and snow accumulations.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art15.sent1:long], every [REF:term:flght]flight of interior stairs shall have not less
than 3 risers.

articles.title: Maximum Vertical Rise of Stair Flights and Required Landings

content.text:
No [REF:term:flght]flight of stairs shall have a
vertical rise of more than 3.7 m (metric) between floors or landings,
except that a [REF:term:flght]flight of stairs serving
as an [REF:term:xt]exit  in a Group B, Division 2 [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy shall have a vertical rise not more
than 2.4 m (metric) between floors or landings.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art3.sent3:short], a landing shall be provided

clauses.text: at the top and bottom of each [REF:term:flght]flight of interior and exterior stairs,
at the top and bottom of every section of [REF:term:rmp]ramp,
where a doorway opens onto a stair or [REF:term:rmp]ramp,
where a [REF:term:rmp]ramp opens onto a stair, and
where a stair opens onto a [REF:term:rmp]ramp.

content.text:
A landing may be omitted at the bottom of an exterior stair
or [REF:term:rmp]ramp, provided there is no gate, door
or fixed obstruction within the lesser of

clauses.text: the width of the stair or [REF:term:rmp]ramp, or
1 100 mm (metric).

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art4.sent2:short], a landing shall be at least as wide and as long as the width of
the stairway in which it occurs.

In a straight stairway and in a stairway that turns less than
90°, the length of the landing need not be more than the lesser of

clauses.text: the required width of stair, or
1 100 mm (metric).

content.text:
The length of a landing shall be measured perpendicular to the
nosing of adjacent steps, at a distance equal to half the length required
in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art4.sent2:short], from the narrow edge
of the landing.
