In [REF:term:bldng]buildings containing Group A, Group B, Division 2 or Group E [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies where at least one of these [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies has an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of more than 500, at least one universal washroom on the [REF:term:tr]storey on which the main [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible entrance to the [REF:term:bldng]building is located shall incorporate an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible change space conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote198:short].)

In [REF:term:ccpn]occupancies or parts of [REF:term:ccpn]occupancies designed to be [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible and used predominantly by children, in patient areas in [REF:term:trtmnt-ccpn]treatment occupancies, and in resident areas in [REF:term:ca-cc]care occupancies, it is permissible to design and locate plumbing fixtures and grab bars differently than described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] to accommodate the special needs of children, patients, residents, and [REF:term:ca]care providers.

In a [REF:term:bldng]building of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancy, all classrooms, auditoria, meeting rooms
and [REF:term:thtr]theatres with an area of more than 100 m2
                            (metric), including courtrooms of any size, shall be equipped with an assistive
listening system complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]

In each location where information, goods or services are provided
to the public at service counters in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancy, at least one
of the service counters shall be equipped with(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote197:short].)

clauses.text:
an assistive listening system or adaptive technology conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long], and

an amplification system, where there is a barrier to communication,
such as a glass screen.

content.text: Unless the degree of [REF:term:ccs]access provided is such as to make these signs unnecessary, signs providing visual information in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be installed to indicate the location of

clauses.text: [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible entrances,
alternative [REF:term:ccs]access routes,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible spaces in seating areas,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible refreshment facilities,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible checkout lanes,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible public telephones,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible washrooms,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible showers,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible passenger-elevating devices,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible parking spaces,
[REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible passenger loading zones, and
assistive listening systems or adaptive technologies.

content.text: Where a washroom is not designed to accommodate persons with physical disabilities in a [REF:term:tr]storey to which an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel is required, signs providing visual and tactile information in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] shall be installed to indicate the location of [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible washrooms.

Except for doors that serve [REF:term:rvc-pc]service spaces or are located within a [REF:term:t]suite, signs installed at or near doors shall provide the same information in both visual and tactile forms in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]
Directional signs shall provide visual information in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote199:short].)

Where a service
counter is provided, at least one section of it shall
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote199:short].) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote184:long])

In each location where one or more public telephones are installed,
at least one telephone shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long]
At least one for every 20 or part thereof of sleeping rooms or bed spaces shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] where provided in

clauses.text: hotels and motels (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent1.clause7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent7:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent8:short]), and

not including apartments and condominiums and the [REF:term:bldng]buildings described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause1:short], other [REF:term:bldng]buildings or parts of [REF:term:bldng]buildings used for [REF:term:rdntl-mjr-ccpn]residential major occupancies (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art20.sent17:short]).

content.text: [REF:term:bldng]Buildings or parts thereof and facilities that are required to be [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible shall be designed in accordance with

clauses.text: this Subsection, or

for each [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible application listed independent of other [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible applications, the applicable provisions of [REF:standard:csab651], "Accessible design for the built environment," listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.table1:long].

content.text: The design of each [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible application listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.table1:long] shall comply entirely with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent1.clause1:short] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent1.clause2:short].

content.title:
Accessible Design Provisions
                                
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent2:short]

content.text: Except as required elsewhere in this Part or as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6:long] pertaining to doorways, the clear width of an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall be not less than 1 000 mm (metric).

The clear width of an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel is permitted to be reduced to not less than 850 mm (metric) for a length of not more than 600 mm (metric), provided the clear floor space at either end of the reduced-clear width section is level within a rectangular area

clauses.text: with a dimension parallel to each end of the reduced-clear width section is not less than 1 000 mm (metric), and
with a dimension perpendicular to each end of the reduced-clear width section is not less than 1 500 mm (metric).

content.text: Interior and exterior walking surfaces that are within an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall

clauses.text: have no opening that will permit the passage of a sphere more than 13 mm (metric) in diameter,
have any elongated openings oriented approximately perpendicular to the direction of travel,
be stable, firm and slip-resistant,
have a cross slope no steeper than 1 in 50,
be beveled at a maximum slope of 1 in 2 at changes in level between 6 mm (metric) and 13 mm (metric),
be provided with sloped floors or [REF:term:rmp]ramps at changes in level more than 13 mm (metric), and
be designed as a ramp complying with this Section where the path of travel has a slope steeper than 1 in 20.

content.text: An [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel is permitted to include [REF:term:rmp]ramps, passenger elevators or other platform-equipped passenger-elevating devices to overcome a difference in level.

The width of an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel that is more than 24 m (metric) long shall be increased to not less than 1 700 mm (metric) for a length of 1 700 mm (metric) at intervals not exceeding 24 m (metric).
Where a section of an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel is less than 1 500 mm (metric) wide for a distance of more than 12 m (metric), it shall end in a clear floor space that is

clauses.text: not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in diameter,
not less than 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric), or

T-shaped with overall dimensions measuring 1 700 mm (metric) wide by 1 500 mm (metric) long, where the two arms of the "T" are not less than 1 000 mm (metric) wide and extend not less than 300 mm (metric) from each side of the base of the "T" and the base is not less than 1 000 mm (metric) wide and extends not less than 500 mm (metric) from each arm.

content.text: An [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall be equipped to provide illumination in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent1:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent2:short]. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art1.sent3:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part9.sect34.subsect2.art7:long].)
Exterior walks that form part of a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall

clauses.text: have a slip-resistant, continuous and even surface,
be not less than 1 600 mm wide (metric),

have a level area conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause3:long] adjacent
to an entrance doorway, and

be designed in
accordance with [REF:external:csab651]Clause 8.2.1 of 
                              [REF:standard:csab651]

content.text: If a passenger-loading zone is provided, it shall have

clauses.text: an access aisle not less than 1 500 mm (metric) wide and 6 000 mm (metric) long adjacent and parallel to the vehicle pull-up space,

a curb ramp, designed in accordance with Clause 8.3.3. of [REF:standard:csab651], "Accessible design for the built environment," where there are curbs between the access aisle and the vehicle pull-up space, and
a clear height of not less than 2 750 mm (metric) at the pull-up space and along the vehicle access and egress routes.

content.text: A [REF:term:rmp]ramp located in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall

clauses.text: have a clear width not less than 1 000 mm (metric) (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote155:long]),

have a uniform
slope along its length not more than 1 in 12 (metric) (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote204:short]),

have a level area not less than 1 700 mm by 1 700 mm (metric) at
the top and bottom and at intermediate levels of a [REF:term:rmp]ramp leading to a door, so that on the latch side the level
area extends not less than (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote205:short]),

subclauses.text:
600 mm (metric) beyond the edge of the door opening where
the door opens towards the [REF:term:rmp]ramp, or

300 mm (metric) beyond the edge of the door opening where
the door opens away from the [REF:term:rmp]ramp,

clauses.text:
have a level area not less than 1 350 mm long (metric) and at least
the same width as the [REF:term:rmp]ramp

subclauses.text:
at intervals not more than 9 m (metric) along its length,
and
where there is an abrupt change in the direction of the [REF:term:rmp]ramp, and

clauses.text:
except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent2:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent3:short], be equipped with handrails conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art5:long], except that they shall be not less than 865 mm (metric) and not more than 965 mm (metric) high, and

be equipped with [REF:term:guard]guards conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art6:long]

content.text:
Handrails installed in addition to required handrails need not
comply with the height requirements stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause5:medium].

The requirement for handrails in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause5:medium] need not apply to a [REF:term:rmp]ramp serving
as an aisle for fixed seating.

The surfaces of [REF:term:rmp]ramps and landings
shall

clauses.text: be hard or resilient where the [REF:term:rmp]ramp is steeper than 1 in 15 (metric) (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote206:short]),
have a cross slope no steeper than 1 in 50 (metric), and
where exposed to water, be designed to drain.

content.text:
[REF:term:rmp]Ramps and landings not at ground level or adjacent to a wall shall have edge protection
consisting of

clauses.text: a curb not less than 75 mm (metric) high, or
a raised barrier or rail located not more than 100 mm (metric) from the [REF:term:rmp]ramp or landing surface.

content.text:
Except where stated otherwise, this Article applies to swinging
and sliding doors.
Every doorway that is located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall have a clear width not less than 850 mm (metric)

clauses.text: for swinging doors, when measured from the face of the active leaf, in the open position of 90° to the doorway, to the outside edge of the stop on the door frame, and
for sliding doors, when measured from the edge of the door, in the open position, to the outside of the stop on the door frame.

content.text:
Doorways in a path of travel to at least one bathroom within
a [REF:term:t]suite of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancy shall have a clear width not less than 850 mm (metric) when measured in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent2:short]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote208:short].)
Door-operating devices shall

clauses.text: comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long], and
be operable at a height between 900 mm (metric) and 1 100 mm (metric) above the floor. (See also  regarding additional devices.)

content.text:
A threshold for a doorway referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent3:short] shall be not more than 13 mm (metric) higher than the finished floor surface and shall be
beveled to facilitate the passage of wheelchairs.
Power door operators required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art7.sent1:long] shall

clauses.text: activate automatically or through the use of controls that

subclauses.text:
are located in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path
of travel,
are marked with the International Symbol of Access,
are located clear of the door swing and not less than 600 mm (metric) and no more than 1 500 mm (metric) from that door swing,
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause1.subclause3:long],

are operable from a height between 150 mm (metric) and 300 mm (metric) as well as between 900 mm (metric) and 1
100 mm (metric) above the floor, and

are operable by touching or approaching any part of their surface
with a fist, arm or foot, and

clauses.text: unless equipped with safety sensors,

subclauses.text: fully open the door in not less than 3 s (metric), and

require a force not more than 65 N (metric) to stop movement
of the door.

content.text:
A cane-detectable [REF:term:guard]guard shall be
installed on the hinged side of power-assisted doors that swing open
into the path of travel. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote210:short].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent9:short] and except for a door with a power door operator complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent6:short], when unlatched, a door in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall open when
the force applied to the handle, push plate or latch-releasing device
is not more than

clauses.text: 38 N (metric) in the case of an exterior swinging door,

22 N (metric) in the case of an interior swinging door,
or
22 N (metric) in the case of a sliding door.

content.text:
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent8:short] does not apply to a
door at the entrance to a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, or where greater forces are required in order to close and latch
the door against the prevailing difference in air pressure on opposite
sides of the door. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote211:short].)

Except for a door at the entrance to a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, a closer for an interior door in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall have a closing
period of not less than 3 s (metric) measured from when the door
is in an open position of 70° (metric) to the doorway, to when
the door reaches a point 75 mm (metric) from the closed position,
measured from the leading edge of the latch side of the door. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote212:short].)

Unless equipped with a power door operator complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent6:short], a swinging door in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall have a clear
space on the latch side extending the height of the doorway and not
less than

clauses.text:
600 mm (metric) beyond the edge of the door opening if the
door swings toward the approach side, and

300 mm (metric) beyond the edge of the door opening if the
door swings away from the approach side.

content.text:
A vestibule located in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall be arranged to allow the movement of wheelchairs
between doors and shall provide a distance between 2 doors in series
of not less than 1 350 mm (metric) plus the width of any door that swings
into the space in the path of travel from one door to another.

Only the active leaf in a multiple-leaf door in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel need conform to
the requirements of this Article.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent16:short], the clear floor space on the pull
side of a swinging door in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall be level within a rectangular area of not less
than 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric) measured from
the hinged side of the door. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote214:short].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art5.sent1.clause3:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent16:short], the clear floor space on the push side of a swinging
door and on each side of a sliding door in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall be level
within a rectangular area

clauses.text:
whose dimension
parallel to the closed door is not less than 1 200 mm (metric), and

whose dimension perpendicular to the closed door is not less
than 1 500 mm (metric).

content.text:
Where a door referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent14:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent15:short] is equipped with a power door operator complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent6:short], the width of the clear floor space
parallel to the closed door is permitted to be reduced to not less
than 1 000 mm (metric). (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote214:short].)

Except for facilities for persons with cognitive disabilities
such as dementia, doorways leading from a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public
corridor or a corridor used by the public that provide access
to a public area or an [REF:term:xt]exit shall be provided
with a door or door frame that has a readily apparent visual contrast
with adjacent wall surfaces. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote215:short].) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote164:long].)
A passenger-elevating device referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3:long] located in an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel shall

clauses.text: conform to

subclauses.text: Appendix E of ASME A17.1/CSA B44, "Safety Code for Elevators and Escalators," or
[REF:standard:csab355], "Platform lifts and stair lifts for barrier-free access,"

clauses.text: have a clear floor space not less than 1 500 mm long (metric) by 1 000 mm wide (metric), and
have entry doors or gates

subclauses.text: providing a clear width not less than 850 mm (metric) in the open position if located on the short side of the passenger-elevating device, or
providing a clear width not less than 1 000 mm (metric) in the open position if located at either end of the long side of the passenger-elevating device.

content.text: Controls described in this Section shall

clauses.text: where located in a [REF:term:tr]storey where an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel is required and unless otherwise stated,

subclauses.text: be in or adjacent to the [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel,
be mounted 400 mm (metric) to 1 200 mm (metric) above the floor, and
be adjacent to and centred on either the length or the width of a clear floor space of 1 350 mm (metric) by 800 mm (metric),

clauses.text: be operable

subclauses.text: with one hand in a closed fist position, without requiring tight grasping, pinching with fingers, or twisting of the wrist, and
unless otherwise stated, with a force not more than 22 N (metric), and

clauses.text: where controls provide a feedback signal to the user, it shall be both audible and visible (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote217:short]).

content.text: Electrical outlets described in this Section shall be located in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause1.subclause2:short]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote195:short].)

Visual information signs required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:long] shall comply with [REF:external:csab651]Clauses
4.5.1, 4.5.2, 4.5.3 and 4.5.4 of 
                           [REF:standard:csab651] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote217:short].)

Tactile information signs required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:long] shall

clauses.text:
have Braille and tactile characters in accordance with [REF:external:csab651]Clauses 4.5.6.2 and 4.5.6.3 of 
                              [REF:standard:csab651]

be installed on the wall closest to the latch side of the door
or on the nearest wall on the right side of the door, where there
is no wall at the latch side, and

be centred 1 500 mm (metric) above the finished floor with
the edge of the sign located not more than 300 mm (metric) from
the door.

content.text:
Signs required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art10:long] shall incorporate
the International Symbol of Access, Modified International Symbol of Access, or the International Symbol of
Access for Hearing Loss and appropriate graphical or textual information
that clearly indicates the type of facilities available. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote218:short].)
Drinking fountains required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent10:long] shall be equipped with controls that

clauses.text: activate automatically, or
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and are located on the front or on both sides of the fountain.

content.text: Where drinking fountains referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art10.sent1:short] are located in a [REF:term:tr]storey where an [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel is required, they shall

clauses.text: be located along the [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel,
have a minimum clear floor space of 800 mm (metric) by 1 350 mm (metric) in front of them,
where they have frontal access, provide a knee clearance in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause5:long], and
have a spout that

subclauses.text: is located near the front of the unit, at a height between 750 mm (metric) and 915 mm (metric) above the floor, and
directs water flow in a trajectory that is nearly parallel to the front of the unit, at a height not less than 100 mm (metric).

content.text: Water-bottle filling stations required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent11:long] shall be equipped with controls that

clauses.text: activate automatically, or
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long].

content.text:
Water-bottle filling stations required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent11:long] that are located in a [REF:term:tr]storey where a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel
is required shall

clauses.text: be located along the [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel,

have a clear floor space of 800 mm (metric) by 1 350
mm (metric) in front of them (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote219:short]),

where they have frontal access, provide a knee clearance in
accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause5:long],

be operable at a height of not more than 1 200 mm (metric) above the floor (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote219:short]),
and
be equipped with controls that

subclauses.text: activate automatically, or
comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1:long].

content.text: Water-closet stalls and enclosures required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent5:long] shall

clauses.text: be not less than 1 500 mm (metric) wide by 1 500 mm (metric) deep,

have a clear lateral transfer space adjacent to the water closet
that

subclauses.text:
is at least 1 500 mm (metric) long, measured from the wall
behind the water closet, and

is at least 900 mm (metric) wide, measured from the closest
edge of the water closet seat,

clauses.text: have a clear floor space of 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 700 mm (metric) in front of the accessible stall,
be equipped with a door that

subclauses.text: can be latched from the inside with a mechanism located 900 mm (metric) to 1 100 mm (metric) above the floor that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long],

is aligned with either the transfer space adjacent to the water
closet or with a clear floor space not less than 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 700
mm (metric) within the stall,

provides a clear opening not less than 850 mm (metric) wide
when it is open,

is self-closing so that, when at rest, the door is ajar by not
more than 50 mm beyond the jamb,

swings outward, unless there is sufficient floor space within
the stall for the door to swing inward in addition to a clear floor
space of at least 800 mm (metric) by 1 350 mm (metric) (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote221:short]),

where the door swings outward, is provided with a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting door pull not less than 140 mm (metric) long located on the inside such that its midpoint is 200 mm (metric) to 300 mm (metric) from the hinged side of the door and 900 mm (metric) to 1 100 mm (metric) above the floor (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote222:short]), and

is provided with a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting
door pull not less than 140 mm (metric) long located on the outside
such that its midpoint is 120 mm (metric) to 220 mm (metric) from the latch side and 900 mm (metric) to 1 100 mm (metric) above the floor,

clauses.text:
have a water closet located so that the distance between the
centre line of the fixture and the wall on one side is 460 mm (metric) to 480 mm (metric),
be equipped with an L-shaped grab bar that

subclauses.text: is mounted on the side wall closest to the water closet,

has horizontal and vertical components not less than 760
mm (metric) long mounted with the horizontal component 750 mm (metric) to 850 mm (metric) above the floor and the vertical component 150 mm (metric) in front of the water closet (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote223:short]), and
complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long],

clauses.text: be equipped with either one grab bar at least 600 mm (metric) long and centred over the water closet, or two grab bars at least 300 mm (metric) long and located either side of the flush valve, that

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long],
are mounted on the rear wall, and

are mounted at the same height as the grab bar on the side wall
or 100 mm (metric) above the top of the attached water tank, if
applicable,

clauses.text:
be equipped with a coat hook mounted not more than 1 200
mm (metric) above the floor on a side wall and projecting not more than 50 mm (metric) from the wall, and

be equipped with a toilet paper dispenser mounted on the side
wall closest to the water closet such that

subclauses.text: the bottom of the dispenser is 600 mm (metric) to 800 mm (metric) above the floor, and

the closest edge of the dispenser is 300 mm (metric) from
the front of the water closet.

content.text: A universal washroom shall

clauses.text:
be served by a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path
of travel,
have a door complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6:long] that

subclauses.text:
has a latch-operating mechanism located 900 mm (metric) to 1 100 mm (metric) above
the floor that complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and is capable
of being locked from the inside, and released from the outside in
case of emergency, and

if it is an outward swinging door that is not self-closing,
has a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting door pull not less than 140 mm (metric) long located on
the inside so that its midpoint is not less than 200 mm (metric) and not more than 300 mm (metric) from the hinged side of the
door and not less than 900 mm (metric) and not more than 1 100 mm (metric) above
the floor (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote222:long]),

clauses.text: have one lavatory conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16:long],
have one water closet conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art14:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause5:long],

have a clear lateral transfer space adjacent to the water closet
that conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause2:long],

have grab bars conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause6:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause7:short],
have a coat hook conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause8:long],
have a toilet paper dispenser conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause9:long],

unless a counter space of not less than 200 mm (metric) by 400 mm (metric) is provided, have a shelf located not more than 1 200 mm (metric) above the floor with a useable surface of not less than 200 mm (metric) by 400 mm (metric),

be designed to permit a wheelchair to turn in an open space
not less than 1
700 mm (metric) in diameter, and
provide emergency lighting conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3:long].

content.text:
A universal washroom required to have an accessible change space
as stipulated in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent15:long] shall

clauses.text: be equipped with an adult-sized change table that is

subclauses.text: designed to carry a minimum load of 1.3 kN (metric),
impervious to water, and
designed to be easily cleaned,

clauses.text:
have a clear floor space to accommodate the adult-sized change
table that is 810 mm (metric) wide by 1 830 mm (metric) long
and does not overlap with the clear spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art13.sent1.clause5:medium]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art13.sent1.clause10:medium] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art13.sent2.clause3:shortNum], and

have a clear transfer space of 900 mm (metric) by 1 350 mm (metric) adjacent to the long side of the clear floor space
for the adult-sized change table.

content.text: A water closet for a person with physical disabilities shall

clauses.text: be equipped with a seat located 430 mm (metric) to 480 mm (metric) above the floor,
flush automatically or be equipped with a flushing control that

subclauses.text:
is located 500 mm (metric) to 900 mm (metric) above
the floor,

is located no more than 350 mm (metric) from the transfer
side, and
complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long],

clauses.text: be equipped with a seat lid or other back support, and
where it has a tank, have a securely attached tank top.

articles.title:
Water-Closet Stalls
and Urinals for Persons with Limited Mobility

content.text:
Water-closet stalls for persons with limited mobility required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent7:long] shall

clauses.text: be at least 1 500 mm (metric) deep and 890 mm (metric) to 940 mm (metric) wide,
be equipped with a door that

subclauses.text:
has a latch-operating mechanism conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] that can be locked from the inside and released
from the outside in the event of an emergency,

provides a clear opening not less than 850 mm (metric) wide
when it is open, measured in accordance with ,

swings outward, unless the minimum dimensions required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art15.sent1.clause1:short] do not overlap with the area of the
door swing,

is self-closing so that, when at rest, the door is ajar by not
more than 50 mm (metric) beyond the jamb, and

has a horizontal, D-shaped, visually contrasting door pull on both sides of the door, near the latch side,
located 900 mm (metric) to 1 100 mm (metric) above the finished
floor,

clauses.text: have one water closet conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art14:long] centred within the stall,
have a horizontal grab bar conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long] on each side of the water closet that

subclauses.text:
is located 750 mm (metric) to 850 mm (metric) above
the floor,

begins not more than 300 mm (metric) from the wall behind
the water closet, and

extends at least 450 mm (metric) in front of the toilet
seat, and

clauses.text:
be equipped with a coat hook mounted not more than 1 200
mm (metric) above the floor on a side wall and projecting not more than 50 mm (metric) from the wall.

content.text: Urinals described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent6:long] shall

clauses.text: be wall-mounted, with the rim located not more than 430 mm (metric) above the floor,
be adjacent to an [REF:term:ccbl-rt]accessible route,

have a clear width of approach that is at least 800 mm (metric) wide by 1 350 mm (metric) long centred on the urinal and unobstructed
by privacy screens,
have no step in front of it,
have a flush control that

subclauses.text: is automatic, or
complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and is located 900 mm (metric) to 1 100 mm (metric) above the floor, and

clauses.text: have a vertically mounted grab bar installed on each side that

subclauses.text: complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7:long],
is not less than 600 mm (metric) long, with its centre line 1 000 mm (metric) above the floor, and

is located not more than 380 mm from the centre line of the
urinal.

content.text: Lavatories required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent8:long] shall

clauses.text: be equipped with faucets complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art3.sent4:long],

be located so that the distance between the centre line of the
lavatory and any side wall is not less than 460 mm (metric),

have a clear floor space in front of the lavatory that is at
least

subclauses.text: 800 mm wide (metric), centred on the lavatory, and

1 350 mm long (metric), of which no more than 430
mm (metric) is beneath the lavatory,

clauses.text:
have a rim height not more than 865 mm (metric) above the
floor,
have a clearance beneath the lavatory not less than

subclauses.text: 800 mm wide (metric), centred on the lavatory,
735 mm high (metric) at the front edge,

685 mm high (metric) at a point 200 mm (metric) back
from the front edge, and

230 mm high (metric) over the distance from a point 280 mm (metric) to a point 430 mm (metric) back from the front
edge,

clauses.text:
have insulated water supply and drain pipes where these pipes
are exposed (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote227:short]),
have a soap dispenser that

subclauses.text: is automatic, or

complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long] and is located not
more than 1 100 mm (metric) above the floor, within 500
mm (metric) from the front of the lavatory (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote228:short]), and

clauses.text:
have a towel dispenser or other hand-drying equipment located
close to the lavatory, not more than 1 200 mm (metric) above the
floor in an area that is accessible to persons using wheelchairs.

content.text: Mirrors required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent9:long] shall be

clauses.text: mounted with their bottom edge not more than 1 000 mm (metric) above the floor, or

fixed in an inclined position so as to be usable by a person
in a wheelchair.

content.text: Showers required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent12:long] shall

clauses.text: be not less than 1 500 mm (metric) wide and 900 mm (metric) deep,

have a clear floor space at the entrance to the shower that
is not less than 900 mm (metric) deep and the same width as the
shower, except that fixtures are permitted to project into that space
provided they do not restrict access to the shower (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote229:short]),

have no doors or curtains that obstruct the controls or the
clear floor space at the entrance to the shower,
have a slip-resistant floor surface,

have a threshold not more than 13 mm (metric) higher than
the finished floor, and where it is higher than 6 mm (metric),
beveled to a slope no steeper than 1 in 2,
have 2 grab bars

subclauses.text: that conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7.sent1:long],

one of which is not less than 1 000 mm (metric) long and
located vertically on the side wall 50 mm (metric) to 80
mm (metric) from the adjacent clear floor space, with its lower end 600 mm (metric) to 650 mm (metric) above the floor, and,

one of which is L-shaped and located on the wall opposite the
entrance to the shower, with a horizontal member not less than 1 000 mm (metric) long mounted 750 mm (metric) to 870 mm (metric) above the floor and a vertical member not less than 750 mm (metric) long mounted 400 mm (metric) to 500 mm (metric) from the
side wall on which the other vertical grab bar is mounted,

clauses.text: have a hinged seat that is not spring-loaded or a fixed seat with a smooth, slip-resistant surface and no rough edges, the seat being

subclauses.text: not less than 450 mm (metric) wide and 400 mm (metric) deep,
mounted on the same side wall as the vertical grab bar, at 460 mm (metric) to 480 mm (metric) above the floor,
designed to carry a minimum load of 1.3 kN (metric),
impervious to water, and
designed to be easily cleaned,

clauses.text:
have a pressure-equalizing or thermostatic-mixing valve and
other controls that

subclauses.text: comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long],

are mounted on the wall opposite the entrance to the shower
at not more than 1 200 mm (metric) above the floor and within
reach of the seat,

clauses.text:
have a hand-held shower head with not less than 1 800
mm (metric) of flexible hose located so that it

subclauses.text: can be reached from a seated position,
can be used in a fixed position at a height of 1 200 mm (metric) and 2 030 mm (metric), and
does not obstruct the use of the grab bars, and

clauses.text:
have recessed soap holders that can be reached from the seated
position.

content.text: A universal dressing and shower room required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent13:long] shall

clauses.text:
be located in a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path
of travel,

have a door capable of being locked from the inside and released
from the outside in the event of an emergency,
have a lavatory and a mirror conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16:long],
have a shower conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art17.sent1:short],
have a bench that is

subclauses.text: at least 1 830 mm (metric) long by 760 mm (metric) wide and 480 mm (metric) to 520 mm (metric) high,
designed to carry a minimum load of 1.3 kN (metric),
impervious to water, and
designed to be easily cleaned,

clauses.text:
have a clear transfer space adjacent to the long side of the
bench that is 900 mm wide (metric) and as long as the bench (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote231:short]), and
have a coat hook conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause8:long], and
provide emergency lighting conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect7.art3:long].

content.text: A bathtub required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8.sent14:long] shall

clauses.text:
be located in a room with a clear floor space not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in
diameter,
be not less than 1 500 mm (metric) long,

have a clear floor space at the entrance to the bathtub that is not less than 900 mm (metric) wide adjacent to its entire deep and at least the same length as the bathtub, except that fixtures are permitted to project into that space provided they do not restrict access to the shower,

be capable of being accessed along its full length with no tracks
mounted on its rim,
have a pressure-equalizing or thermostatic mixing valve faucets and other controls that

subclauses.text: conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art8.sent1.clause2:long], and

are located on the centre line or between the centre line of
the bathtub and the exterior edge of the bathtub rim, at a maximum
height of 450 mm (metric) above the rim,

clauses.text: have three grab bars

subclauses.text: that conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art7.sent1:long],
that are not less than 1 200 mm (metric) long,

two of which are located vertically at each end of the bathtub,
set 80 mm (metric) to 120 mm (metric) in from the outside
edge of the bathtub, with their lower end 180 mm (metric) to 280 mm (metric) above the bathtub rim, and

one of which is located horizontally along the length of the
bathtub at 180 mm (metric) to 280 mm (metric) above the bathtub
rim,

clauses.text: have a slip-resistant bottom surface, and

be equipped with a hand-held shower head with not less than 1 800 mm (metric) of flexible hose that can be used in a fixed position
at a height of 1 200 mm (metric) and 2 030 mm (metric).

content.text:
Assistive listening
systems required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art9.sent1:long] shall encompass the entire seating area.

Assistive listening systems or adaptive technologies  required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art9.sent2:long] shall provide for the clear
communication required for the exchange of information, goods and
services.

A section of a
service counter required to be [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art11.sent1:long] shall

clauses.text:
be not less than 800 mm (metric) long centred over a knee space conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art20.sent1.clause3:short],
have a surface not more than 865 mm (metric) above the floor, and

where forward-facing
interaction with a person or a device is required, have a knee space underneath it that is (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote233:short])

subclauses.text: not less than 800 mm (metric) wide,
not less than 685 mm (metric) high, and
not less than 485 mm (metric) deep.

content.text: A telephone required to be [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art12:long] shall

clauses.text:
be adjacent to and centred on either the length or the width
of a clear floor space not less than 1 350 mm (metric) by 800 mm (metric),

where a forward approach is provided, have a knee space underneath
it conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art20.sent1.clause3:long], and

be located so that its receiver and operable parts are not more
than 1 200 mm (metric) above the floor.

content.text:
Where provided,
shelves or counters for public telephones shall

clauses.text: be level,
be not less than 305 mm (metric) deep,
have, for each telephone provided, a clear space not less than 250 mm (metric) wide having no obstruction within 250 mm (metric) above the surface, and
have a section with a surface not more than 865 mm (metric) above the floor serving at least one telephone.

content.text:
Spaces designated for wheelchair use in [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancies as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent3:long] shall conform to the
following:

clauses.text:
at least one designated
space shall be clear and level for each increment of 200 seats (metric) and the remaining designated spaces shall be level and have removable seats,

they shall be not less than 900 mm (metric) wide and 1 700 mm (metric) long
to permit a wheelchair to enter from a side approach and 1 350 mm (metric) long
where the wheelchair enters from the front or rear of the space,
they shall be arranged so that

subclauses.text: at least two designated spaces are located side by side, and

at least one fixed
seat is located beside each designated space,

clauses.text:
they shall be located adjoining a [REF:term:brrr-fr]accessible path of travel without infringing on egress from any row of seating
or any aisle requirements, and

they shall be situated, as part of the designated seating plan,
to provide a choice of viewing location and a clear view of the event
taking place.

content.text:
Spaces designated for wheelchair use in waiting rooms or areas
as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent4:long] shall

clauses.text: be clear and level, and

comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art22.sent1.clause2:medium]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art22.sent1.clause4:short].

content.text: Adaptable seats required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent5:long] shall

clauses.text:
be located adjoining an aisle without infringing on egress from
any row of seating or any aisle requirements,

be equipped with a movable or removable armrest on the side
of the seat adjoining the aisle, and

be situated, as part of the designated seating plan, to provide
a choice of viewing location and a clear view of the event taking
place.

content.text: Storage spaces for mobility aids shall be provided in a location

clauses.text:
that is on the same level as and in proximity to the adaptable
seats required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3.sent5:long],

that is within the room side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separation required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect2.art2:long], and
where they will not infringe on egress.

content.text: Sleeping rooms and bed spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art13.sent1:short] to be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible shall have

clauses.text: a clear floor space that permits a turning area of not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in diameter, or not less than 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric), that could be adjacent a bed,
a pathway clearance of not less than 1 000 mm (metric) wide, that could be unobstructed by a bed, to allow functional use of the bedroom,
at least one closet that provides

subclauses.text: a clear opening width of not less than 900 mm (metric),

a clear floor space, that need not be separate from the turning areas required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art23.sent1.clause1:short], of not less than 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric) on at least one side of the closet (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art6.sent1:short])
clothes hanger rods capable of being lowered to a height of not more than 1 200 mm (metric), and
at least one shelf capable of being lowered to a height of not more than 1 200 mm (metric),

clauses.text: when a balcony is provided, an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible path of travel to an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible balcony conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7.sent4:short],

except for dedicated electrical outlets for equipment and appliances, where controls, switches and outlets are intended for frequent operation, they shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long], and
a bathroom, where provided as part of the sleeping room or bed space, or [REF:term:cc]access to a bathroom, where not provided as part of the sleeping room or bed space

subclauses.text:
conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause1:medium]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause2:number]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause5:number]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause6:number]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause7:number]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause8:number]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause9:short] with a water closet conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art14:long],
provided with a lavatory and mirror conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16:long], and

provided with a shower conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art17:long] or a bathtub conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art18:long], only to the extent of providing the same type of facilities provided in sleeping rooms and bed spaces where [REF:term:cc]access is not required.

subsections.title: Alterations and Additions to Existing Buildings

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art1.sent2:short], [REF:term:cc]access as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art8:number] shall be provided

clauses.text: to additions to existing [REF:term:bldng]buildings where such additions have internal path of travel connections with the existing [REF:term:bldng]buildings,
to existing parts of [REF:term:bldng]buildings to which additions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art1.sent1.clause1:short] are made, and
to the extent required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art5:long], to existing [REF:term:bldng]buildings

subclauses.text: where the [REF:term:ccpn]occupancy is changed, or
that are altered or renovated.

content.text: This Subsection does not apply to

clauses.text: [REF:term:bldng]buildings of new construction,

vertical additions of one [REF:term:tr]storey not more than 600 m2
                               (metric) in [REF:term:flr-r]floor area regardless of [REF:term:ccpn]occupancy, or

horizontal or vertical additions to [REF:term:ccpn]occupancies described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause1:medium]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause3:number].

revisions.text: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5:long] does not apply to [REF:term:altns]alterations to existing [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy.
revisions.change_summary: Added new Sentence 3 stating that Subsection 3.8.5. does not apply to alterations to existing buildings of residential occupancy

content.text: Exterior [REF:term:cc]access shall be provided to an addition except where [REF:term:cc]access to the addition is provided by way of the existing [REF:term:bldng]building.
Walks and ramps for an addition shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long].
An entrance to an addition shall be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible except where

clauses.text: the addition is [REF:term:ccbl]accessible by an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible path of travel from an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible entrance serving the existing [REF:term:bldng]building, and
not less than 50% of the pedestrian entrances to the [REF:term:bldng]building are [REF:term:ccbl]accessible.

content.text:
Where there is a vertical addition of one [REF:term:tr]storey and of more than 600 m2
                            (metric) in [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, or of two or more [REF:term:tr]storeys regardless of [REF:term:flr-r]floor area,

clauses.text: [REF:term:cc]access shall be provided to all additional [REF:term:tr]storeys, and

the additional [REF:term:tr]storeys shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:medium]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short].

content.text:
Where an existing [REF:term:bldng]building is extended horizontally, the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] shall be applied to the addition except as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art6:short], and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art8.sent2:long].

Where an existing [REF:term:bldng]building is altered or renovated, or where the [REF:term:ccpn]occupancy is changed, [REF:term:cc]access shall be provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:short] where providing such [REF:term:cc]access would be practical.

Where sleeping rooms or bed spaces are provided in an addition, the percentage of [REF:term:ccbl]accessible sleeping rooms or bed spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:long] to conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art23:long] shall be based on the sum of sleeping rooms or bed spaces in the addition and in the existing [REF:term:bldng]building.

The [REF:term:ccbl]accessible sleeping rooms or bed spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art6.sent1:short] may be distributed between the addition and the existing [REF:term:bldng]building.

Where an addition is required to be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible, facilities located in the existing [REF:term:bldng]building that are necessary to the operation of the addition shall be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible.

Where [REF:term:ltrtn]alterations are made to an existing [REF:term:bldng]building, universal washrooms complying with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] are permitted to be provided in lieu of facilities for [REF:term:prsns-wth-phscl-dsblts]persons with disabilities in washrooms. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote205:short].)
The egress requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7:long] shall apply to the vertical additions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect4.art3.sent1:long].

Where an existing [REF:term:tr]storey is extended horizontally and the [REF:term:bldng]building is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, the protection requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7:long] shall apply to

clauses.text: the extended portion of the [REF:term:tr]storey, or
the combined area of the existing [REF:term:tr]storey and the extension.

revisions.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art1.sent2:short], this Subsection applies to
                              
                                 one [REF:term:tr-dwllng-nt]storey dwelling units served by an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible interior [REF:term:pblc-crrd]public corridor and an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible common [REF:term:bldng]building entrance, as required to be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art2:medium]
                                    [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3:short], and
                              
                              
                                 common spaces and facilities intended for use by the residents of the [REF:term:dwllng-nt]dwelling units described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art1.sent1.clause1:short] including common rooftop [REF:term:ccpn]occupancies.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art1.sent2:short], and as specified by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art1.sent3:short], this Subsection applies to
                                 
                                    one [REF:term:tr-dwllng-nt]storey dwelling units served by an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible interior [REF:term:pblc-crrd]public corridor and an [REF:term:ccbl]accessible common [REF:term:bldng]building entrance, as required to be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art2:medium]
                                       [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art3:short], and
                                 
                                 
                                    common spaces and facilities intended for use by the residents of the [REF:term:dwllng-nt]dwelling units described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art1.sent1.clause1:short] including common rooftop [REF:term:ccpn]occupancies.
revisions.change_summary: Repealed and substituted Sentence 3.8.5.1.(1) to add reference to Sentence (3) for adaptable dwelling units requirement

content.text: [REF:term:bldng]Buildings described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause1:long] including [REF:term:scndr-t]secondary suites and all other [REF:term:dwllng-nt]dwelling units to which this Section applies shall, as required by Sections 3.7. and 9.31., provide at least one bathroom with walls reinforced in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art7.sent1.clause5:long].

revisions.text: 3) At least one for every five or part thereof of [REF:term:dwllng-nt]dwelling units described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art1.sent1.clause1:short] shall conform to this Subsection. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.appnoteA-3.8.5.1.3:long].)
revisions.change_summary: Added new sentence requiring one in five dwelling units to be adaptable

content.text: The construction of [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling units and the [REF:term:bldng]building in which they are located shall conform to the requirements of this Subsection and, as required by this Subsection, to [REF:term:cc]access requirements for [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy elsewhere in this Code.
Unless otherwise required, clear areas and spaces required in this Subsection are permitted to overlap with other clear area and space requirements.

This Subsection does not require an [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit be provided with a living space, a bedroom, a bathroom or a kitchen, but when provided, those spaces and the paths connecting them shall conform to the applicable requirements of this Subsection.

revisions.text: References in this Subsection to provisions in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3:long] are permitted to be designed to the applicable provisions of CSA B651, "Accessible design for the built environment," as listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art1.sent1:long].
revisions.change_summary: Added new Sentence 4 permitting references to Subsection 3.8.3. to be designed to applicable provisions of CSA B651

content.text: Common areas, spaces and facilities and all common exterior and interior paths of travel serving [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling units shall be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2:long] with [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art7:long].

Common corridors and passageways serving [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling units shall be equipped to provide illumination, measured at floor or tread level, of not less than 50 lx (metric).
Each [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit shall be provided with special outlet boxes and cover plates as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art19.sent7:long].

Unless otherwise required by this Section, common spaces and paths of travel that are not intended to serve the residents of [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling units need not be [REF:term:ccbl]accessible.

The principal entrance door to [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling units shall have a clear width of not less than 850 mm (metric) when the door is in the open position. (See Note 3.8.5.4.(1))

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent5:short], there shall be a clear floor space in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent14:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent15:number] adjacent to and on both sides of the [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit entrance door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent1:short].

Within an [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit, every doorway along a path of travel connecting the entrance door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent1:short] with a living space, adaptable bedroom, adaptable bathroom, and adaptable kitchen shall have a clear width of not less than 850 mm (metric) when the door is in the open position.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent5:short], there shall be a clear floor space in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent14:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent15:number] adjacent to and on both sides of the doorways described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent3:short].

Doorways provided with power door operators, or provided with a special outlet box and cover plates that are designed, located and wired specifically to accommodate the future installation of a power door operator, may provide the clear floor space described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent16:long].

articles.title: Adaptable Dwelling Unit Hallways and Corridors

content.text:
Hallways and corridors in [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling units forming a path of travel connecting the entrance door described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art4.sent1:long] with a living space, adaptable bedroom, adaptable bathroom and adaptable kitchen shall have a clear width conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art2.sent1:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art2.sent2:number].
At least one bedroom or sleeping space in an [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit shall have

clauses.text: a floor area that permits a turning area of not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in diameter, or not less than 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric), that could be adjacent a bed,
a pathway clearance of not less than 850 mm (metric) wide, that could be unobstructed by a bed, to allow functional use of the bedroom, and
at least one closet that provides

subclauses.text: a clear opening width of not less than 900 mm (metric), and

a clear floor space, that need not be separate from the turning areas required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art6.sent1.clause1:short], of not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in diameter or 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric) on at least one side of the closet. (See Note A-3.8.5.6.(1).)

revisions.title: Adaptable Dwelling Unit Bedrooms

content.text: At least one bedroom or sleeping space in an [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit shall have

clauses.text: a floor area that permits a turning area of not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in diameter, or not less than 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric), that could be adjacent a bed,
a pathway clearance of not less than 850 mm (metric) wide, that could be unobstructed by a bed, to allow functional use of the bedroom, and
when provided, a [REF:term:clst]closet with

subclauses.text: a clear opening width of not less than 900 mm (metric), and

a clear floor space, that need not be separate from the turning areas required in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art6.sent1.clause1:short], of not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in diameter or 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric) on at least one side of the [REF:term:clst]closet. (See Note A-3.8.5.6.(1).)

content.text: Though the Code doesn't regulate bed furniture or sizes or styles such as bunkbeds, designs should allow for a bed to be located to accommodate transfer from the turning area to either side of the bed, such as by flipping the orientation of the bed, as well as for functional maneuvering space in the room.
A built-in closet is not required by this Code.

revisions.change_summary: Struck out second through fifth sentences and substituted new text about bed furniture and built-in closets, and added additional paragraph

content.text: At least one bathroom in an [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit shall be designed to be adaptable for use by [REF:term:prsns-wth-phscl-dsblts]persons with disabilities by providing

clauses.text: a clear lateral transfer space adjacent a water closet conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause2:long],

a [REF:term:plmbng-sstm]plumbing system that accommodates the future installation of a lavatory with a clear space in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause1:medium]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause6:number] that does not impede the space for or use of other fixtures described in this Article (see Note A-3.8.5.7.(1)(c) and (d)),
a [REF:term:plmbng-sstm]plumbing system that accommodates the future installation of a

subclauses.text: shower described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art17.sent1:long] that does not impede the space for or use of other fixtures described in this Article, or

bathtub described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art18.sent1:long] that does not impede the space for or use of other fixtures described in this Article (see Note A-3.8.5.7.(1)(c) and (d)), and

clauses.text: walls adjacent the water closet and shower or bathtub location reinforced to accommodate the future installation of grab bars conforming to

subclauses.text:
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause6:medium]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art12.sent1.clause7:number] for water closets, and
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art17.sent1.clause6:long] for showers or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art18.sent1.clause6:medium] for bathtubs (see Note A-3.8.5.7.(1)(e)).

content.text: The kitchen in an [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling unit shall be designed so that the [REF:term:cktop]cooktop and sink are adjacent or can have a continuous counter between them.
A clear floor space shall be provided in the kitchen area that is not less than 1 700 mm (metric) in diameter or 1 700 mm (metric) by 1 500 mm (metric).

The [REF:term:plmbng-sstm]plumbing system serving the kitchen shall accommodate the future installation of a kitchen sink that could be installed in accordance with the requirements for the installation of a lavatory as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art16.sent1.clause6:number]. (See Note A-3.8.5.7.(1)(c) and (d).)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art9.sent2:short], controls and switches for [REF:term:bldng]building systems and outlets in [REF:term:dptbl-dwllng-nt]adaptable dwelling units, that are intended for frequent operation by occupants, shall not require activities for operation below 400 mm (metric) from the floor or above 1 200 mm (metric) from the floor.
[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect5.art9.sent1:short] does not apply to controls, switches and dedicated outlets for equipment or appliances.

For the purpose of this Section, the term “self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]building” shall mean a [REF:term:bldng]building that is open to the public for the sole purpose of providing individual
self-service storage units.
This Section applies to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings that

clauses.text: are not more than one [REF:term:tr]storey in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,
do not contain a [REF:term:bmnt]basement or [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine,

consist of individual self-service storage units with external
access only,
are used for no purpose other than storage, and

except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent4:short], contain no other [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy.

content.text:
Where there is a conflict between the requirements of this Section
and other requirements in Part 3, this Section shall govern.
The requirements in Part 3 regarding [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load shall not apply to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings.

Self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall
be classified as Group F, Division 2 [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major
occupancies.

For the purpose of applying the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2:long] to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings, [REF:term:bldng-r]building area shall
mean

clauses.text: the [REF:term:bldng-r]building area of each [REF:term:bldng]building, or
the total of the [REF:term:bldng-r]building areas of all [REF:term:bldng]buildings as a group.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect2.art2.sent3:short], the spatial separation requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long] shall apply to self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings.
The distance between each group of self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall be not less than 9 m.

[REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long] need not apply between [REF:term:bldng]buildings within a group of self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings, where the distance between these [REF:term:bldng]buildings is at least 6 m (metric).

Where [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect2.art1.sent1.clause2:long] is applied to a group of [REF:term:bldng]buildings, [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art5.sent1:long] shall apply to that group of [REF:term:bldng]buildings as if they were a single [REF:term:bldng]building.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent6:short], the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3:long] shall
apply. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote238:short].)
Not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is permitted to be contained within one of the self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings on a property.

A [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:short] shall be separated from individual
self-service storage units by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 2 h (metric).

Where an office not more than 50 m2
                            (metric) in area is adjacent to a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent2:short], it shall
be considered as part of the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit.

[REF:term:fr-prtn]Fire separations required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect1.art1.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art9.sent1:long] need not be provided between individual
self-service storage units.
The [REF:term:flr-r]floor area of self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall be

clauses.text:
subdivided into compartments not more than 500 m2
                               (metric) in area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not
less than 1 h (metric), or
[REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

see_also.content:
(See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art12.sent2:long] for the exemption applying
to [REF:term:xt]exit doors of individual self-service storage
units.)

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect7.subsect2.art1.sent3:long], two public
washrooms, each containing a water closet and a lavatory, shall be
provided within one of the self-service storage [REF:term:bldng]buildings on the property. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote239:short].)

For the purpose of compliance with this Code as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect2.subsect1.art1.sent1.clause2:long], the objectives and functional statements
attributed to the acceptable solutions in this Part shall be the objectives
and functional statements listed in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.subsect1.art1.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect3.appnote1:long].)
