in [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, shall swing on the vertical
axis.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent5:short], breakaway sliding doors, installed as required [REF:term:xt]exit doors or required doors in [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means
of egress, shall be identified as swinging doors by means of
a label or decal affixed to the door.
Revolving doors shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art15:long]

Movable [REF:term:prttn]partitions used to separate
a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor from an adjacent [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and personal services occupancy or
a [REF:term:mrcntl-c]mercantile occupancy need not conform
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent1:short], provided the partitions
are not located in the only [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote130:long].)

[REF:term:xt]Exit doors need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art4.sent2:short], where

clauses.text: the doors serve accessory [REF:term:bldng]buildings where life safety is not adversely affected,

the doors serve [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garages or other accessory [REF:term:bldng]buildings serving
not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, or
the doors

subclauses.text:
serve storage [REF:term:t]suites of not more than 28 m2
                                  (metric) in gross area that are in warehousing [REF:term:bldng]buildings of not more than one [REF:term:tr]storey, and
open directly to the exterior at ground level.

content.text:
Except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
unit or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, [REF:term:xt]exit doors that are required to swing shall
swing in the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel.

Doors that open onto a corridor or other facility that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from a room or [REF:term:t]suite having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of more than 60 persons shall swing on the vertical axis in the
direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel.

Doors that divide a corridor that is not wholly contained within
a [REF:term:t]suite shall swing in the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel.

Where a pair of doors is installed in a corridor that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit in both directions, the doors
shall

clauses.text:
swing in opposite directions, with the door on the right-hand
side swinging in the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel,
or
swing in both directions.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6.art6.sent2:short], the distance between a stair riser and the leading edge of a door
during its swing, except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, shall be not less than 300 mm (metric).

Where there is a danger of blockage from ice or snow, an [REF:term:xt]exit door, including doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, may open onto not more than
one step, provided the riser of such a step does not exceed 150 mm (metric).

articles.title: Door Latching, Locking and Opening Mechanisms

content.text:
Principal entrance doors, [REF:term:xt]exit doors
and doors to [REF:term:t]suites, including exterior doors
of [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, and other doors in
an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit shall

clauses.text:
be openable from the inside or in travelling to an [REF:term:xt]exit without requiring keys, special devices or
specialized knowledge of the door-opening mechanism, or

be controlled by electromagnetic locking mechanisms in accordance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5:long].

content.text:
Except for doors serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
unit or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, and doors to accessory [REF:term:bldng]buildings and
to garages serving a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, door release hardware on doors in a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means
of egress shall be operable with one hand and the door shall
be openable with not more than one releasing operation. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent4:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote131:long].)

Door release hardware on doors in a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means
of egress shall be installed 900 mm (metric) to 1 100 mm (metric) above the finished floor.

Except for hotels and motels, a door opening onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor that provides [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from [REF:term:t]suites shall be designed not to lock automatically if it is equipped with
an automatic self-closing device. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote143:long].)

Every [REF:term:xt]exit door, except doors serving
a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit or a house with
a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, shall be designed and
installed so that when the latch is released the door will open in
the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel under a force
of not more than 90 N applied to the door release hardware. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect3.art6.sent8:long] for door opening forces in an accessible path of travel.)

articles.title:
Egress from Roof Area, Podiums, Terraces, Platforms and Contained
Open Spaces

content.text: Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art1.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art1.sent4:short] an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit shall be provided from every roof intended for [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy and from every podium, terrace, platform or contained open space.

Where a roof is intended for an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of more than 60 persons, at least 2 separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress at the roof level, designed in conformance with the requirements for [REF:term:xt]exits and located remote from each other, shall be provided.

Where a podium, terrace, platform or contained open space is provided, egress requirements shall conform to the appropriate requirements for rooms or [REF:term:t]suites in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4:long]

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art1.sent2:short], [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress at the roof level, designed in conformance with the requirements for [REF:term:xt]exits shall be provided from an [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy on a roof serving more than a single [REF:term:dwllng-nt]dwelling unit.

Except as required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent1:long], each [REF:term:t]suite in a [REF:term:flr-r] floor
area occupied by more than one [REF:term:t]suite shall have

clauses.text: an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit doorway,
a doorway to a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, or
a doorway to an exterior passageway.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art3.sent1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art2.sent2:long], from
the point where a doorway described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art2.sent1.clause2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art2.sent1.clause3:short] enters the [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or exterior
passageway, it shall be possible to go in opposite directions to each
of 2 separate [REF:term:xt]exits.

Except for a dead-end corridor that is entirely within a [REF:term:t]suite and except as
permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art2.sent1:long], a dead-end corridor is permitted
provided it is not more than 6 m (metric) long.

articles.title: Number and Spacing of Egress Doors

content.text:
Except for [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, at
least 2 egress doors shall be provided when the area of a room or [REF:term:t]suite, or the distance measured from any point within
the room or [REF:term:t]suite to the nearest egress door,
exceeds the values in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.table1:long]

Doors required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.sent1:short] shall
be spaced so that in the event that one door is made inaccessible
by a fire within such room or [REF:term:t]suite, the other
door will provide safe egress.

content.title:
Maximum Areas and Travel Distances for Rooms, Suites and
Mezzanines with a Single Means of Egress

header_rows.content:
Maximum Area of Room, [REF:term:t] Suite or [REF:term:flr-r]Floor Area,
m^{2}

Maximum Distance to Egress Door,
m

content.text:
Required [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from [REF:term:t]suites shall not be through any other [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, [REF:term:rvc-rm]service
room or other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy.

articles.title: Travel Distance within Rooms and Suites

content.text:
Except for [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, the
travel distance from any point within the room or [REF:term:t]suite to the nearest egress door shall not exceed the maximum
travel distance in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art2:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art1.sent3:short], for the purposes of this Subsection, travel distance
means the distance from any point in the [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area to an [REF:term:xt] exit measured along the
path of [REF:term:xt]exit travel.

Where a room or [REF:term:t]suite is separated from
the remainder of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of at least 45 min (metric) or,
in a [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered
                           [REF:term:bldng]building, by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation which is not required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating, the travel distance may be measured from an egress
door of the room or [REF:term:t]suite to the nearest [REF:term:xt]exit.

Where a [REF:term:pblc-crr] public corridor is not
less than 9 m (metric) wide and conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause4.subclause1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect2.art5.sent1.clause4.subclause4:short], the travel distance may be determined
in accordance with those Subclauses.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9:long], at least 2 [REF:term:xt]exits shall be provided from every [REF:term:flr-r]floor
area, spaced so that the travel distance to the nearest [REF:term:xt]exit is not more than

clauses.text:
40 m (metric) in the case of [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business
and personal services occupancies,
45 m (metric) for all [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies where the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, and
30 m (metric) for all other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9:long], a single [REF:term:xt]exit is permitted from each [REF:term:tr] storey in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of 1 and 2 [REF:term:tr] storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height provided
the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area and travel distance requirements
conform to those required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4:long] and the total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load served by an [REF:term:xt]exit facility does not exceed 60 persons.

Where more than one [REF:term:xt]exit is required
from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, each [REF:term:xt]exit shall be considered as contributing not more than half
the required [REF:term:xt]exit width.

Where more than one [REF:term:xt]exit is required
from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area, at least 2 [REF:term:xt]exits shall be independent of each other and be
placed remote from each other along the path of travel between them.  (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote49:short].)
Not more than one [REF:term:xt]exit from a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area above or below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey is permitted to lead through a lobby.

The lobby referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] shall be not more than 4.5 m (metric) above [REF:term:grade]grade, and the path of travel through the lobby to the outdoors
shall not exceed 15 m (metric).

The lobby referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] shall conform in all respects to the requirements for [REF:term:xt]exits, except that rooms other than [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms, storage rooms and rooms of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential or [REF:term:ndtrl-cc]industrial
occupancy are permitted to open directly onto such lobby.

Where the lobby referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] and adjacent [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies that are permitted to open into the lobby are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation between such [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies and the lobby
need not have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote156:long].)

Passenger elevators are permitted to open onto the lobby referred
to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5.sent1:short] provided the elevator
doors are designed to remain closed except while loading and unloading
passengers.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent3:short], the space above a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine shall be served by [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress leading
to [REF:term:xt]exits accessible at the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine level, on the same basis as [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas.
The [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent1:short], provided

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine is not required to
terminate at a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art1.sent2:long],
the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine is not more than 60,

the area of the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine does not
exceed the area limits stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.table1:long], and

the distance limits stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.table1:long], measured
along the path of travel, are not exceeded from any point on the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine to

subclauses.text:
an egress door serving the space that the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine overlooks if the space is served by a single egress
door, or

an egress stairway leading to an [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access
to exit in the space below if that space is required to be
served by 2 or more egress doorways in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art4.sent1:long].

content.text:
One of the [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from
a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine that is not required to terminate
at a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art1.sent2:long], and that exceeds the limits of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent2:short] is permitted to lead through the room
in which the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine is located, provided
all other [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from that [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine lead to [REF:term:xt]exits accessible at the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine level.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent2:short], the maximum travel distance from any point on a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine to the nearest [REF:term:xt]exit shall
be not more than

clauses.text:
40 m (metric) in a [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and personal
services occupancy,

45 m (metric) in a [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout, provided
it does not contain a [REF:term:hgh-hzrd]high-hazard industrial
occupancy, or

30 m (metric) in any [REF:term:flr-r]floor area not referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent4.clause1:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art6.sent4.clause2:short].

articles.title: Travel Limit to Exits or Egress Doors

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent3:short], every [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit containing
more than 1 storey
                            (metric) shall have [REF:term:xt]exits or egress doors located so that it shall not
be necessary to travel up or down more than 1 storey
                            (metric) to reach a level served by

clauses.text:
an egress door to a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, enclosed [REF:term:xt]exit stair or exterior passageway,
or
an [REF:term:xt]exit doorway not more than 1.5 m (metric) above adjacent ground level.

content.text:
Where a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is not located
above or below another [REF:term:t]suite, the travel limit
from a floor level in the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit to an [REF:term:xt]exit or egress door may exceed 1 storey
                            (metric) where that floor level is
served by an openable window

clauses.text: providing an unobstructed opening of not less than 1 m (metric) in height and 0.55 m (metric) in width, and
located so that the sill is not more than

subclauses.text: 1 m (metric) above the floor, and
7 m (metric) above adjacent ground level.

content.text:
The travel limit from a floor level in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit to an [REF:term:xt]exit or egress
door may exceed 1 storey
                            (metric) where
that floor level has direct access to a balcony.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art2.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect7.art3.sent1:long], where an egress door from a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit opens onto a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or exterior passageway it shall be possible from the location where the egress door opens onto the corridor or exterior passageway to go in opposite directions to 2 separate [REF:term:xt]exits unless the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit has a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress.

For [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite, it need not be possible to go in more than one direction to an [REF:term:xt]exit from the location where the egress door opens into a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or exterior passageway if the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered or if each [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit has separate and direct access from each [REF:term:tr]storey to

clauses.text: a balcony, or
an openable window conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause2:short].

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent3:short], a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit shall be provided with a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress where an egress door from the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit opens onto

clauses.text: an [REF:term:xt]exit stairway serving more than one [REF:term:t]suite,
a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor

subclauses.text: serving more than one [REF:term:t]suite, and
served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit,

clauses.text: an exterior passageway

subclauses.text: serving more than one [REF:term:t]suite,
served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit stairway or [REF:term:rmp]ramp, and
more than 1.5 m (metric) above adjacent ground level, or

clauses.text: a balcony

subclauses.text: serving more than one [REF:term:t]suite,
served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit stairway or [REF:term:rmp]ramp, and
more than 1.5 m (metric) above adjacent ground level.

content.text: Where a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit is located above another [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit or common space in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite, the upper [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit shall be provided with a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress where an egress door from that [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit opens onto an exterior passageway that

clauses.text: has a floor assembly with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating less than 45 min,
is served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit stairway or [REF:term:rmp]ramp, and
is located more than 1.5 m above adjacent ground level.

content.text: For [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite where an egress door from either [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit opens onto a shared egress facility served by a single [REF:term:xt]exit stairway or [REF:term:rmp]ramp, other than as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent2:short], a second and separate [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress need not be provided if the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered or if the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units have separate and direct access from each [REF:term:tr]storey to

clauses.text: a balcony, or
an openable window conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art1.sent2.clause2:short].

articles.title: Egress Windows or Doors for Bedrooms

content.text:
Except where the [REF:term:t]suite is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, each bedroom or combination bedroom
shall have at least one outside window or exterior door openable from
the inside without the use of keys, tools or special knowledge and
without the removal of sashes or hardware. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect5.subsect1.art2:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote50:short].)
The window referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent1:short] shall

clauses.text:
provide an unobstructed opening of not less than 0.35
m2
                               (metric) in area with no dimension less than 380 mm (metric), and

maintain the required opening during an emergency without the
need for additional support. (See Note A-9.9.10.1.(2).)

content.text: Where a window required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent1:short] opens into a window well, a clearance of not less than 760 mm (metric) shall be provided in front of the window. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote52:short].)

Where the sash of a window referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent3:short] swings towards the window well, the
operation of the sash shall not reduce the clearance in a manner that
would restrict escape in an emergency.

Where a protective enclosure is installed over the window well
referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect10.art1.sent3:short], the enclosure
shall be openable from the inside without the use of keys, tools or
special knowledge of the opening mechanism.

This Subsection applies to all [REF:term:xt]exits except those serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
unit or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces.

[REF:term:xt]Exits shall be located so as to be clearly
visible or their locations shall be clearly indicated.

Where an [REF:term:xt]exit door leading directly
to the outside is subject to being obstructed by parked vehicles or
storage because of its location, a visible sign or a physical barrier
prohibiting such obstructions shall be installed on the exterior side
of the door.
Every [REF:term:xt]exit door shall have an [REF:term:xt]exit sign providing visual information placed over it or adjacent to it if the [REF:term:xt]exit serves

clauses.text: a [REF:term:bldng]building that is 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height,
a [REF:term:bldng]building having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of more than 150, or

a room or [REF:term:flr-r]floor area that has a fire
escape as part of a required [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress.

content.text: Every [REF:term:xt]exit sign providing visual information shall

clauses.text: be visible on approach to the [REF:term:xt]exit,

consist of a green and white or lightly tinted graphical symbol
meeting the colour specifications referred to in [REF:standard:iso3864-1] and

conform to [REF:standard:iso7010] for the following
symbols (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote157:long]):

subclauses.text: E001 emergency exit left,
E002 emergency exit right,
E005 90-degree directional arrow, and
E006 45-degree directional arrow.

content.text:
Internally illuminated [REF:term:xt]exit signs shall
be continuously illuminated and

clauses.text:
where illumination of the sign is powered by an electrical circuit,
be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:csac22.2no.141] or

where illumination of the sign is not powered by an electrical
circuit, be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs572]

content.text:
Externally illuminated [REF:term:xt]exit signs shall
be continuously illuminated and be constructed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs572] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote158:long].)

The circuitry serving lighting for externally and internally
illuminated [REF:term:xt]exit signs shall

clauses.text: serve no equipment other than emergency equipment, and

be connected to an emergency power supply as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent2:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent3:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent7:short].

content.text:
Where no [REF:term:xt]exit is visible from a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor, from a corridor used by the
public, or from principal routes serving an open [REF:term:flr-r]floor area having an [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load of more than 150, an [REF:term:xt]exit sign conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect11.art3.sent2.clause2:medium]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect11.art3.sent2.clause3:short] with an arrow or pointer
indicating the direction of egress shall be provided.
[REF:term:xt]Exit signs with tactile information shall be provided in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect5.art2:long].

articles.title: Signs for Stairs and Ramps at Exit Level

content.text:
In [REF:term:bldng]buildings that are 3 storeys
                            (metric) in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building
height, any part of an [REF:term:xt]exit
                           [REF:term:rmp]ramp or stairway that continues up or down past
the lowest [REF:term:xt-lvl]exit level shall be clearly
marked to indicate that it does not lead to an [REF:term:xt]exit, if the portion beyond the [REF:term:xt-lvl]exit level may be mistaken as the direction of [REF:term:xt]exit travel.
Arabic numerals indicating the assigned floor number shall be

clauses.text:
mounted permanently on the stair side of the wall at the latch
side of doors to [REF:term:xt]exit stair shafts,
not less than 60 mm (metric) high, raised approximately 0.8 mm (metric) above the surface,

located 1 500 mm (metric) from the finished floor and not
more than 300 mm (metric) from the door, and

contrasting in colour with the surface on which they are applied
(see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote53:short]).

content.text: This Subsection applies to the lighting of all [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress except those within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units or a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces.

Every [REF:term:xt]exit, [REF:term:pblc-crr]public
corridor or corridor providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access
to exit for the public shall be equipped to provide illumination
to an average level of not less than 50 lx (metric) at floor or
tread level and at all points such as angles and intersections at
changes of level where there are stairs or [REF:term:rmp]ramps.
The minimum value of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art2.sent1:short] shall be not less than 10 lx (metric).
Emergency lighting shall be provided in

clauses.text: [REF:term:xt]exits,
principal routes providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit in an open [REF:term:flr-r]floor area,
corridors used by the public,
underground [REF:term:wlkw]walkways,
[REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors,
public washrooms that are equipped to serve more than one person at a time,

locations where doors are equipped with an electromagnetic lock as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent5.clause11:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect4.subsect6.art16.sent6.clause7:short], and
universal washrooms, universal shower rooms and accessible change spaces required by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect8.subsect2.art8:long].

content.text:
Emergency lighting required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent1:short] shall be provided from a source of energy separate
from the electrical supply for the [REF:term:bldng]building.

Lighting required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent1:short] shall be designed to be automatically actuated for a period of
at least 30 min (metric) when the electric lighting in the affected
area is interrupted.
Illumination from lighting required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent1:short] shall be provided to average levels of not less than 10 lx (metric) at floor or tread level.
The minimum value of the illumination required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent4:short] shall be not less than 1 lx (metric).

Where incandescent lighting is provided, lighting equal to 1 W/m2
                            (metric) of [REF:term:flr-r]floor area shall be considered to meet the requirement in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3.sent4:short].

Where self-contained emergency lighting units are used, they
shall conform to [REF:standard:csac22.2no.141]

For the purposes of this Section, roofs with slopes of 60° (metric) or more to the horizontal that are adjacent to a room
or space intended for [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy shall be
considered as a wall.

articles.title: Testing of Integrated Fire Protection and Life Safety Systems

content.text:
Where life safety and fire protection systems and systems with
fire protection and life safety functions are integrated with each
other, they shall be tested as a whole in accordance with [REF:standard:ulcs1001] to verify that they have been
properly integrated. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote123:long].)

Tents, [REF:term:r-pprtd-]air-supported structures, transformer vaults, [REF:term:wlkw]walkways, elevators
and escalators shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long].
Where rooms or spaces are intended for an [REF:term:mbl-ccpn]assembly occupancy, such rooms or spaces shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long].

[REF:term:bmnt]Basements containing more than 1 [REF:term:tr]storey or exceeding 600 m2
                            (metric) in area shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long].

Where rooms or spaces are intended for the storage, manufacture
or use of hazardous or explosive material, such rooms or spaces shall
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote125:long].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect3.subsect5.art8:long], facilities
for the dispensing of fuel shall not be installed in any [REF:term:bldng]building.

Openings through floors that are not protected by shafts or [REF:term:clr]closures shall be protected in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8:long] (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art7.sent1:long].)
Chutes and shafts shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect3:long] except where they are entirely contained within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit.

Sprinkler systems shall be designed, constructed and installed
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art15:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art17:long]

Standpipe and hose systems shall be designed, constructed and
installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art8:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art11:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art17:long]

Fire pumps shall be installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art17:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art18:long]

Where fuel-fired [REF:term:pplnc]appliances are installed
on a roof, such [REF:term:pplnc]appliances shall be installed
in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect1.art5:long]

revisions.text: Part 9 does not apply to [REF:term:bldng]buildings designed and constructed in accordance with Subsection 3.2.10. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent2:long] of Division A and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect1.subsect1.art1.sent3:long] of Division B.)
revisions.change_summary: Added Sentence 9.10.1.3.(12) to clarify Part 9 does not apply to buildings designed under Subsection 3.2.10

content.text:
In kitchens containing commercial cooking equipment used in
processes producing grease-laden vapours, the equipment shall be designed
and installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote54:short].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art2:long], every [REF:term:bldng]building or part thereof shall be classified
according to its [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy as
belonging to one of the groups or divisions described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art1.table1:long]

content.title: Occupancy Classifications

body_rows.content:
[REF:term:lw-hzrd-]Low-hazard
industrial occupancies (Does not include [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garages serving individual [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units)

articles.title: Custodial, Convalescent and Residential Care Homes

content.text: Children's custodial homes and convalescent homes for ambulatory occupants living as a single housekeeping unit in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit with sleeping accommodation for not more than 10 persons (metric) are permitted to be classified as [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancies (Group C).
Reserved.
Reserved.
Reserved.
Reserved.
A care facility accepted for residential use pursuant to provincial legislation is permitted to be classified as a [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy, provided

clauses.text: occupants live as a single housekeeping unit in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit with sleeping accommodation for not more than 10 persons (metric),
[REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms are installed in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19:long],
emergency lighting is provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect12.art3:long], and
the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered throughout.

articles.title: Major Occupancies above Other Major Occupancies

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art4:long], in any [REF:term:bldng]building containing more than one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy in which one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy is located entirely above
another, the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1:long] for each
portion of the [REF:term:bldng]building containing a [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy shall be applied to that portion
as if the entire [REF:term:bldng]building was of that [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy.

articles.title: Buildings Containing More Than One Major Occupancy

content.text:
In a [REF:term:bldng] building containing more than
one [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, where the aggregate
area of all [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies  in a
particular group or division does not exceed 10% of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area on the [REF:term:tr]storey on which they are located, they need not be considered as [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancies for the purposes of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2.art3:long] provided they are not classified as Group F, Division 2 occupancies
                            (metric).

articles.title: Group A, Division 2, Low Occupant Load

content.text: This Part may apply to a Group A, Division 2 [REF:term:ssmbly-cc]assembly occupancy that is permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect2.art7:long] to be classified as a Group D, [REF:term:bsn-prsn]business and personal services occupancy, provided the [REF:term:bldng]building in which the [REF:term:ssmbly-cc]assembly occupancy is located complies with [REF:internal:nbc.divA.part1.sect3.subsect3.art3.sent1:long] of Division A. (See Note A-3.1.2.7.)

Except as permitted in Sentences (2) and (3), where a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating or a [REF:term:fr-prtct]fire-protection rating is required
in this Section for an element of a [REF:term:bldng] building, such rating shall be determined in conformance with

clauses.text: the test methods described in Part 3,
the calculation method presented in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long], or

the construction specifications presented in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table1:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table2:long]. (See Note A-9.10.3.1.(1)(c).)

content.text: In a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, where a minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of 15 min (metric) is permitted, the construction described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art1.sent2.clause1:long] is permitted to be used.

In a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, where a minimum [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of 30 min (metric) is permitted, it is permitted to use construction having

clauses.text: walls and floor/ceiling assemblies framed with wood studs,
joist spaces filled with

subclauses.text:
preformed insulation of rock or slag fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs702], "Mineral Fibre Thermal Insulation for Buildings," having a mass per unit area of not less than 1.22 kg/m2
                                  (metric) of floor surface, or

wet-blown cellulose fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs703], "Cellulose Fibre Insulation for Buildings," having a density of not less than 50 kg/m3
                                  (metric) to a minimum depth of 90 mm (metric) on the underside of the subfloor and the sides of the structural members,

clauses.text: stud spaces of

subclauses.text:
[REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing assemblies filled with preformed insulation of rock or slag fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs702.1], "Standard for Mineral Fibre Thermal Insulation for Buildings, Part 1: Material Specification," having a mass per unit area of not less than 1.22 kg/m2
                                  (metric) of wall surface, or filled with insulation of cellulose fibres conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs703], "Standard for Cellulose Fibre Insulation (CFI) for Buildings," having a density of not less than 50 kg/m3
                                  (metric),

clauses.text: resilient channel on one side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation spaced 400 (metric) or 600 mm (metric) o.c., and
not less than 12.7 mm (metric) thick gypsum board on ceilings and on both sides of walls. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect11.subsect1.art1.sent2.clause1:long].)

content.text:
Where a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating is
required in this Section for an element of a [REF:term:bldng]building, such rating shall be determined in accordance with the test methods
described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long], or in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long].

Unless the [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating is referred to herein as a “surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating,” it shall apply to any surface of the element being
considered that would be exposed by cutting through it as well as
to the exposed surface of the element.

Floor, roof and ceiling assemblies shall be rated for exposure
to fire on the underside.

Exterior walls shall be rated for exposure to fire from inside
the [REF:term:bldng]building, except that such walls need
not comply with the temperature rise limitations required by the standard
tests referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long] if such walls have
a [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance of not less than 1.2 m (metric), and due allowance is made for the effects of heat radiation
in accordance with the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3:long].
Interior vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations required to have [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance ratings shall be rated for exposure to fire on each side.

Where a ceiling construction has a suspended membrane ceiling
with lay-in panels or tiles which contribute to the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, hold down clips or
other means shall be provided to prevent the lifting of such panels
or tiles in the event of a fire.

Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2.sent1:long], the space above a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine is permitted
to be excluded from the calculation of [REF:term:bldng-hg]building
height, provided

clauses.text:
the aggregate area of [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanines that
are not superimposed does not exceed 10% of the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area of the [REF:term:bldng]building in which
they are located, and

the area of [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine in a [REF:term:t]suite does not exceed 10% of the area of that [REF:term:t]suite on the [REF:term:tr]storey on which
it is located.

content.text:
Except as required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2.sent1:long], the space
above a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine is permitted to be excluded
from the calculation of [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, provided

clauses.text:
the aggregate area of [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanines that
are not superimposed does not exceed 40% of the open area of the room
in which they are located (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote48:long]), and

except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1.sent3:short], the space above the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine floor
is used as an open area without [REF:term:prttn]partitions or subdividing walls higher than 1 070 mm (metric) above the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine floor.

content.text:
The space above a [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1.sent2:short] is permitted to include
an enclosed space whose area does not exceed 10% of the open area
of the room in which the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine is located,
provided the enclosed space does not obstruct visual communication
between the open space above the [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine and the room in which it is located.

For the purpose of determining [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant
load, the areas of [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanines that
are not considered as [REF:term:tr]storeys shall be added
to the [REF:term:flr-r]floor area of the [REF:term:tr]storey on which they are located. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote58:short].)

Platforms and catwalks intended solely for periodic inspection
and maintenance need not be considered as floor assemblies or [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanines for the purpose of calculating [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height, provided

clauses.text: they are not used for storage, and

they are constructed with [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible materials, unless the [REF:term:bldng]building is permitted
to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction.

articles.title: More Than One Level of Mezzanine

content.text:
Each level of [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine that is partly
or wholly superimposed above the first level of [REF:term:mzznn]mezzanine shall be considered as a [REF:term:tr]storey in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height.

Where a [REF:term:bmnt]basement is used primarily
as a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage, the [REF:term:bmnt]basement is permitted to be considered as a separate [REF:term:bldng]building for the purposes of this Section provided
the floor above the [REF:term:bmnt]basement and the exterior
walls of the [REF:term:bmnt]basement above the adjoining
ground level are constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations of masonry or concrete having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating of not less than 2 h (metric).
A rooftop enclosure shall not be considered as a [REF:term:tr]storey in calculating the [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height if the rooftop enclosure is provided for

clauses.text: elevator machinery,
a [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room,
a stairway used for no purpose other than for access or egress,
an elevator lobby used for no purpose other than for access or egress, or
a combination thereof.

subsections.title: Permitted Openings in Wall and Ceiling Membranes

articles.title: Permitted Openings in Wall and Ceiling Membranes

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:short], a membrane forming part of an assembly required to
have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance rating shall
not be pierced by openings into the assembly unless the assembly has
been tested and rated for such openings.

A wall or ceiling membrane forming part of an assembly required
to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating is
permitted to be pierced by openings for electrical and similar service
outlet boxes, provided such outlet boxes and the penetrations conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8:long]

A membrane ceiling forming part of an assembly assigned a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  on the basis of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.spectables1.table2:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long] is permitted to
be pierced by openings leading to ducts within the ceiling space,
provided the ducts, the amount of openings and their protection conform
to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD:long].

Where a [REF:term:bldng]building or part of a [REF:term:bldng]building is required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction, [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible elements shall be limited in conformance
with the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5:long]

[REF:term:hv-tmbr-]Heavy timber construction shall
be considered to have a 45 min (metric)
                           [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating when it is constructed in accordance
with the requirements for [REF:term:hv-tmbr-]heavy timber construction in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect4.art7:long]

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art3:long], structural
steel members used in construction required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating shall be protected
to provide the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating.

subsections.title:
Fire Resistance and Combustibility in Relation to Occupancy,
Height and Supported Elements

articles.title: Fire-Resistance Ratings for Floors and Roofs

content.text:
Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance ratings of floors and roofs
shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect2:long] for mixed [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21:long] for construction camps.)

content.title: Fire-Resistance Ratings for Floors and Roofs

header_rows.content:
Floors Except
Floors over Crawl Spaces

content.text:
The requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long] for roof assemblies
to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating are
permitted to be waived in [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered
                           [REF:term:bldng]buildings where

clauses.text:
the sprinkler system is electrically supervised in conformance
with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art9.sent3:long], and

the operation of the sprinkler system will cause a signal to
be transmitted to the fire department in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art7.sent4:long].

articles.title: Fire-Resistance Ratings for Walls, Columns and Arches

content.text:
Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, all [REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing walls, columns and arches in the [REF:term:tr]storey immediately below a floor or roof assembly
shall have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of
not less than that required for the supported floor or roof assembly.

Light-frame walls, columns, arches and beams as well as [REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing steel elements that support floors
between [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units in a house with
a [REF:term:scnd-t]secondary suite including their common
spaces shall be protected by not less than 12.7 mm (metric) thick
gypsum board. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote59:short].)

Where an assembly is required to be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction and to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, it shall be supported by [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible construction.
Construction supporting a [REF:term:rvc-rm]service room need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art3:long]

[REF:term:mzznn]Mezzanines required to be counted
as [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2:long] shall
be constructed in conformance with the requirements for “Floors Except
Floors over Crawl Spaces” in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long]

Where a portion of a roof supports an [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, that portion shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating conforming to the rating for “Floors Except Floors over
Crawl Spaces” in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art8.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art8.sent3:short], the floor assembly of every exterior passageway used
as part of a [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress shall have
a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating  of not less
than 45 min (metric) or be of [REF:term:ncmbtbl-] noncombustible
construction.

No [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating is required
for floors of exterior passageways serving [REF:term:bldng]buildings of Group D, E or F [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy that are not more than 2 [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:term:bldng-hg]building height.

No [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating is required
for floors of exterior passageways serving

clauses.text: reserved,

a single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit where no [REF:term:t]suite is located above or below the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect9.art3.sent2:long]).

content.text:
Where a crawl space exceeds 1.8 m (metric) in height or
is used for any [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy or as a [REF:term:plnm]plenum in [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction or for the passage of [REF:term:fl-pp]flue pipes, it
shall be considered as a [REF:term:bmnt]basement in applying
the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1:long]
[REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art1.table1:long] does not apply to

clauses.text: a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit that has no other [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit above or below it,
houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, or

a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit that is not above
or below another [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy.

content.text:
The [REF:term:fr-rtnc-] fire-resistance ratings of
floors, roofs, [REF:term:ldbrng]loadbearing  walls, columns
and arches need not conform to this Subsection if such assemblies
conform in all respects to the appropriate requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2:long]

subsections.title: Fire Separations between Rooms and Spaces within Buildings

revisions.title:
Fire Separations and Smoke-tight Barriers between Rooms and
Spaces within Buildings

content.text: This Subsection applies to

clauses.text: [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations required between rooms and spaces in [REF:term:bldng]buildings, except between rooms and spaces within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, and
reserved.

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art3:long], a wall or
floor assembly required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation  shall be constructed as a continuous barrier against the spread
of fire and retard the passage of smoke.
Reserved.

Except as provided
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent6:short], the continuity of a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation where it abuts another [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, a floor,
a ceiling, or a roof shall be maintained by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating
not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the abutting [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote60:short].) (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote29:long].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent6:short], joints located in a horizontal plane between a floor and an exterior
wall shall be sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that,
when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:astme2307] has an F rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Except as provided
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent6:short], all gypsum
board joints in the assemblies described in Sentence (1) shall conform to [REF:standard:csaa82.31] to
maintain the integrity of the smoke-tight barrier over the entire
surface.

Joints between ceilings and walls, between floors and walls,
and between walls at corners need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent3:short]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art2.sent5:short] where such joints consist
of gypsum board that is attached to framing members and arranged so
as to restrict the passage of flame and smoke through the joints.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote30:long].)

articles.title: Openings to be Protected with Closures

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art5:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8:short], openings
in required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations shall be
protected with [REF:term:clr]closures conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13:long]

Doors in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of 15 min (metric), but not greater than 45 min (metric), need not have a [REF:term:fr-prtct]fire-protection rating provided they (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13:long] and Note A-9.10.9.3.(2).)

clauses.text: are at least 45 mm (metric) thick solid core wood doors, and
have a self-closing device.

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art4.sent2:short]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art4.sent4:short], all floor assemblies shall be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations.

Floor assemblies contained within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
units and  within houses with a [REF:term:scnd-t]secondary
suite need not be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separations.

Floor assemblies for which no [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating is required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8:long] and floors of [REF:term:mzznn] mezzanines not required to be counted as [REF:term:tr]storeys in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art1:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect4.art2:long] need not be constructed as [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations.

Where a crawl space is not required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect8.art9:long] to be constructed as a [REF:term:bmnt]basement, the
floor above it need not be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

[REF:term:ntrcnnct]Interconnected floor spaces shall
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect8:long]

articles.title:
General Requirements
for Penetrations of Fire Separations

content.text:
Except as required
by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent2:short] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art7:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8:long] and as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art9:long],
penetrations of a required [REF:term:fr-prtn] fire separation or a membrane forming part of an assembly required to be a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation shall be

clauses.text:
sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected
to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an F rating not less than the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation,

tightly fitted or cast in place, provided the penetrating item
is made of steel, ferrous, copper, concrete or masonry, or
sealed to maintain the integrity of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

content.text:
Penetrations of a [REF:term:frwll]firewall shall
be sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than
the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Except as provided
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art7.sent2:short]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art7.sent5:short], piping for drain, waste,
vent and central vacuum systems that is not located in a vertical
shaft is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating or a membrane that forms part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided the penetration
is protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause2:short].

Drain piping leading
directly from a water closet through a concrete floor slab is permitted
to penetrate a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane that contributes to the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided

clauses.text:
the piping is [REF:term:ncmbtbl-]noncombustible and
the penetration is protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1:long], or

the piping is [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible and the
penetration is sealed by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long].

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible drain, waste and vent
piping is permitted on one side of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided it is not located in a vertical
shaft.

In [REF:term:bldng]buildings containing two dwelling units
                                  (metric) only, [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible drain, waste and vent piping is permitted on one
side of a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

Water distribution piping is permitted to partly or wholly penetrate
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided

clauses.text:
the piping is [REF:term:cmbtbl]noncombustible and
the penetration is protected in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1:long], or

the piping is [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible and is
not located in a vertical shaft, and the penetration is sealed by
a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long].

articles.title:
Penetrations by Outlet Boxes or Service Equipment in Concealed
Spaces

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent2:short]
                                 [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent5:short], outlet boxes are permitted to penetrate the membrane
of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating, provided they are sealed at the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to the fire test
method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote63:short].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent2:long], [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible outlet boxes that penetrate
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming
part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short], provided

clauses.text: they do not exceed

subclauses.text:
0.016 m (metric)
                                       ^{2} in area, and

an aggregate area of 0.065 m (metric)
                                       ^{2} in
any 9.3 m (metric)
                                       ^{2} of surface area, and

clauses.text: the annular space between the membrane and the [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible outlet boxes does not exceed 3 mm (metric).

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent2:long], [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible outlet boxes that penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming part
of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short], provided

clauses.text: the outlet boxes are

subclauses.text:
separated from the remainder of the space within the assembly
by an enclosure of not more than 0.3 m (metric)
                                       ^{2} in area made of [REF:term:fr-blk]fire block material
conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3:long] (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote64:short]), or

located in a space within the assembly that is filled with preformed
fibre insulation processed from rock or slag conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs702] and having a mass
per unit area of not less than 1.22 kg/m (metric)
                                       ^{2} of wall surface such that the exposed sides and back of the outlet
box are encapsulated by the [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible insulation, and

clauses.text:
the outlet boxes do not exceed an aggregate area of 0.016
m (metric)
                                    ^{2} in any individual enclosure as described
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause1:short] or any individual insulated
space as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause2:short].

content.text:
[REF:term:ncmbtbl]Noncombustible outlet boxes conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent2:short] are permitted to be located
on opposite sides of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating and
need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short], provided
they are

clauses.text:
separated from each other by a horizontal distance of not less
than 600 mm (metric),

separated from each other and the remainder of the wall space
by an enclosure conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause1:medium], or
located in an insulated wall space in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3.clause1.subclause2:medium].

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible outlet boxes conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent3:short] are permitted to be located
on opposite sides of a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating and
need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent1:short].

Service equipment is permitted to penetrate a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12.sent2:long], provided the penetration is sealed by

clauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop that, when subjected to
the fire test method in [REF:standard:ulcs115] has an FT rating not less than the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation,

a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long], where the service equipment is located entirely
within the cavity of a wall assembly above and below the horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having a required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, or
a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long], where the penetration is

subclauses.text:
contained within the concealed space of a floor or ceiling assembly
having a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating,
located above a ceiling membrane providing a horizontal [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, or

contained within a [REF:term:hrzntl-r]horizontal service
space conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12.sent2:long] that is directly
above or below a floor or ceiling.

articles.title: Penetrations by Raceways, Sprinklers and Fire Dampers

content.text:
[REF:term:cmbtbl]Combustible totally enclosed raceways
that are embedded in a concrete floor slab are permitted in an assembly
required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, provided the concrete cover between the raceway and the bottom
of the slab is not less than 50 mm (metric).

Totally enclosed raceways are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided they are sealed at
the penetration by a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1.clause1:long].

Sprinkler piping is permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, provided the [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire
compartments on each side of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separation are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

Sprinklers are permitted to penetrate a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming part of an assembly
required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art8.sent6.clause1:long], provided
the annular space created by the penetration of a fire sprinkler is
covered by a metal escutcheon plate in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13]

[REF:term:fr-dmpr]Fire dampers are permitted to penetrate
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation or a membrane forming
part of an assembly required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating without having to meet the [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art6.sent1:long], provided the [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper is

clauses.text: installed in conformance with [REF:standard:nfpa80]
specifically designed with a [REF:term:fr-tp]firestop, or
provided in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:long].

content.text: In a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces, ducts penetrating [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations need not be equipped with [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire dampers in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10:long] provided they are [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible with all openings in the duct system serving only one [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment.

[REF:term:cmbtbl-c]Combustible construction that
abuts on or is supported by a [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible
                                 [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation shall be constructed
so that its collapse under fire conditions will not cause collapse
of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation.

articles.title: Reduction in Thickness of Fire Separation by Beams and Joists

content.text:
Where pockets for the support of beams or joists are formed
in a masonry or concrete [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, the remaining total thickness of masonry and/or grout and/or concrete
shall be not less than the required equivalent thickness shown for
Type S monolithic concrete in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixD.appsect2.subsect1.article1.table1:long] of Appendix
D for the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art12.sent2:short], a [REF:term:hrzntl-r]horizontal service space or other
