a floor space where an upper [REF:term:tr]storey projects
beyond the exterior wall of a lower [REF:term:tr]storey and

subclauses.text:
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation is required at
the floor between the two, or
reserved, or

clauses.text:
a floor space where an upper [REF:term:tr]storey projects
beyond the exterior wall of a lower [REF:term:tr]storey, and the projection is continuous across

subclauses.text:
a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation separating
two [REF:term:t]suites, or
reserved.

content.text: Protection required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent2:short] shall be provided by

clauses.text:
[REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible material having
a minimum thickness of 0.38 mm (metric) and a melting point not
below 650°C,

not less than 12.7 mm (metric) thick gypsum soffit board
or gypsum board installed according to [REF:standard:csaa82.31]
not less than 11 mm (metric) thick plywood,

not less than 12.5 mm (metric) thick OSB or waferboard,
or
not less than 11 mm (metric) thick lumber.

content.text:
In the case of a soffit described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent1:short] that is at the edge of an [REF:term:ttc-r-rf]attic
or roof space and completely separated from the remainder of
that [REF:term:ttc-r-rf]attic or roof space by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks, the requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent2:short] do not apply.

Where all [REF:term:t]suites spanned by a common [REF:term:ttc-r-rf]attic or roof space or situated above or below
the projecting floor are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered,
the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect12.art4.sent2:short] do not
apply, provided that all rooms, including closets and bathrooms, having
openings in the wall beneath the soffit are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, notwithstanding any exceptions in the sprinkler
standards referenced in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12:long]

subsections.title: Doors, Dampers and Other Closures in Fire Separations

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art2:long], openings
in required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations shall be
protected with a [REF:term:clr]closure conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art1.table1:long] and shall be installed in conformance with Chapters
2 to 14 of [REF:standard:nfpa80] unless otherwise
specified herein. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long])

content.title: Fire-Protection Ratings for Closures

articles.title: Solid Core Wood Door as a Closure

content.text:
A 45 mm (metric) thick solid core wood door is permitted
to be used where a minimum [REF:term:fr-prtct] fire-protection
rating of 20 min (metric) is permitted or between a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor and a [REF:term:t]suite  provided that the door conforms to [REF:standard:ulcs113] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote68:short].)

Doors described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art2.sent1:short] shall
have not more than a 6 mm (metric) clearance beneath and not more
than 3 mm (metric) at the sides and top.

Doors required to provide a 20 min (metric)
                           [REF:term:fr-prtct]fire-protection rating or permitted to be 45 mm (metric) solid core wood shall be mounted in a wood frame of
not less than 38 mm (metric) thickness where the frame has not
been tested and rated.

articles.title: Doors as a Means of Egress

content.text: Doors forming part of an [REF:term:xt]exit or a public [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect6:long] in addition to this Subsection.

Wired glass conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect6.subsect1.art2:long] which
has not been tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long] is
permitted as a [REF:term:clr]closure in a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required to have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not more than 1 h (metric) provided such glass is not less than 6 mm (metric) thick and is mounted in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5.sent2:short].

Wired glass described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5.sent1:short] shall be mounted in fixed steel frames having a metal thickness
of not less than 1.35 mm (metric) and a glazing stop of not less
than 20 mm (metric) on each side of the glass.

Individual panes of glass described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5.sent1:short] shall not exceed 0.8 m2
                            (metric) in area or 1.4 m (metric) in height or width, and the area of
glass not structurally supported by mullions shall not exceed 7.5 m2
                            (metric).

Steel door frames forming part of a [REF:term:clr]closure in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, including anchorage
requirements, shall conform to [REF:standard:ulcs105]

Glass block that has not been tested in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1:long] is permitted as a [REF:term:clr]closure in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation required to have
a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not more
than 1 h (metric). (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect20.subsect9.art6:long])

The size of an opening in an interior fire separation, even
where protected with a [REF:term:clr]closure, shall not
exceed 11 m2
                            (metric), with no dimension greater
than 3.7 m (metric), when the [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments on both sides of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation are not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

The size of an opening in an interior [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation, even where protected with a [REF:term:clr]closure, shall not exceed 22 m2
                            (metric), with no dimension greater than 6 m (metric), when the [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments on both sides of the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.
Every swing type door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation shall be equipped with a latch.

Except as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art10.sent2:short], every door in a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation shall
have a self-closing device.
Self-closing doors are not required between [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors and [REF:term:t]suites in [REF:term:bn-nd-pr]business and personal services occupancies, except in dead-end corridors.

Where hold-open devices are used on doors in required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations, they shall be installed in
accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art14:long]

Swing-type doors shall open into [REF:term:rvc-rm]service
rooms containing fuel-fired equipment where such doors lead
to [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors or rooms used for
assembly but shall swing outward from such rooms in all other cases.

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art13.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art13.sent5:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art9.sent5:long], a duct that penetrates an assembly required to be
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation with a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating shall be equipped with
a [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect8.art10:long]

A [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper is not required where
a [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible branch duct pierces
a required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation provided the
duct

clauses.text: has a melting point not below 760°C (metric),

has a cross-sectional area less than 130 cm2
                               (metric), and

supplies only air-conditioning units or combined air-conditioning
and heating units discharging air at not more than 1.2 m (metric) above the floor.

content.text:
A [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper is not required where
a [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible branch duct pierces
a required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation around an [REF:term:xht-dct]exhaust duct riser in which the airflow is
upward provided

clauses.text: the melting point of the branch duct is not below 760°C (metric),
the branch duct is carried up inside the riser not less than 500 mm (metric), and

the [REF:term:xht-dct]exhaust duct is under negative
pressure as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art20:long]

content.text:
[REF:term:ncmbtbl]Noncombustible ducts that penetrate
a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation separating a [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space from the remainder
of the [REF:term:bldng]building need not be equipped with
a [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper at the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation provided

clauses.text: the ducts have a melting point above 760°C (metric), and

each individual duct exhausts directly to the outside at the
top of the [REF:term:vrtcl-rv]vertical service space.

content.text:
A duct serving commercial cooking equipment and piercing a required [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation need not be equipped with a [REF:term:fr-dmpr]fire damper at the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separation. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part6.sect3.subsect1.art6:long])

[REF:term:fr-tp-fl]Fire stop flaps in ceiling membranes
referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect5.art1.sent3:long] shall

clauses.text: conform to [REF:standard:ulcs1122] and

activate at a temperature approximately 30°C above the normal
maximum temperature that occurs in the ducts, whether the air duct
system is operating or shut down.

articles.title: Doors between Garages and Dwelling Units

content.text:
A door between an attached or built-in garage and a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit shall be tight fitting and weather-stripped
to provide an effective barrier against the passage of gas and exhaust
fumes and shall be fitted with a self-closing device.

A doorway between an attached or built-in garage and a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit shall not be located in a room
intended for sleeping.

Where a door is installed so that it may damage the integrity
of a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation if its swing is
unrestricted, door stops shall be installed to prevent such damage.
This Subsection applies to [REF:term:bldng]buildings other than those to which [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15:long] applies.

This Subsection does not apply to detached carports conforming
to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect35:long] that serve not more than one[REF:term:dwllng-n] dwelling unit or a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t]secondary suite.

articles.title: Area and Location of Exposing Building Face

content.text: Except as permitted by Sentence (4), the area of an [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face shall be

clauses.text:
taken as the exterior wall area facing in one direction on any
side of a [REF:term:bldng]building, and
calculated as

subclauses.text:
the total area measured from the finished ground level to the
uppermost ceiling, or

the area for each [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment, where a [REF:term:bldng]building is divided into [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments by [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations with [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
ratings not less than 45 min (metric).

content.text:
For the purpose of using [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.table1:long] to determine
the maximum aggregate area of [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected openings in an irregularly shaped or skewed exterior wall, the location of
the [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face shall be
taken as a vertical plane located so that there are no [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected openings between the vertical
plane and the line to which the [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance is measured. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote57:long].)

For the purpose of using [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art5.table1:long] to determine
the required type of construction, cladding and [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating for an irregularly shaped or skewed
exterior wall,

clauses.text:
the location of the [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building
face shall be taken as a vertical plane located so that no
portion of the actual [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face is between the vertical plane and the line to which the [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance is measured, and

the value for the maximum area of [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected
openings (see second column of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art5.table1:long])
shall be determined using the [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance measured from the location described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art2.sent3.clause1:short]. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote57:long].)

content.text: If a [REF:term:bldng]building is divided by fire separations into [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments, the area of [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face is permitted to be calculated for each [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartment, provided the fire separations have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 45 min (metric).

the time from receipt of notification of a fire by the fire
department until the first fire department vehicle arrives at the [REF:term:bldng]building exceeds 10 min (metric) in 10% or
more of all calls to the [REF:term:bldng]building, and

conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect3:long], or

where the [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance is

content.text:
The spacing between individual [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected
openings described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent3:short] that serve a single room or space described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent5:short] shall be not less than

clauses.text:
2 m (metric) horizontally of another [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected opening that is on the same [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face and serves the single room or space,
or

2 m (metric) vertically of another [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected opening that serves the single room or space,
or another room or space on the same [REF:term:tr]storey.

content.text:
For the purpose of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent4:short],
“single room or space” shall mean

clauses.text:
two or more adjacent spaces having a full-height separating
wall extending less than 1.5 m (metric) from the interior face
of the exterior wall, or
two or more stacked spaces that are on the same [REF:term:tr]storey.

content.text:
The maximum aggregate area of [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected
openings is permitted to be up to twice the area determined
according to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent1:short], where the [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected openings are glazed with

clauses.text: wired glass in steel frames, as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art5:long], or
glass blocks, as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect13.art7:long]

face and that have [REF:term:nprtctd-]unprotected openings are [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, notwithstanding any

openings in an [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face of a [REF:term:tr]storey that faces a [REF:term:trt]street and is at the same level as the [REF:term:trt]street need not comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14.art4.sent1:short], where

or accessory [REF:term:bldng]building facing a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, where

unit, and

the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit served by the

the only [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy on the property.

same property.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent8:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent11:short], [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent5:short] shall not
apply to

clauses.text: [REF:term:bldng]buildings containing one or two [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units only, and
detached garages or accessory [REF:term:bldng]buildings, where

subclauses.text: the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng]building serves only one [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit,

the detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng]building is located on the same property as that [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
unit, and

the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit served by the
detached garage or accessory [REF:term:bldng]building is
the only [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy on the property.

content.text:
Where [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible projections on
an [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face are permitted
by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent6:short], are totally enclosed
and constructed with solid faces, such as for fireplaces and [REF:term:chmn]chimneys, and extend within 1.2 m (metric) of a property line,

clauses.text:
the construction of the face and sides of the projection shall
comply with the corresponding requirements for [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building faces for [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting
distances less than 1.2 m (metric) as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent2:short]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent3:short], and

where the underside of the projection is more than 0.6
m (metric) above finished ground level, it shall be protected by

subclauses.text: not less than 0.38 mm (metric) thick [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible material,
unvented aluminum conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-93.2]

not less than 12.7 mm (metric) thick gypsum soffit board
or gypsum ceiling board installed according to [REF:standard:csaa82.31]
not less than 11 mm thick (metric) plywood,

not less than 12.5 mm thick (metric) OSB or waferboard,
or
not less than 11 mm thick (metric) lumber.

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent10:short], where the [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance of not more
than 0.45 m (metric), projecting roof soffits shall not be constructed
above the [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote60:long].)

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent10:short], where the [REF:term:xpng-bld]exposing building face has a [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance of more than 0.45 m (metric), the face of roof soffits shall not project to less
than 0.45 m (metric) from the property line. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote60:long].)

The face of a roof soffit is permitted to project to the property
line, where it faces a [REF:term:pblc-w]public way  . (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote72:short].)

Where roof soffits project to less than 1.2 m (metric) from
the property line, the centre line of a [REF:term:pblc-w]public way, or an imaginary
line between two [REF:term:bldng]buildings or [REF:term:fr-cmprt]fire compartments on the same property,
they shall

clauses.text: have no openings, and
be protected by

subclauses.text: not less than 0.38 mm thick (metric) sheet steel,
unvented aluminum conforming to [REF:standard:cgsb-93.2]

not less than 12.7 mm thick (metric) gypsum soffit board
or gypsum ceiling board installed according to [REF:standard:csaa82.31]
not less than 11 mm thick (metric) plywood,

not less than 12.5 mm thick (metric) OSB or waferboard,
or
not less than 11 mm thick (metric) lumber.

content.text:
For [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible construction, materials installed to provide the
required protection for soffits may be covered with a [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible or [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible finish material.

Heavy timber and steel columns need not conform to the requirements
of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15.art5.sent1:short], provided the [REF:term:lmtng-dt]limiting distance is not less than 3
m (metric).

articles.title: Required Fire Blocks in Concealed Spaces

content.text:
Vertical concealed spaces in interior walls and exterior walls
shall be separated by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks

clauses.text: one from the other, and
from horizontal concealed spaces.

content.text:
Horizontal concealed spaces in attics, roof spaces, ceilings,
floors, and crawl spaces shall be separated by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks

clauses.text: one from the other, and
from vertical concealed spaces.

content.text:
[REF:term:fr-blk]Fire blocks shall be provided at
all interconnections between concealed vertical and horizontal spaces
in interior coved ceilings, drop ceilings and soffits where the exposed
construction materials within the concealed spaces have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating greater than 25.

[REF:term:fr-blk]Fire blocks shall be provided at
the top and bottom of each run of stairs where they pass through a
floor containing concealed space in which the exposed construction
materials within the space have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating greater than 25.

Where not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, concealed
spaces of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction created
by a ceiling, roof space or unoccupied attic space shall be separated
by [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks into compartments

clauses.text: not more than 60 m (metric) in greatest dimension, and

where such space contains exposed construction materials having
a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating greater
than 25, not more than 300 m2
                               (metric) in area.

content.text:
No dimension of the concealed space described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art1.sent5.clause2:medium] shall
exceed 20 m (metric).

Concealed spaces in mansard or gambrel style roofs, exterior
cornices, balconies and canopies of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible
construction in which the exposed construction materials within
the space have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating exceeding 25 shall have vertical [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks at intervals of not more than 20 m (metric) and at points where
such concealed spaces extend across the ends of required vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations.

articles.title: Required Fire Blocks in Wall Assemblies

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art2.sent2:short], [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks shall be provided to block
off concealed spaces within wall assemblies, including spaces created
by furring,

clauses.text: at each floor level,

at each ceiling level where the ceiling contributes to part
of the required [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating, and
at other locations within the wall, so that the distance between [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks does not exceed 20 m (metric) horizontally and 3 m (metric) vertically.

content.text: [REF:term:fr-blk]Fire blocks described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art2.sent1:short] are not required, provided

clauses.text:
the insulated wall assembly contains not more than one concealed
air space whose horizontal thickness is not more than 25 mm (metric),
the exposed construction materials within the space are [REF:term:ncmbtbl]noncombustible,

the exposed construction materials within the space, including
insulation, but not including wiring, piping or similar services,
have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more
than 25, or
the concealed wall space is filled with insulation.

content.text:
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3.sent3:short], [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks shall be constructed
of materials that will remain in place and prevent the passage of
flames for not less than 15 min (metric) when subjected to the
standard fire exposure in [REF:standard:ulcs101]

[REF:term:fr-blk]Fire blocks are deemed to comply
with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect16.art3.sent1:short] if they are constructed
of not less than

clauses.text: 0.38 mm (metric) sheet steel,
12.7 mm (metric) gypsum board,

12.5 mm (metric) plywood, OSB or waferboard, with joints
having continuous supports,

two layers of lumber, each not less than 19 mm (metric) thick,
with joints staggered, or
38 mm (metric) lumber.

content.text:
In a [REF:term:bldng]building permitted to be of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction, semi-rigid fibre
insulation board produced from glass, rock or slag is permitted to
be used to block the vertical space in a double-frame wall assembly
formed at the intersection of the floor assembly and the walls, provided
the width of the vertical space does not exceed 25 mm (metric) and the insulation board

clauses.text:
has a density not less than 45 kg/m3
                               (metric),
is securely fastened to one set of studs,

extends from below the bottom of the top plates in the lower [REF:term:tr]storey to above the top of the bottom plate in the
upper [REF:term:tr]storey, and

completely fills the portion of the vertical space between the
headers and between the wall plates.

content.text:
Where [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks are pierced by
pipes, ducts or other elements, the effectiveness of the [REF:term:fr-blk]fire blocks shall be maintained around such
elements. (See also [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote44:long].)

Except as otherwise provided in this Subsection, the exposed
surface of every interior wall and ceiling, including skylights and
glazing, shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating of not more than 150.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent3:short], doors need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent1:short] provided they have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating of not more than 200.

Doors within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, other
than garage doors, need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art1.sent2:short].

articles.title: Ceilings in Exits or Public Corridors

content.text: At least 90% of the exposed surface of every ceiling in an [REF:term:xt]exit or ceiling that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered in a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long])

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art3.sent2:short], at least 90% of the exposed surfaces of every wall in an [REF:term:xt]exit shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long])

At least 75% of the wall surface of a lobby used as an [REF:term:xt]exit in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect8.art5:long] shall have a
surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more
than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long])

Where an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit passageway provides
the only [REF:term:mn-f-gr]means of egress from the rooms
or [REF:term:t]suites it serves, the wall and ceiling finishes
of that passageway, including the soffit beneath and the [REF:term:guard]guard on the passageway, shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 25, except
that up to 10% of the total wall area and 10% of the total ceiling
area is permitted to have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
rating of not more than 150.

At least 90% of the total wall surface in any [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 75, or
at least 90% of the upper half of such walls shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 25. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art6:long])

articles.title: Calculation of Wall and Ceiling Areas

content.text:
Skylights, glazing, [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible doors,
and [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible light diffusers and lenses
shall not be considered in the calculation of wall and ceiling areas
in this Subsection.

Where a [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor or a corridor
used by the public contains an [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, the interior finish materials used on the walls or ceiling of such [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancy, shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating in conformance with that
required for [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridors.

Light diffusers and lenses having [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread
ratings that exceed those permitted for the ceiling finish,
shall conform to the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect13.art4.sent1:long].

Individual [REF:term:cmbtbl]combustible skylights
in corridors required to be separated from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations shall not exceed 1 m2
                            (metric) in area and shall
be spaced not less than 1.2 m (metric) apart.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art10.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17.art10.sent3:short], foamed plastics that form part of a wall or ceiling
assembly shall be protected from adjacent space in the [REF:term:bldng]building, other than adjacent concealed spaces
within [REF:term:ttc-r-rf]attic or roof spaces, crawl spaces,
wall assemblies and ceiling assemblies

clauses.text:
by one of the interior finishes described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect29.subsect4:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect29.subsect9:long],

provided the [REF:term:bldng]building does not contain
a Group C [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy, by sheet
metal that

subclauses.text:
is mechanically fastened to the supporting assembly independent
of the insulation,
is not less than 0.38 mm (metric) thick, and
has a melting point not less than 650°C (metric), or

clauses.text: by any thermal barrier that meets the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect5.art15.sent2:long].

content.text:
A walk-in cooler or freezer consisting of factory-assembled
wall, floor or ceiling panels containing foamed plastics is permitted
to be used, provided the panels

clauses.text: are protected on both sides by sheet metal not less than 0.38 mm (metric) thick having a melting point not less than 650°C (metric),
do not contain an air space, and

have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating, determined
by subjecting a sample panel with an assembled joint typical of field
installation to the applicable test described in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect1.subsect12:long], that is not more than that permitted for
the room or space in which they are located or that they bound.

content.text:
Thermosetting foamed plastic insulation having a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 200 is
permitted to be used in factory-assembled doors in [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garages serving single [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
units provided that

clauses.text: the insulation is covered on the interior with a metallic foil,
the assembly has a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 200, and
the assembly incorporates no air spaces.

content.text: The interior finish of walls and ceilings in bathrooms within [REF:term:t] suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy shall have a surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of not more than 200.

Where a covering or a lining is used with a duct, such lining
or covering shall have a [REF:term:flm-prd-] flame-spread rating conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect6.subsect5.art4:long] or [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect33.subsect6.art4:number]

Where access is provided through a [REF:term:frwll]firewall, the requirements in this Subsection shall apply to the [REF:term:flr-r]floor areas on both sides of the [REF:term:frwll]firewall as if they were in the same [REF:term:bldng]building.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.sent3:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.sent4:short], a fire alarm system shall be installed in [REF:term:bldng]buildings in which a sprinkler system is installed.
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.sent5:short], a fire alarm system shall be installed

clauses.text:
in every [REF:term:bldng]building that contains more
than 3 [REF:term:tr]storeys, including [REF:term:tr]storeys below the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey,

where the total [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load exceeds
300, or
when the [REF:term:ccpnt-ld]occupant load for any [REF:term:mjr-ccpn]major occupancy in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art2.table1:long] is exceeded.

content.title:
Maximum Occupant Load for Buildings without Fire Alarm
Systems

header_rows.content:
[REF:term:ccpnt-ld]Occupant
Load  Above which a Fire Alarm System is Required

content.text:
In [REF:term:bldng]buildings in which a sprinkler
system has been installed in accordance with [REF:standard:nfpa13d] a fire alarm system need not be installed.

In [REF:term:bldng]buildings that contain fewer than 9 sprinklers (metric) conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect5.art12.sent4:long], a
fire alarm system need not be installed.

A fire alarm system is not required in a [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy where an [REF:term:xt]exit or [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor serves not more
than 4 [REF:term:t]suites or where each [REF:term:t]suite has direct access to an exterior [REF:term:xt]exit facility leading to ground level.

Except as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art3.sent2:short] and
as required by this Subsection, where fire alarm, fire detection and
smoke detection devices and systems are installed, these devices and
systems and their installation shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long]

The following Articles in [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4:long] regarding
fire alarm systems do not apply to Part 9 [REF:term:bldng]buildings: [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art10:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art11:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art12:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art13:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect4.art22:long]

articles.title: Rooms and Spaces Requiring Heat Detectors or Smoke Detectors

content.text: Where a fire alarm system is required, every [REF:term:pblc-crr]public corridor in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy and every [REF:term:xt]exit stair shaft shall be provided with [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art4.sent3:short], if a fire alarm system is required in a [REF:term:bldng]building that is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered, [REF:term:fr-dtctr]fire detectors shall be installed in the following
spaces:

clauses.text: storage rooms not within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units,
[REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms not within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units,
janitors' rooms

rooms in which hazardous substances are to be used or stored
(see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote125:long]),
elevator hoistways, chutes and dumbwaiter shafts, and
laundry rooms in [REF:term:bldng]buildings of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy, but not those within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units.

content.text:
[REF:term:ht-dtctr]Heat detectors and [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art4.sent2:short] are not required in [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units or in [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered
                           [REF:term:bldng]buildings in which
the sprinkler system is electrically supervised and equipped with
a water flow alarm.

articles.title: Smoke Detectors in Recirculating Air-Handling Systems

content.text:
Except for a recirculating air system serving not more than
one [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, where a fire alarm
system is required to be installed, every recirculating air-handling
system shall be designed to prevent the circulation of smoke upon
a signal from a duct-type [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector where such system supplies more than one [REF:term:t]suite on the same floor or serves more than 1 [REF:term:tr]storey.

articles.title: Portions of Buildings Considered as Separate Buildings

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art6.sent2:short], where a vertical [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having
a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating of not less
than 1 h (metric) separates a portion of a [REF:term:bldng]building from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building and there are no openings through the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire
separation other than those for piping, tubing, wiring and
conduit, the requirements for fire alarm and detection systems may
be applied to each portion so separated as if it were a separate [REF:term:bldng]building.

The permission in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect18.art6.sent1:short] to
consider separated portions of a [REF:term:bldng]building as separate [REF:term:bldng]buildings does not apply
to [REF:term:rvc-rm]service rooms and storage rooms.

Central vacuum cleaning systems serving more than one [REF:term:t]suite or [REF:term:tr]storey in [REF:term:bldng]buildings equipped with a fire alarm system shall
be designed to shut down upon activation of the fire alarm system.

A fire alarm system is not required in a [REF:term:trg-grg]storage garage conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect2.subsect2.art92:long] provided
there are no other [REF:term:ccpnc]occupancies in the [REF:term:bldng]building.
Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art8:long], [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms conforming to [REF:standard:ulcs531] shall be installed in

clauses.text: each [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit,

each sleeping room not within a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
unit, and

ancillary spaces and common spaces not in [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units in a house with a [REF:term:scnd-t]secondary
suite.

content.text: The sound patterns of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms shall

clauses.text: meet the temporal patterns of [REF:term:lrm-gnl]alarm signals (see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote77:long]), or
be a combination of temporal pattern and voice relay.

content.text: Within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, sufficient [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms shall be installed so that

clauses.text: there is at least one [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm installed on each [REF:term:tr]storey, including [REF:term:bmnt]basements, and
on any [REF:term:tr]storey of a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit containing sleeping rooms, a [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm is installed

subclauses.text: in each sleeping room, and

in a location between the sleeping rooms and the remainder of
the [REF:term:tr]storey, and if the sleeping rooms are
served by a hallway, the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm shall
be located in the hallway.

content.text:
A [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art3.sent1:short] shall be installed in conformance
with [REF:standard:ulcs553]

[REF:term:mk-lrm]Smoke alarms required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art3.sent1:short] shall
be installed on or near the ceiling.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent3:short], [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms described
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art1.sent1:long] shall

clauses.text:
be installed with permanent connections to an electrical circuit
(see [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote86:long]),

have no disconnect switch between the overcurrent device and
the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm, and

in case the regular power supply to the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm is interrupted, be provided with a battery as
an alternative power source that can continue to provide power to
the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm for a period of no less
than 7 days (metric) in the normal condition, followed by 4 minutes (metric) of alarm.

content.text:
Where the [REF:term:bldng]building is not supplied
with electrical power, [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms are
permitted to be battery-operated.

occupancy are permitted to be equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms, provided the [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors

form part of the fire alarm system.

content.text:
[REF:term:mk-dtctr]Smoke detectors permitted to be
installed in lieu of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms as stated
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4.sent3:short] are permitted to sound
localized alarms within individual [REF:term:t]suites,
and need not sound an alarm throughout the rest of the [REF:term:bldng]building.

Where more than one [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm is required in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms shall be interconnected so that the actuation of any one alarm causes all alarms within the [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit to sound.

an additional [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm of photo-electric type shall be installed in each [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit and common space and be interconnected so that the actuation of one [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm will cause the additional [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms in the other [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units or common spaces to sound when the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect9.subsect4.art2:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art17:long] have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating not less than 30 min (metric) (see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect3.art1.sent3:short]).

content.text: Additional [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms and interconnection of [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms between [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units and common spaces in a house with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite is not required if

clauses.text:
the [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separations described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect9.art16:long]

the [REF:term:bldng]building is [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

content.text:
Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6.sent2:short], a manually operated device shall be incorporated within the circuitry
of a [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm installed in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit so that the signal emitted by
the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm can be silenced for a
period of not more than 10 min (metric), after which the [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarm will reset and sound again if the
level of smoke in the vicinity is sufficient to re-actuate it.

[REF:term:t]Suites of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancy equipped with [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detectors installed to [REF:standard:ulcs524] which are part of the fire alarm system in lieu

required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6.sent1:short].

Where instructions are necessary to describe the maintenance
and care required for [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms to
ensure continuing satisfactory performance, they shall be posted in
a location where they will be readily available to the occupants for
reference.

Except where a fire alarm system is installed or required in
a [REF:term:bldng]building, [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke
detectors forming part of a residential fire warning system
installed in conformance with [REF:standard:ulcs540] are permitted to be installed in lieu of all [REF:term:mk-lrm]smoke alarms required by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art3:short], provided that the fire warning system

clauses.text:
is capable of sounding audible signals as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art2:long]
                              [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art5:long],
is powered as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art4:long], and
is equipped with a silencing device as stated in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect19.art6:long]

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art1.sent3:short], a window or access panel providing an opening not less than 1 100 mm (metric) high and 550 mm (metric) wide and having a sill
height of not more than 900 mm (metric) above the floor shall
be provided on the second and third [REF:term:tr]storeys of every [REF:term:bldng]building in at least one wall
facing on a [REF:term:trt]street if such [REF:term:tr]storeys are not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered.

Access panels required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art1.sent1:short] shall be readily openable from both inside and outside or be glazed
with plain glass.
Access panels required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art1.sent1:short] need not be provided in

clauses.text: [REF:term:bldng]buildings containing only [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units where there is no [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit above another [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, or
houses with a [REF:term:bc-scnd-t]secondary suite including their common spaces.

content.text:
Except for [REF:term:bmnt]basements in houses with
a [REF:term:scnd-t]secondary suite or [REF:term:bmnt]basements serving not more than one [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, each [REF:term:bmnt]basement that
is not [REF:term:prnklrd]sprinklered that exceeds 25 m (metric) in length or width shall be provided with direct access
to the outdoors to at least one [REF:term:trt]street.

Access required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art2.sent1:short] may
be provided by a door, window or other means that provides an opening
not less than 1 100 mm (metric) high and 550 mm (metric) wide,
the sill height of which shall not be more than 900 mm (metric) above the floor.

Access required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art2.sent1:short] may
also be provided by an interior stair accessible from the outdoors.

Access for fire department equipment shall be provided to each [REF:term:bldng] building by means of a [REF:term:trt]street, private roadway or yard. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote77:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part3.sect9.appnote90:long].)

Where access to a [REF:term:bldng]building as required
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20.art3.sent1:short] is provided by means of
a roadway or yard, the design and location of such roadway or yard
shall take into account connection with public thoroughfares, weight
of firefighting equipment, width of roadway, radius of curves, overhead
clearance, location of fire hydrants, location of fire department
connections and vehicular parking.

Portable extinguishers shall be installed in all [REF:term:bldng]buildings, except within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, in conformance with the appropriate provincial
or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws or, in the absence
of such regulations or bylaws, the [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc].

articles.title: Freeze Protection of Fire Protection Systems

content.text:
Equipment forming part of a fire protection system that may
be adversely affected by freezing temperatures and that is located
in an unheated area shall be protected from freezing.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art9:long], construction camps shall
conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect1:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect20:long]

Except for sleeping rooms within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling
units, sleeping rooms in construction camps shall be separated
from each other and from the remainder of the [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having not less than a 30 min (metric)
                           [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating.

articles.title: Floor Assemblies between the First and Second Storey

content.text:
Except in a [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling unit, a floor
assembly in a construction camp [REF:term:bldng]building separating the [REF:term:frt-tr]first storey and the
second [REF:term:tr]storey shall be constructed as a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having not less than a 30 min (metric)
                           [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance rating.

[REF:term:wlkw]Walkways of [REF:term:cmbtbl-c]combustible construction connecting [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall be separated from each connected [REF:term:bldng]building by a [REF:term:fr-prtn]fire separation having not less
than a 45 min (metric)
                           [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating.

Construction camp [REF:term:bldng]buildings shall
be separated from each other by a distance of not less than 10 m (metric) except as otherwise permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect14:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect15:long]

Except in [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units and except
as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art6.sent2:short], the surface [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating of wall and ceiling surfaces
in corridors and [REF:term:wlkw]walkways, exclusive of
doors, shall not exceed 25 over not less than 90% of the exposed surface
area and not more than 150 over the remaining surface area.

Except within [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units,
corridors that provide [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from sleeping rooms and that have a [REF:term:fr-rtnc-]fire-resistance
rating of not less than 45 min (metric) shall have a [REF:term:flm-prd-]flame-spread rating conforming to the appropriate
requirements in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect17:long]

Except in [REF:term:dwllng-n]dwelling units, corridors
providing [REF:term:cc-t-xt]access to exit from sleeping
rooms in construction camp [REF:term:bldng]buildings with
sleeping accommodation for more than 10 persons shall be provided
with a [REF:term:mk-dtctr]smoke detector connected to the [REF:term:bldng]building alarm system.

Each construction camp [REF:term:bldng]building shall
be provided with portable fire extinguishers in conformance with the
appropriate provincial or territorial regulations or municipal bylaws
or, in the absence of such regulations or bylaws, in conformance with
the [REF:standard:nrcc-nfc].

Every construction camp [REF:term:bldng]building providing
sleeping accommodation for more than 30 persons shall be provided
with a hose station that is protected from freezing and is equipped
with a hose of sufficient length so that every portion of the [REF:term:bldng]building is within reach of a hose stream.
Hose stations required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art9.sent1:short] shall be located near an [REF:term:xt]exit.

Hoses referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect10.subsect21.art9.sent1:short] shall be not less than 19 mm (metric) inside diam and shall
be connected to a central water supply or to a storage tank having
a capacity of not less than 4 500 L (metric) with a pumping system
capable of supplying a flow of not less than 5 L/s (metric) at
a gauge pressure of 300 kPa (metric).

articles.title: Removal of Topsoil and Organic Matter

content.text:
The topsoil and vegetable matter in all unexcavated areas under
a [REF:term:bldng]building shall be removed.

In localities where termite infestation is known to be a problem,
all stumps, roots and other wood debris shall be removed from the [REF:term:l]soil to a depth of not less than 300 mm (metric) in unexcavated areas under a [REF:term:bldng]building.

The bottom of every [REF:term:xcvtn]excavation shall
be free of all organic material.

[REF:term:xcvtn]Excavations shall be kept free of
standing water.

The bottom of [REF:term:xcvtn]excavations shall be
kept from freezing throughout the entire construction period.
[REF:term:xcvtn]Excavations for [REF:term:fndtn]foundations shall extend to undisturbed [REF:term:l]soil.
