the cladding materials described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect1.art1.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect1.art1.sent5:short] are installed on substrates other than those identified
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect1.art1.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect1.art1.sent5:short], the materials and installation
shall comply with Part 5.

articles.title: Minimizing and Preventing Ingress and Damage

content.text:
Except where exterior walls are protected from precipitation
or where it can be shown that precipitation ingress will not adversely
affect occupant health or safety, exterior walls shall be designed
and constructed to

clauses.text: minimize the ingress of precipitation into the assembly, and
prevent the ingress of precipitation into interior space.

content.text:
Except where exterior walls are protected from specific mechanisms
of deterioration, such as mechanical impact and ultraviolet radiation,
exterior walls shall be designed and constructed to minimize the likelihood
of their required performance being reduced to an unacceptable level
as a result of those mechanisms.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect2.art2.sent2:short], a cladding assembly is deemed to have a capillary break between
the cladding and the backing assembly, where

clauses.text:
there is a drained and vented air space not less than 9.5 mm deep (metric) behind the cladding, over the full height and width of the wall
(see also [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art3:long]),

an open drainage material, not less than 10 mm thick and with
a cross-sectional area that is not less than 80% open, is installed
between the cladding and the backing, over the full height and width
of the wall,

the cladding is loosely fastened to the backing and behind each
cladding component there is a clear air space that is

subclauses.text: continuous for the full width of the component,

clauses.text: the wall is a masonry [REF:term:cvt-wll]cavity wall or the cladding is masonry veneer constructed according to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect20:long], or
the cladding conforms to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect14:long]

content.text:
The drained and vented air space, and drainage material described
in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art1.sent1:short] may be interrupted by

clauses.text: penetrations for windows, doors and services,
flashing, and

furring, provided the furring does not make up more than 20%
of the furred area.

content.text:
Where a construction projects over the top of the drained and
vented air space described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect2.art2.sent1.clause1:medium] or over the drainage material described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect2.art2.sent1.clause2:medium], the air space or drainage material shall not be contiguous
with concealed spaces in the projecting construction.

Exterior walls exposed to precipitation shall be protected against
precipitation ingress by an exterior cladding assembly consisting
of a first plane of protection and a second plane of protection, where
such walls enclose spaces of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential occupancy or spaces that directly serve spaces of [REF:term:rdntl-cc]residential
occupancy.

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect2.art2.sent6:short], exterior walls exposed to precipitation shall be protected against
precipitation ingress by an exterior cladding assembly consisting
of a first plane of protection and a second plane of protection incorporating
a capillary break, where

clauses.text:
the number of degree-days is less than 3400 and the moisture
index is greater than 0.90, or

the number of degree-days is 3400 or more, and the moisture
index is greater than 1.00.

see_also.content: (See [REF:internal:nbc.divB.part1.sect1.subsect3.art1.sent1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divB.appendixC:short] for information on the moisture index.)

content.text:
In exterior walls described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect2.art2.sent5:short], the first and second planes of protection need not
incorporate a capillary break, where

clauses.text:
it can be shown that omitting the capillary break will not adversely
affect the performance of the [REF:term:bldng]building assemblies,
the [REF:term:bldng]building is an accessory [REF:term:bldng]building, or
the wall

subclauses.text:
is constructed of non-moisture-sensitive materials, and intersecting
or supported floors are also constructed of non-moisture-sensitive
materials, or

is constructed as a mass wall of sufficient thickness to minimize
the transfer of moisture to the interior.

articles.title: First and Second Planes of Protection

content.text:
Where walls required to provide protection from precipitation
comprise cladding assemblies with first and second planes of protection,

clauses.text: the first plane of protection shall

subclauses.text:
consist of cladding with appropriate trim, accessory pieces
and fasteners, and

be designed and constructed to minimize the passage of rain
and snow into the wall by minimizing holes and managing precipitation
ingress caused by the kinetic energy of raindrops, surface tension,
capillarity, gravity, and air pressure differences (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect4:long]),

clauses.text:
the second plane of protection shall be designed and constructed
to (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3:long])

subclauses.text:
intercept all rain and snow that gets past the first plane of
protection, and
effectively dissipate any rain or snow to the exterior, and

clauses.text:
the protection provided by the first and second planes of protection
shall be maintained

subclauses.text:
at wall penetrations created by the installation of components
and services such as windows, doors, ventilation ducts, piping, wiring
and electrical outlets, and
at the interface with other wall assemblies.

content.text:
A clearance of not less than 200 mm (metric) shall be provided
between finished ground and cladding that is adversely affected by
moisture, such as untreated wood, plywood, OSB, waferboard and hardboard.

A clearance of not less than 50 mm (metric) shall be provided
between a roof surface and cladding that is adversely affected by
moisture, such as untreated wood, plywood, OSB, waferboard and hardboard.

articles.title: Elements of the Second Plane of Protection

content.text:
The second plane of protection shall consist of a drainage plane
having an appropriate inner boundary and flashing to dissipate rainwater
to the exterior.

Except for cladding systems conforming to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect14:long], the inner boundary of the drainage plane
shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art6:long]

The protection provided by the second plane of protection shall
be maintained

clauses.text:
at wall penetrations created by the installation of components
and services such as windows, doors, ventilation ducts, piping, wiring
and electrical outlets, and
at the interface with other wall assemblies.

content.text:
Flashing material and its installation shall comply with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art7:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art8:long]

Sheathing membranes shall conform to the performance requirements
of [REF:standard:cgsb-51.32]

Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art4:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art6:long], at least one layer of
sheathing membrane shall be applied beneath cladding.

Sheathing membrane required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art3.sent1:short] shall be applied so that joints are lapped not less
than 100 mm (metric).

Where sheathing membrane required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art3.sent1:short] is applied horizontally, the upper sheets shall overlap
the lower sheets.

articles.title: Insulating Sheathing in lieu of Sheathing Membrane

content.text:
Where non-wood-based rigid exterior insulating sheathing, or
exterior insulating sheathing with an integral sheathing membrane
is installed, a separate sheathing membrane is not required.
Where insulating sheathing is installed as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art4.sent1:short],

clauses.text:
sheathing panels subject to moisture deterioration shall be
sealed at all joints, and

the joints of sheathing panels not subject to moisture deterioration
shall be

subclauses.text: sealed at all joints, or

lapped or tongue and groove, and detailed to ensure drainage
of water to the exterior.

articles.title: Sheathing Membranes in lieu of Sheathing

content.text:
Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art6:long], where no
sheathing is used, at least 2 layers of sheathing membrane shall be
applied beneath the cladding. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect23.subsect17.art1:long] and [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote166:short].)

All joints in the sheathing membrane required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art5.sent1:short] shall occur over framing, and the
membrane shall be fastened to the framing with roofing nails or staples
spaced not more than 150 mm (metric) along the edges of the outer
layer of sheathing membrane.

Wall sheathing is permitted to be used in lieu of one layer
of sheathing membrane required in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art5.sent1:short], and its thickness need not conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect23.subsect17.art2.table1:long].

Sheathing membrane is permitted to be omitted beneath cladding
when the joints in the cladding are formed to effectively prevent
the passage of wind and rain in conformance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art6.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art6.sent3:short], as applicable.

Cladding consisting of sheets of plywood, hardboard, OSB, waferboard
or fibre cement is considered to meet the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art6.sent1:short], provided the cladding is applied
so that

clauses.text: all edges are directly supported by framing,
the vertical joints between adjacent sheets are sealed and

subclauses.text: covered with battens,
shiplapped, or
otherwise matched to provide weathertight joints, and

clauses.text: the horizontal joints between adjacent sheets are sealed and

subclauses.text: shiplapped, or
otherwise matched to provide weathertight joints.

content.text:
Metal siding consisting of sheets of metal is considered to
meet the requirements of [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art6.sent1:short] where
the joints between sheets are of the locked-seam type.
Flashing shall consist of not less than

clauses.text: 1.73 mm (metric) thick sheet lead,
0.33 mm (metric) thick galvanized steel,
0.46 mm (metric) thick copper,
0.46 mm (metric) thick zinc,
0.48 mm (metric) thick aluminum, or
1.02 mm (metric) thick vinyl.

content.text: Except as provided in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art8.sent2:short], flashing shall be installed at

clauses.text: every horizontal junction between cladding elements,
every horizontal offset in the cladding, and

every horizontal line where the cladding substrates change and
where

subclauses.text:
the substrates differ sufficiently for stresses to be concentrated
along that line, or

the installation of the cladding on the lower substrate may
compromise the drainage of moisture from behind the cladding above.

content.text: Flashing need not be installed as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art8.sent1:short]

clauses.text:
where the upper cladding elements overlap the lower cladding
elements by not less than 25 mm (metric),
where

subclauses.text:
the cladding above and below the joint is installed outboard
of a drained and vented air space (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect2.art2.sent1.clause1:long]), and

the horizontal detail is constructed so as to minimize the ingress
of precipitation into the air space, or

clauses.text: at horizontal construction joints in stucco, where

subclauses.text: the joint is finished with an expansion-contraction strip, and

the cladding is installed outboard of a drained and vented air
space (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect2.art2.sent1.clause1:long]).

content.text:
Flashing shall be installed over exterior wall openings where
the vertical distance from the bottom of the eave to the top of the
trim is more than one-quarter of the horizontal overhang of the eave.
(See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote169:short].)

Flashing described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art8.sent1:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art8.sent3:short] shall

clauses.text:
extend not less than 50 mm (metric) upward inboard of the
sheathing membrane or sheathing installed in lieu of the sheathing
membrane (see [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art4:long]),

have a slope of not less than 6% toward the exterior after the
expected shrinkage of the [REF:term:bldng]building frame,
terminate at each end with an end-dam

subclauses.text:
with a height in millimetres not less than 25 mm (metric) or 1/10 the value of the 1-in-5 driving rain wind pressure in Pa,
and
at the height defined in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect3.art8.sent4.clause3.subclause1:short], extending to the face of the adjacent cladding,

clauses.text: lap not less than 10 mm (metric) vertically over the [REF:term:bldng]building element below, and

terminate in a drip offset not less than 5 mm (metric) outward
from the outer face of the [REF:term:bldng]building element
below.

content.text:
Where the sills of windows and doors installed in exterior walls
are not self-flashing, flashing shall be installed between the underside
of the window or door and the wall construction below. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote171:short].)

Sealant shall be provided where required to prevent the entry
of water into the structure.

Sealant shall be provided between masonry, siding or stucco
and the adjacent door and window frames or trim, including sills,
unless such locations are completely protected from the entry of rain.

Sealant shall be provided at vertical joints between different
cladding materials unless the joint is suitably lapped or flashed
to prevent the entry of rain. (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect7.subsect6.art2:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect20.subsect13.art12:long]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect28.subsect1.art5:long])
Sealants shall be

clauses.text: a non-hardening type suitable for exterior use,

selected for their ability to resist the effects of weathering,
and

compatible with and adhere to the substrate to which they are
applied.

content.text: Sealants shall conform to

clauses.text: [REF:standard:astmc834]
[REF:standard:astmc920]
[REF:standard:astmc1184] or
[REF:standard:astmc1311]

content.text: Backer rod shall conform to [REF:standard:astmc1330] (See [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.appnote172:long].)

Except as permitted by [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art1.sent2:short]
                           [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art1.sent5:short], cladding shall be fastened to the framing members
or furring members, or to blocking between the framing members.

Vertical lumber,
stucco lath or reinforcing, vertically applied vinyl siding, vertically
applied insulated vinyl siding, and polypropylene siding are permitted to be attached to sheathing only where the sheathing
consists of not less than

clauses.text: 14.3 mm (metric) lumber,
12.5 mm (metric) plywood or waferboard, or
11 mm (metric) OSB.

content.text:
Vertically applied metal siding and wood shingles and shakes
are permitted to be attached to the sheathing only where the sheathing
consists of not less than

clauses.text: 14.3 mm (metric) lumber,
7.5 mm (metric) plywood, or
7.5 mm (metric) OSB or waferboard.

content.text:
Where wood shingles or shakes are applied to sheathing which
is not suitable for attaching the shingles or shakes, the shingles
or shakes are permitted to be attached to a wood lath not less than 38 mm (metric) by 9.5 mm (metric) thick securely nailed to the
framing and applied as described in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect7.art5:long]

Cladding, trim and furring members are permitted to be attached
to the web fastening strips of flat wall insulating concrete form
units using screws in accordance with [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art4.sent2:long].

Blocking for the attachment of cladding shall be not less than 38 mm (metric) by 38 mm (metric) lumber securely nailed to the
framing and spaced not more than 600 mm (metric) o.c.

Except as permitted in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art1.sent4:long], furring
for the attachment of cladding shall be not less than 19 mm (metric) by 38 mm (metric) lumber when applied over sheathing.
When applied without sheathing, furring referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art3.sent1:short] shall be not less than

clauses.text:
19 mm (metric) by 64 mm (metric) lumber on supports
spaced not more than 400 mm (metric) o.c., or

19 mm (metric) by 89 mm (metric) lumber on supports
spaced not more than 600 mm (metric) o.c.

content.text: Furring referred to in [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art3.sent1:short] shall be

clauses.text: securely fastened to the framing, and
spaced not more than 600 mm (metric) o.c.

content.text:
Nail or staple size and spacing for the attachment of cladding
and trim to wood framing,
furring members or blocking shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art4.table1:long].

content.title: Attachment of Cladding to Wood Framing, Furring Members or Blocking

Screw size and spacing for the attachment of cladding, trim
and furring members to the web fastening strips of flat wall insulating
concrete form (ICF) units shall conform to [REF:internal:nbc.divBV2.part9.sect27.subsect5.art4.table2:long] where the 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure (HWP) is less than or equal

the web fastening strips of flat wall ICF units with screws not less
